Welcome and thanks to everyone for joining.
Today's class is the remaining part of last week's Neptune (Varuna Devta) class.
Recap: last week's class covered Neptune's attributes.
Agenda: what result comes when different planets sit in Neptune's sign.
Agenda: what result comes when Neptune goes into other planets' signs.
Agenda: Neptune's conjunctions with other planets.

hindi: साथ में हम बात करेंगे वेस्ट डायरेक्शन की जो हमारा इच्छा पूर्ति स्थान होता है।
says: The west direction is the wish-fulfilment place (Neptune's direction in his scheme), and it will be discussed along with Neptune.
ambiguity: West is normally Saturn's direction in classical vastu; here it is tied to Neptune by his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classical dik-bala gives west to Saturn; west as wish-fulfilment is his own scheme.

hindi: यह हर घर में होता है।
says: Every home has a west sector, so the wish-fulfilment zone exists in each house or building.
ambiguity: 'घर' may be a physical home (vastu) or a bhava; context of west direction suggests the physical home.

hindi: हर घर के द्वारा इसके उपाय किए जा सकते हैं।
says: Neptune's remedies can be done through the west sector of every home, or through each house (bhava) of the chart; details promised later.
ambiguity: Same house-vs-bhava ambiguity; he may mean remedies for each of the 12 houses.

gist: Says he will take a very small recap first.

hindi: जो नेप्च्यून है इसको वरुण देवता कहा जाता है हिंदी में और वरुण जो है यह सागर को कहा जाता है।
says: Neptune is called Varuna Devta in Hindi and Varuna stands for the ocean, so Neptune's nature is read from the sea.
classical_check: Partly differs: Varuna is the Vedic water god, but Neptune is a modern planet not in Parashari texts.

hindi: सागर अनलिमिटेड है।
says: The ocean is unlimited, so Neptune signifies limitlessness, no boundary.

hindi: पूरी धरती पर हर जगह मौजूद है।
says: The ocean is present everywhere on earth, so Neptune's influence is pervasive and touches every area of life.

hindi: ऐसा कह सकते हैं कि सागर के अंदर ही शायद धरती मौजूद है।
says: He suggests the earth itself lies inside the ocean, meaning the sea (Neptune) is the container of the material world.
ambiguity: Poetic; said with 'perhaps'.

hindi: और सागर के अंदर मुख्य तौर पर दो तत्व हैं।
says: The sea has two main elements, which he then maps onto two planets; this sets up Neptune as a blend of Moon and Sun.

hindi: एक है पानी जल चंद्रमा दूसरा है सूर्य नमक जो उसको बांध के रखता है।
says: Water in the sea is Moon; salt, which holds the water together, is Sun.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon rules water and Sun is often linked to salt (lavana) in some traditions.

hindi: आप देखेंगे तो अंतरिक्ष में धरती जो आकाश जो हमारे सौरमंडल में बंधी हुई है, वह सूर्य के आकर्षण शक्ति से बंधी हुई है।
says: The earth is held in the solar system by the Sun's attraction; he uses this to show that the Sun is the binding power.
classical_check: Silent; this is astronomy used as an analogy.

hindi: चंदा मामा जो एक स्पेसिफिक गोले पर गोल-गोल घूमता रहता है धरती के इधर-उधर यह भी सूर्य की वजह से अटका हुआ है।
says: The Moon circling the earth in a fixed orbit is also kept in place because of the Sun, so Sun binds Moon.
classical_check: Silent; astronomy analogy (the Moon is bound to the earth, which orbits the Sun).

hindi: सूर्य हम सबको खींच कर चल रहा है।
says: The Sun pulls along all of us as it moves, i.e. everything in the system follows the Sun.

gist: Quips that nobody knows where the Sun is taking us in the galaxy.

hindi: तो ये सूर्य जो है यही समुद्र के पानी को बांध कर रखता है।
says: Conclusion of the analogy: the Sun is what binds the sea water, so in Neptune's sea symbolism Sun is the binder of Moon's water.

hindi: जैसे चंदा मामा को बांध के रखता है।
says: Just as the Sun holds the Moon, it holds the sea water; the same binding relation is repeated for Moon.

gist: 'It does the work of binding the water' - repeats the Sun-binds-water point.

hindi: तो जब ये सूर्य और चंद्रमा का एक प्रकार का मिश्रण हो जाता है तो ये मान के चलिए कि कृपा का देवता बन जाता है।
says: When Sun and Moon blend into one (as salt and water in the sea), the result is the god of grace (kripa); this is how he describes Neptune's good side.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not in classical texts.

gist: Repeats that Varuna Devta means the sea water.

hindi: समुद्र है अपने आप में महा विशाल।
says: The sea is immense in itself, so Neptune also stands for vastness and huge scale.

hindi: इसका अंत नहीं।
says: The sea has no end, so Neptune is the planet of endlessness (no limit or finish line).

hindi: जैसे हम कह सकते हैं कि पता ही नहीं कोई अंत ही नहीं संसार का।
says: Like the world itself, whose end nobody knows, Neptune is the symbol of what has no known limit.

gist: 'The universe has no end' - repeat of the previous analogy.

hindi: ऐसे हमारे छोटे से सोलर सिस्टम में हमारे जीवन में अंत ही नहीं।
says: In the same way, within our small life there is also no end, meaning Neptune carries the endlessness into personal life, mainly as endless wanting.

hindi: यह एक बड़ी समस्या होती है।
says: This endlessness is a big problem for humans: the inability to feel finished or satisfied is Neptune's negative side.

hindi: हर व्यक्ति इस चक्कर में रहता है।
says: Every person is caught in this loop of unending wanting, so this Neptune effect is universal and not limited to special charts.

hindi: मेरे पास इतनी दौलत हो जिसका अंत नहीं।
says: First example of Neptune's urge: wanting wealth that never ends (a link to the wealth houses).

hindi: इतना सुख हो जिसका अंत नहीं।
says: Second example: wanting comfort and happiness that has no end.

hindi: इतना मजा हो अंत नहीं।
says: Third example: wanting pleasure and fun without limit, i.e. Neptune drives sensory indulgence.

hindi: जीवन कितना हो अनंत हो।
says: Fourth example: wanting an endless lifespan, the wish never to end.
ambiguity: This is a desire statement, not a claim about longevity in a chart.

gist: Rhetorical fragment 'how much happiness?'.

hindi: यानी हम लोग इस कॉम्बिनेशन से ग्रसित रहते हैं कि भैया और चाहिए।
says: People are gripped by this Neptune condition, the standing demand 'I want more', whatever they already have.
ambiguity: 'Combination' is used loosely for the pattern of desire, not an astrological yoga.

hindi: हमारे जीवन का और खत्म नहीं होता।
says: The 'more' in life never finishes: satisfying one want only raises the next.

hindi: यानी ये नेपच्यून ये वरुण देवता ने कहीं ना कहीं धमाल मचा रखा है खोपड़ी में कि बंदा यह नहीं कहता।
says: Neptune is creating havoc in the mind so that the person never says 'this is enough'; the cause of dissatisfaction is placed in Neptune.

gist: Quoted 'enough!' speech, completing the previous sentence.

hindi: अब मैं संतुष्ट हो गया भाई।
says: The phrase 'now I am satisfied' marks the opposite pole: contentment appears when Neptune's craving settles.

hindi: वह अपने जीवन के अंदर अगर 1 लाख सांस मिल रही है तो जिस सांस पर छींक आई उस पर गाली बक देता है।
says: A Neptune-driven mind is ungrateful: out of a lakh of good breaths it curses the one breath with a sneeze, focusing on the single flaw.
ambiguity: Illustrative figure, not a count.

hindi: अगर किसी मित्र, दोस्त, भाई, सखा ने बहुत प्रेम दिया जीवन भर तो उसकी एक गलती पर क्लेश मचा देता है।
says: Neptune's negative effect in relationships: a lifetime of love from a friend or brother is forgotten and a quarrel erupts over a single mistake.

hindi: यानी इसके डिस्टरबेंस से हमारे जीवन के अंदर हमारे सारे किए कराए सारे अच्छे कर्मों का नाश पीट देने की बुद्धि भी आती है।
says: Disturbance of Neptune can bring a mindset that wipes out all one's past good work and good deeds.

hindi: और इसी के दम पर अगर रियलाइजेशन हो जाए तो हम ये कहते हैं कोई नहीं।
says: The same Neptune, when realization arises, gives the opposite response: 'it does not matter', letting go.

hindi: 100 खून माफ।
says: Positive Neptune gives forgiveness on a very large scale, shown by the idiom 'a hundred murders forgiven'.
ambiguity: Idiom, not literal.

hindi: यानी दिल बड़ा विशाल यह बहुत विशाल है।
says: Neptune at its best gives a very large, generous heart.

hindi: सागर सागर अनंतता का देवता अनंत इसका एंड नहीं है।
says: Summary definition: Neptune, the sea, is the god of infinity with no end.

hindi: यानी जहां पर हमारे जीवन के अंदर ये पागलपन आ जाता है कि यार एंडलेस हो गया वहां भी वरुण काम कर रहा है
says: Wherever the madness of 'endless' appears in life, Neptune is working there.

hindi: और जहां हमें ये होता अरे एनफ है यार बहुत है काफी है।
says: Equally, the feeling 'this is enough, plenty' is also Neptune's work, so one planet gives both greed and sufficiency.

gist: Rhetorical question 'how much more to do?'.
Rhetorical 'how big the sea is'.
Rhetorical 'what will you do with so much, where will you carry it?'.
'We will build a house' - start of a joke about the size of a house.
'How big?' - part of the same joke.
'Nobody builds a 4 km house.'
'You could not even walk across it.'

hindi: तो कहने का मकसद है हमारे जीवन के लिमिटेशंस की रियलाइजेशन कराना भी वरुण का काम है और पागलपन अनंतता का एहसास भी वरुण है।
says: Point of the lesson: Neptune both makes us realise our limitations and creates the mad feeling of infinity; he assigns both poles to Neptune.

hindi: जैसे कि यही देवता अगर बिगड़ जाए कुंडली के जिस खाने में तो वहां हमेशा महसूस कराता और चाहिए और है कुछ नहीं सब नकली है।
says: If Neptune is afflicted in any house of the chart, the person constantly feels 'I want more' there while also feeling nothing is real or all is fake, about that house's matters.
cells_derived_method: Take the topic of the house where Neptune sits (2 wealth, 4 home, 5 romance and children, 7 partner, 10 career) and apply craving plus disillusion to it; the sign it sits in colours the style (earth sign: material wanting, water sign: emotional, fire: ambition, air: ideas).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna; Neptune in 2nd in Taurus, endless wish for money and food, never feeling rich enough.
Derived: Leo lagna; Neptune in 7th in Aquarius, idealised partner or partners, then disappointment that the relation is not real.
Derived: lagna Aries; Neptune in 10th in Capricorn, unlimited career ambition with a feeling that status achieved is hollow.

ambiguity: 'बिगड़ जाए' (afflicted) is not defined here by aspects or conjunction.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not used classically; rule follows modern house-significator logic.

hindi: धन स्थान में यदि होता है तो ऐसे लोग इस चीज का रोना रोते हैं।
says: If afflicted Neptune is in the wealth house (2nd), the person keeps complaining about money.
cells_derived_method: The 2nd house's sign changes the lagna and style of complaint: for earth signs it is savings, for Gemini or Virgo it is earning through work, for water signs it is family money.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna; Neptune in 2nd in Scorpio, complaint about shared or hidden money and family resources.
Derived: lagna Taurus; Neptune in 2nd in Gemini, complaint about income from trade and communication work.

ambiguity: Subject 'होता है' is garbled but refers to afflicted Neptune.
classical_check: Silent for Neptune; the 2nd house signifying wealth is classical.

gist: Quoted complaint 'friend, money itself is less'.

hindi: मकान के घर स्थान पर बैठे दूषित हो तो कहेगा यार ये क्या है यार?
says: Afflicted Neptune in the house of property and home (4th) makes the person dissatisfied with his house, asking 'what is this?'
cells_derived_method: The 4th house sign decides the style of discontent: in fixed earth it is about land and ownership, in water signs about emotional comfort and mother.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna; Neptune in 4th in Libra, wants a more beautiful and balanced home, never satisfied with decor or peace at home.
Derived: lagna Libra; Neptune in 4th in Capricorn, discontent about property value, status of home and ancestral land.

classical_check: Silent for Neptune; the 4th house for home is classical.

gist: Quoted complaint 'I have only two, four, five houses'.
Rhetorical 'how many do I want, how many can I enjoy?'.

hindi: भोग भले ही ना हो सके लेकिन और चाहिए।
says: Neptune's craving is separate from use: the person wants more even when he cannot enjoy what he has.

hindi: जब प्रेम संबंध में जाता है तो इतने प्रेम संबंध बनाता है कैसेनोवा बना देता है बिगाड़ देता है।
says: When afflicted Neptune enters the love-relationship area it creates many love affairs, makes a Casanova and spoils relationships.
cells_derived_method: Love houses are 5 (romance) and 7 (partnership, with 8 and 12 as secrecy and bed): Neptune in 5 gives many flirtations, in 7 many partners or an idealised spouse, in 12 hidden affairs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Neptune in 5th in Aries, impulsive romances and serial infatuation.
Derived: Gemini lagna; Neptune in 7th in Sagittarius, many partners across cultures or beliefs, idealisation of spouse.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Neptune in 12th in Scorpio, secret and intense affairs.

ambiguity: He does not name the house; 'love relationship' read as 5th/7th.
classical_check: Silent for Neptune; Venus, 5th and 7th are the classical love significators.

hindi: शराब पिलाता है अंधाधुंध पिलाता है।
says: Neptune makes a person drink alcohol wildly without limit; recorded as his tradition claim about intoxication, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Neptune is a modern significator of intoxicants, not classical.

hindi: ज्ञान देता है तो अंधाधुंध देता है।
says: When Neptune gives knowledge it gives it in a flood, without limit.

hindi: उसमें भी और जब यह व्यक्ति रियलाइजेशन कर लेता है कि और कुछ नहीं काफी है।
says: Even in those excesses, once the person realises 'nothing more is needed, this is enough', the Neptune cycle ends.

hindi: यह एनलाइटनमेंट होता है।
says: That moment of realising 'enough' is enlightenment in his definition.

hindi: तो यही एनलाइटनमेंट का देवता भी यही है कि काफी है।
says: Neptune is also the god of enlightenment, the sense of 'it is enough', so one planet carries bondage and release.
classical_check: Differs: classically moksha is Ketu and Jupiter; Neptune as enlightenment is his scheme.

gist: Rhetorical 'how much do you need?'.

hindi: तो इस ग्रह को मान के चलें कि एक समुद्र देवता इसकी राशि नंबर सात है और 12 नंबर राशि में सबसे ज्यादा उत्तम फल देता है।
says: Neptune is the sea god; his own sign is number 7, Libra, and he gives the best results in the number 12 sign.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Libra works by house: in a kendra or trikona it gives the best (balanced) results, in dusthana houses it turns craving to loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna; Neptune in own sign on the ascendant, imaginative and idealistic personality with fair-minded outlook.
Derived: Cancer lagna; Neptune in 4th in Libra, a calm and beautiful home atmosphere with idealistic family.
Derived: lagna Pisces; Neptune in 8th in Libra, hidden and sudden matters, occult interests.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर राशि में' may mean Pisces (sign 12) or just 'among the 12 signs'; the following text discusses Libra only, so Pisces is not entered in the cells.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune has no classical sign lordship; Libra as its sign is his scheme.

hindi: सात तुला तुला क्या है?
says: Number seven is Libra (Tula), his Neptune sign; he then explains what Libra symbolises.

hindi: तराजू।
says: Libra's symbol is the scales (tarazu), which he uses to read Neptune's balancing nature.
classical_check: Agrees: Libra is the sign of the balance.

hindi: तराजू को आप देखेंगे बराबर पलड़ा करता है।
says: The scale levels both pans, so Libra and its Neptune lordship equalise, bringing back balance.

hindi: यानी कि अच्छा भी बुरा भी।
says: The balance works both ways, giving good and bad in equal measure for planets that enter Libra.

hindi: समुद्र कभी कुछ रखता नहीं है अपने पास।
says: The sea never keeps anything with itself, so Neptune does not retain: what it takes it gives back.

hindi: इसमें जो फेंक दो बाहर आ जाता है या डूब जाता है।
says: Whatever is thrown into the sea either floats back out or sinks; the outcome is binary, a Neptune result is either return or total loss.

hindi: समुद्र का बहुत विशेष गुण है।
says: He announces that this behaviour (nothing is kept) is the sea's special quality.

hindi: यह दाता है देता ही है।
says: The sea is a giver; Neptune is a donor planet whose basic act is giving.

gist: Repeats that sign number seven is Libra.

hindi: ये तुला राशि इस तुला राशि में जब सूर्य ग्रह आता है।
says: Starts the case of the Sun entering Libra, Neptune's sign; the result is explained in the next sentences.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Libra is debilitated (classically) and its meaning changes with the house: it lords a different house for each lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna; Sun in Libra in the 1st is lord of the 11th, so self and gains are weak and ego is subdued.
Derived: Gemini lagna; Sun in Libra in the 5th, lord of the 3rd, children and intellect face a weakened solar push.
Derived: Capricorn lagna; Sun in Libra in the 10th, lord of the 8th, career authority is undermined and delayed.

classical_check: Agrees that Sun is debilitated in Libra (Parashara).

hindi: तुला राशि को आप जान लें समुद्र के पास जो है सूरज देवता आ गए।
says: Reading of Sun in Libra: the Sun has come close to the sea (Neptune's sign), a very hot object near water.
classical_check: Agrees in outcome (Sun is debilitated in Libra), different reasoning.

gist: Rhetorical 'where does the Sun live?'.
'Lives here' - pointing at the chest; gesture only.

hindi: सूर्य यहां रहता है और यह हमारा हृदय चक्र है।
says: The Sun's place in the body is the chest, the heart chakra.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun signifies the heart; the heart chakra link is a later tantric overlay.

hindi: अगर सूर्य देवता यहां आते हैं यानी बहुत ज्यादा गर्मी आ जाती है तो क्या ही हाल होगा।
says: If the Sun comes into this Libra (sea) position, excessive heat arrives and the heart area suffers; he leaves the effect to be inferred.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is a gesture; it could mean the chest or the sign Libra.
classical_check: Agrees roughly: Sun debilitated in Libra gives weak heart or vitality in some texts.

hindi: हो सकता है हृदय घात हो जाए।
says: Sun in Libra may lead to a heart attack; recorded only as his claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'May happen' is hedged, unlike the next sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: afflicted Sun is a heart significator, but no text promises a heart attack.

hindi: यानी कि आपके जीवन के अंदर जितने भी हार्ट अटैक होते हैं, उसमें यह गारंटी है कि सूर्य आपका भ्रष्ट हो गया है।
says: He claims every heart attack guarantees that the person's Sun is spoiled. This is a strong generalisation; medical claim recorded as said, not as advice.
ambiguity: 'Guarantee' is an overstatement; spoiled Sun is not defined.
classical_check: Overclaims: texts link Sun to the heart but do not say every heart disease means a bad Sun.

hindi: इसी सूर्य के दोष के कारण आपको किडनी में स्टोन होता है।
says: He says kidney stones are also due to a Sun flaw. A medical claim recorded as said, not as advice.
ambiguity: Kidney is usually Venus or Libra; he ties it to a hot Sun in Libra.
classical_check: Differs: kidney is Libra/Venus in kala-purusha, and stones are not Sun-specific.

hindi: आप जितने भी किडनी पेशेंट है, जितने हार्ट पेशेंट्स हैं, उन सबके साथ का लफड़ा यह है कि उनका नेपच्यून रूठा हुआ है।
says: He says all kidney and heart patients share one problem: their Neptune is upset. Medical claim recorded as said, not as advice.
ambiguity: 'रूठा' (sulking) is not defined by any chart condition.
classical_check: Silent for Neptune; sweeping and unverified.

hindi: उनका वरुण की राशि रूठी हुई है और उसके ऊपर अटैक सूर्य ने कर रखा है।
says: The Neptune sign (Libra) in their chart is troubled and the Sun is attacking it, by conjunction or aspect.
cells_derived_method: Check the Libra house of the chart (varies by lagna) for Sun's presence or aspect; the house topic shows the area hit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo; Libra is the 3rd, Sun's attack on it hits siblings and courage.
Derived: lagna Aquarius; Libra is the 9th, Sun's attack hits fortune, father and dharma.

ambiguity: 'Attack' by conjunction or aspect is not specified.

hindi: आप मान के चलें कि सूरज देवता बिल्कुल समुद्र के पास आ गए तो पानी सोख लेंगे।
says: If the Sun comes right next to the sea it will soak up the water: Sun near Neptune dries the watery side of life.

gist: Rhetorical 'then what will happen to the human body?'.

hindi: पानी सोखता चला जाएगा।
says: The body will keep losing its water (dehydration is implied); he applies the sea-drying image to the body. Recorded as his claim, not as medical advice.

hindi: कृपा अगर सूखनी शुरू हो जाए तो क्या हाल होगा?
says: If Neptune's grace (the sea's water) starts drying up, life suffers; he sets up the picture of a Sun-dried Neptune before listing the damage.

hindi: आपके शरीर का पानी सूख जाएगा।
says: With the Sun's heat on Neptune the body's water dries up. Recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.

hindi: तो खून का पानी बन गया।
says: Blood turns to water, a figure for vitality and richness draining away when Neptune's sea is dried.
ambiguity: Also an idiom (blood turning to water = losing love or warmth).

gist: Physiology: in old age the body keeps about 60% water.
Physiology: about 72% water in young adults and 90% in infants.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में शरीर का पानी जो ज कम हुआ वैसे-वैसे झुर्रियां पड़ जाती है।
says: As body water falls, wrinkles appear; he uses ageing as the sign of Sun-over-Neptune drying.

hindi: शरीर की हड्डियां गल जाती है और हड्डियों के बीच के जॉइंट वीक होते हैं।
says: Bones erode and joints between bones weaken when the sea dries; the Sun's flaw is blamed for bone and joint weakness. Medical claim recorded as said, not as advice.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun is a classical karaka of bones; the Neptune-drying logic is his own.

hindi: यह सारा का सारा खेल सूर्य देवता का है।
says: All this drying, wrinkling and bone and joint weakening is blamed on the Sun alone, the agent that damages Neptune's water.
classical_check: Overclaims: ageing and bone health are not attributed to the Sun alone in classical texts.

hindi: जब वो सात नंबर में आता है।
says: The trigger condition: this harm occurs when the Sun comes in number 7, which in this context is Neptune's seat.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 7th house takes a different sign by lagna (Aries for Libra lagna, Libra for Aries lagna), and a different house lordship; Sun in Libra in any house is debilitated. The 7th-house topic (partner, kidney, bladder) colours the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra; Sun in 7th is in Aries, its exalted sign, though still in his number 7 house; his rule would call it harmful by house even though classically it is strong.
Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in 7th is in Libra and debilitated; lord of the 5th placed in partnership house, children and creativity entangled with spouse issues.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Sun in 7th in Gemini, lord of the 9th in the 7th, father and fortune linked to partner.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' could be sign 7 (Libra) or house 7; later sentences use it for houses (8, 9, 6 'moving to 7'), so both are listed.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun is debilitated in Libra and is weak in the 7th (no digbala) classically.

hindi: कुंडली में जहां आ जाएगा उसी के अनुसार वो सूर्य आपको दोष बना के दे देगा।
says: Wherever the afflicted Sun falls in the chart, the defect shows according to that place, i.e. the house decides which body part or life area gets the problem.
cells_derived_method: Use the house's body part and affairs: 1 head, 2 face and eyes, 4 chest, 7 lower belly or bladder, with the house lord and sign style adding detail.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in 2nd in Taurus, defect to face, eyes, speech and family wealth.
Derived: lagna Leo; Sun lagna lord in 4th in Scorpio, defect to the chest and home peace.
Derived: lagna Cancer; Sun in 10th in Aries, exalted and lord of the 2nd, so the defect shows mildly in career and speech.

classical_check: Agrees with the general principle that a malefic's house shows the area of damage (kala-purusha body parts).

hindi: यहां पर आता है यह लग्न बैठ गया सिर।
says: If the afflicted Sun sits in the lagna (1st house), it troubles the head, which is the 1st house body part.
cells_derived_method: Sign of the lagna changes the style: fire signs give head heat or headaches, water signs give emotional strain on the mind, etc.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra; Sun in lagna in Libra, debilitated; head and self-confidence are the weak points.
Derived: lagna Leo; Sun in own sign in the 1st, an afflicted-Sun rule would be weak; strong self but head heat possible.

ambiguity: 'Afflicted' is assumed from context; the caption is a gesture ('here').
classical_check: Agrees: 1st house is head in kala-purusha.

hindi: यह आपकी छाती का एरिया।
says: The next house on the body map is the chest area; afflicted Sun here points to chest and heart problems.
cells_derived_method: 4th house sign changes the lagna and what the Sun lords there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in 4th in Cancer, lord of the 5th, heart and mother-home strain.
Derived: lagna Cancer; Sun in 4th in Libra debilitated, lord of the 2nd, chest and family comfort weak.

ambiguity: He points with a gesture; the house is not named. Chest = 4th in kala-purusha, so 4th is assumed.
classical_check: Agrees: 4th house is chest/heart in kala-purusha.

hindi: हार्ट अटैक की तैयारी।
says: Afflicted Sun at the chest position is a preparation for a heart attack. Medical claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: House unnamed (gesture).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun as heart karaka afflicted; no text predicts a heart attack as such.

hindi: यहां दोनों पे आ गया तो आपका किडनी स्टोन की कार्यक्रम देता है।
says: If the afflicted Sun falls on both kidney positions it produces kidney stone trouble. Medical claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Both' places are not named; may be the left and right kidney or houses 6 and 7.
classical_check: Silent; kidneys are Libra and Venus in classical body mapping.

hindi: सातवें में आ गया तो आपको हो सकता है ब्लैडर में स्टोन दे दे।
says: Afflicted Sun in the 7th may give a bladder stone. Medical claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Sun's sign in the 7th changes with lagna; debilitation in Libra makes it worse than exaltation in Aries.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in 7th in Libra, debilitated, strongest case for his claim.
Derived: lagna Libra; Sun in 7th in Aries, exalted, the sign softens the claim.

classical_check: Partly agrees: 7th house is the lower abdomen and urinary region in kala-purusha.

hindi: यहां देगा तो एक राइट पैर तोड़ देगा।
says: If the afflicted Sun falls at this other place (pointed on the body), it breaks the right leg; the house is not named.
ambiguity: House not named; legs in kala-purusha are the 10th to 12th, so right leg might be a particular house of that range.
classical_check: Silent on right versus left leg.

hindi: यहां लेफ्ट पैर तोड़ देगा।
says: At the mirror place of the previous one, the afflicted Sun breaks the left leg.
ambiguity: House not named (gesture).

hindi: यहां कंधे तोड़ देगा।
says: At another position the afflicted Sun breaks the shoulders; house unnamed.
ambiguity: House not named; shoulders are the 3rd house in kala-purusha.
classical_check: Silent for the shoulder breaking; 3rd house is arms and shoulders classically.

hindi: यहां आंखों की नेत्र की ज्योति खा सकता है।
says: At another place the afflicted Sun can eat up the eyesight; house unnamed. Medical claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: House not named; eyes are 2nd and 12th classically, and Sun is an eye karaka.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun is the karaka of eyesight.

hindi: और जहां बैठ गया उसी घर के अनुसार वहां के भाव के फलों का सत्यानाश कर देगा।
says: Wherever the afflicted Sun sits, it ruins the results of that house; the house meaning decides what is destroyed.
cells_derived_method: Take the house's significations and the sign it falls in, then remove the Sun's favourable result there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn; Sun in 10th in Libra, career, authority and public name damaged.
Derived: lagna Cancer; Sun in 4th in Libra, mother, home, vehicle and peace damaged.
Derived: lagna Scorpio; Sun in 12th in Libra, sleep, expenses and foreign matters damaged.

classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts say a debilitated malefic spoils its house; 'destroys' is stronger.

hindi: यानी वरुण देवता के घर में सूरज देवता की एंट्री बिल्कुल नहीं चाहिए।
says: The Sun should not enter Varuna's (Neptune's) house, Libra, at all, as it is damaging to the person.
cells_derived_method: House of the Sun's Libra placement varies by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra; Sun in lagna in Libra, the most visible case, self and body affected.
Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in 7th in Libra, partner and kidney area.

classical_check: Agrees: Sun is debilitated in Libra.

hindi: यह जला के भस्म कर देने वाली स्थिति हो जाएगी।
says: The Sun in Neptune's sign becomes a situation that burns the things of that house to ash.

hindi: तो यह हाईली हाईली नेगेटिव है।
says: Summary: Sun in Libra is rated as highly negative.

hindi: इसके लिए आपका उपाय है एक मुट्ठी गेहूं उबालकर ठंडे करके गाय
says: Remedy for a Sun in Libra: boil a fistful of wheat, cool it and feed it to a cow.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; feeding a cow wheat for Sun is a common folk remedy.

gist: Rhetorical 'who is the cow mother?'.

hindi: इसके साथ वाली है।
says: The cow mother is the one standing next to this (the Sun-in-Libra spot), i.e. the neighbouring principle of Libra.
ambiguity: Captions are vague; 'next to this' likely refers to Venus, lord of Libra.

gist: 'The goddess next to it' - rephrases the previous sentence.

hindi: गाय का हिसाब किताब आप ये लेके चलेंगे यदि यहां तो यहां शुक्र का स्थान है।
says: Following the cow's accounting here, this spot (Libra) is Venus's place, so the cow remedy is a Venus act performed for a Sun in Libra.
classical_check: Agrees that Libra is a Venus sign.

gist: 'This is Venus' - repeats that the place is Venus's.

hindi: ये गाय होती है।
says: The cow represents Venus in his scheme, so feeding a cow pleases Venus.
classical_check: Agrees: cow is a standard Venus karaka (and also Moon).

gist: Rhetorical 'how hot is Venus?'.

hindi: 471 डिग्री सेल्सियस टेंपरेचर।
says: Venus's surface temperature is quoted as 471 C, used to show it is a very hot planet.
ambiguity: Figure may be slightly off (about 465 C is the usual value).
classical_check: Not an astrological claim; astronomy supports Venus being hot.

hindi: कितना ज्यादा गर्म है।
says: Venus is extremely hot, so it carries heat unlike its usual 'cool' reputation.
classical_check: Differs: classically Venus is a cool, watery planet.

gist: Rhetorical 'how is the sea?'.

hindi: ठंडा यह समुद्र है।
says: The sea (Neptune) is cold, set against the hot Venus; in Libra the two meet.

gist: Anatomy: the heart has two ventricles or two areas.
Anatomy: a right heart and a left heart.
Anatomy: a right-side and a left-side bundle branch artery.
Anatomy: right side pushes blood to the left and the left pushes to the right.
Anatomy: both sides beat together.
Onomatopoeia of the heartbeat.
Anatomy: if one side slows, the other side supports it.

hindi: हमारे पास दिल भी दो होते हैं।
says: The heart is double (left and right sides), taken as a sign that the body works in pairs, which he maps to Sun and Neptune-type duality.

hindi: हर चीज दो ही होती है।
says: Everything in the body and in nature comes in twos; duality is the basic rule.

hindi: यही डुअलिटी है येदा और पिंगला नाड़ी।
says: This duality is the Ida and Pingala channels (left and right breath nadis) of yoga.
ambiguity: 'येदा' is a caption error for Ida; he does not say Ida = Moon and Pingala = Sun here.
classical_check: Agrees with yogic texts: Ida is lunar and Pingala is solar.

hindi: तो अगर आपका नेप्च्यून बिगड़ गया तो राइट बंडल ब्रांच आर्टरी ये एक तकलीफ हो जाती है।
says: If Neptune is afflicted, the right bundle branch of the heart gets a problem. Medical claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: He calls a bundle branch an artery; the term is loose.

hindi: लेफ्ट खराब हो गया तो लेफ्ट बंडल ब्रांच आर्टरी यानी आपके लेफ्ट और लेफ्ट साइड के हार्ट के अंदर ब्लड सप्लाई जो है वो ठीक नहीं है और स्लो चल रहा है।
says: If the left side is damaged (the matching left half of the pair), the left bundle branch has poor and slow blood supply to the left heart. Medical claim recorded as said.
ambiguity: What 'left' maps to in the chart (a planet, a house, or the Sun) is not stated.

gist: Aside: 'while it should not run slow'.

hindi: तो बहुत ज्यादा डेंजरस है कि आपको हार्ट अटैक हो जाए।
says: These conditions make a heart attack very dangerous. Recorded as his claim, not a prediction or diagnosis.

hindi: और ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर अगर आपका सूर्य देवता का दोष है 100% कुंडली में सूर्य कहीं पर भी हो सूर्य सात नंबर को इन्फ्लुएंस कर रहा होगा।
says: In such a case, he claims, wherever the Sun is in the chart it will certainly be influencing number 7 (by aspect, sign or house shift).
cells_derived_method: Sun in 1st aspects the 7th directly; Sun in neighbouring houses reaches it through a chalit shift.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun exalted in lagna aspects the 7th Libra, which is its debilitation sign, so Sun's gaze falls on Neptune's seat.
Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in 6th in Virgo can shift toward the 7th Libra in bhava chalit.

ambiguity: '100%' is an overstatement; 'number 7' as house or sign remains unclear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: 7th aspect of Sun from the 1st is classical; 'always' is not.

gist: Rhetorical 'how will it influence 7?'.

hindi: सूर्य आठ नंबर का हुआ तो भी सात को इन्फ्लुएंस करने के चांस है।
says: If the Sun is in number 8 it can still influence number 7, because it may sit near the cusp and shift.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 8th, close to the cusp, moves into the 7th in the bhava chalit, so the 7th gets Sun's effect; sign tells style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo; Sun exalted in the 8th in Aries, near the start of the house, chalit may place it in the 7th Pisces.
Derived: lagna Aquarius; Sun in the 8th in Virgo, chalit shift into the 7th Leo, its own sign.

classical_check: Agrees: bhava chalit shifts planets between adjacent houses.

hindi: नौ का हुआ तो भी चांस
says: Sun in number 9 also has a chance to influence 7, in the sense of a distant link via aspect.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 9th reaches the 7th only through aspect or chalit shift, which depends on its degree and the 7th's cusp.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Sun in own sign in the 9th, 3rd aspect reach is weak; effect small.
Derived: lagna Leo; Sun exalted in the 9th, little relation to Aquarius 7th except through cusp data.

ambiguity: Mechanism for the 9th reaching the 7th is not stated.

hindi: छह का हुआ तो भी चांस है कि सात नंबर की ओर मूव कर गया हो।
says: Sun in number 6 may have moved toward 7, i.e. be shifted in the chalit chart so that it falls on the 7th.
cells_derived_method: A Sun late in the 6th shifts into the 7th in chalit or sripati systems.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in the 6th in Virgo late degree may move into the 7th Libra, the Neptune seat.
Derived: lagna Pisces; Sun in the 6th in Leo may move into the 7th Virgo (a Mercury sign).

classical_check: Agrees: planets move between houses in bhava chalit.

hindi: जो मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली होती है।
says: He nicknames a combined chart 'Munna Bhai's chart', meaning the practical chart blending several chart types.
ambiguity: Nickname is not a standard term; meaning inferred from the next sentence.

hindi: यह हमारी निरण भाव केपी कुंडली कस कुंडली और चलित कुंडली को मिलाजुला कर आता है।
says: This combined view comes from mixing the nirayana, bhava, KP, cusp and chalit charts, a method he will teach separately.
ambiguity: Caption garbled ('निरण भाव', 'कस'); read as nirayana, bhava, cusp.
classical_check: Agrees with the idea of cross-checking chalit and KP cusps; mix as a single chart is his own.

gist: Says this will be discussed later.
A whole separate class is needed on this.

hindi: यानी ये दोनों पे सात का खतरा है।
says: Both the heart and the kidney (the two organs just discussed) are at risk from number 7 afflicted by the Sun.
ambiguity: 'दोनों' is not defined; read as heart and kidney. Medical claim recorded as said.
classical_check: Partly agrees: 7th house covers kidney and urinary region.

gist: 'Seven-seven danger for one' - cannot tell what is meant.

hindi: एक नंबर का सूर्य होगा तो भी सात पर दृष्टि दे सकता है।
says: Sun in the 1st house also casts its 7th aspect on number 7, so the Sun reaches the Neptune seat from the lagna.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 1st aspects the 7th house, whose sign depends on lagna; the sign aspected decides the flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo; Sun in own sign in the 1st aspects the 7th Aquarius, Saturn's sign, tension between ego and partner.
Derived: lagna Pisces; Sun in the 1st aspects the 7th Virgo, partner is critical and practical.

classical_check: Agrees: every planet aspects the 7th from itself.

hindi: दो नंबर का शिफ्ट होकर एक पर आया तो भी,
says: Sun in the 2nd that shifts into the 1st in the chalit chart also aspects the 7th.
cells_derived_method: A Sun at the end of the 2nd house moves to the 1st in chalit; aspect then falls on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo; Sun in the 2nd in Virgo, shifted into the 1st in chalit, aspects the 7th Aquarius.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Sun in the 2nd in Aquarius, shifted into the 1st, aspects the 7th Cancer.

hindi: 12 का शिफ्ट होकर एक पर आया तो भी।
says: Sun in the 12th that shifts into the 1st in chalit also casts the aspect on the 7th.
cells_derived_method: A Sun late in the 12th moves forward into the 1st in chalit; aspect then falls on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in the 12th in Pisces shifted into the lagna, aspects the 7th Libra, Neptune's seat.
Derived: lagna Libra; Sun in the 12th in Virgo shifted into the 1st Libra, debilitated by sign, aspects the 7th Aries.

hindi: इतने सारे चांसेस में आपको हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम देता है यह।
says: Summing up: in all these Sun placements (1, 2, 6, 8, 9, 12 and so on) the Sun gives heart trouble. Medical claim recorded as said.
classical_check: Overclaims: nearly every Sun position would be counted, so the rule loses its discriminating power.

hindi: लेकिन, नेप्च्यून देने वाला देवता है इसलिए मृत्यु नहीं देगा।
says: Neptune is a giving planet, so it will not give death. He means the heart problems he described are not fatal. Recorded as his claim; no death prediction.

hindi: राइट बंडल ब्रांच आर्टरी का मनुष्य जो होता है, नॉर्मल जिंदगी जी सकता है।
says: A person with the right-bundle condition can live a normal life. Medical statement recorded as said, not as advice.

gist: 'There is no problem' - repeats the previous reassurance.
Aside: doctors prescribe statins even for this.
Aside: blood-thinning medicine that keeps thinning blood for life.
Aside: many other problems then follow.

hindi: इसमें समुद्र देवता को प्रसन्न यदि कर लेते हो आप यानी इतना विशाल हृदय करते हो
says: If you please the sea god, meaning you become large-hearted, the body's repair system switches on; the remedy for Neptune is generosity of heart.
ambiguity: A garbled phrase 'ले डाला ले ले' sits in the caption; read as noise.

hindi: शुक्र जो है ये पहले ही आग की तरह है।
says: Venus is already like fire in nature, hot and burning.
classical_check: Differs: Venus is classically cool and moist.

hindi: यह भी सूर्य की तरह नन्हा सूरज है ये।
says: Venus is like a little Sun, radiant and bright like the Sun.

hindi: इतना गर्म ग्रह कोई नहीं है सूर्य के अतिरिक्त।
says: Apart from the Sun, no planet is as hot as Venus.
classical_check: Differs from classical qualities (Mars is the hot planet).

hindi: तो यह वाला जो है भ्रष्ट करके नष्ट कर देता है।
says: When afflicted, this hot planet (Venus, or Sun in its sign) corrupts and then destroys; the effect is hit-and-ruin.
ambiguity: 'यह वाला' may be Venus or the Sun; context is the hot-planet discussion.

hindi: तो हार्ट अटैक की प्रॉब्लम के लिए और किडनी स्टोन की प्रॉब्लम के लिए और बाकी हड्डियां गलाने के लिए यह आपका सूर्य है।
says: For heart attack, kidney stone and bone erosion the culprit is your Sun; a three-way medical attribution. Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Partly agrees on heart and bones for Sun; kidney is not a Sun matter classically.

hindi: अगर कुंडली में कहीं पर भी आपके तकलीफ आ रही है तो आप यह जांच लें कि यह कहीं ना कहीं सूर्य का यहां दोष है
says: If any trouble shows in the chart, check whether it is a Sun fault somewhere; he treats the Sun flaw as a first thing to check.
classical_check: Silent; a diagnostic habit, not a classical rule.

hindi: और इसके लिए आपको एक मुट्ठी गेहूं उबालकर ठंडे करके गाय को खिलानी है।
says: Remedy for the Sun fault: boil a fistful of wheat, let it cool and feed it to a cow, given again as the standing Sun remedy.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; folk remedy.

hindi: पूरे जन्म एव्री संडे
says: Do the wheat remedy every Sunday for the whole life; Sunday is the Sun's day.
ambiguity: The fragment runs on from the previous sentence; the verb is implied.
classical_check: Agrees that Sunday belongs to the Sun.

hindi: ऊपर से नमक डालकर कभी मत खाना।
says: Do not eat food after adding extra salt on top, a dietary restriction for the Sun fault.
classical_check: Silent; he links salt with the Sun via the sea idea.

hindi: वाइट नमक।
says: The salt to avoid adding on top is white salt.

hindi: काला नमक ले सकते हैं।
says: Black salt is allowed in place of white salt.

gist: 'This will be very good' - approval of the black salt advice.

hindi: योगा कीजिए।
says: Do yoga as a further remedy for the Sun-over-Neptune dryness and stiffness.

hindi: योगा करने से आपकी बॉडी के अंदर लचीलापन आएगा।
says: Yoga brings flexibility into the body, countering the joint stiffness he blamed on the Sun.

hindi: रिलीफ की स्थिति बनेगी।
says: A state of relief will result from the yoga and the salt-and-wheat remedies together.

hindi: घर के अंदर लोग नमक रख देते हैं और नमक रख के उसकी नेगेटिव एनर्जी किल करते हैं, हटाते हैं।
says: People keep salt inside the house to kill and remove negative energy; he cites this common vastu practice as support for salt's cleansing link.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; common vastu folk practice.

hindi: सूर्य ही आपका पिता है।
says: The Sun is your father, the karaka of the father.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर हो सकता है कि आपके पिता के साथ आपका तनाव रहे या जीवित भी ना हो।
says: With an afflicted Sun there may be tension with the father, or the father may not be alive. Recorded as his claim, not a prediction of any death.
classical_check: Partly agrees: afflicted Sun and 9th/10th house trouble relations with the father.

gist: Remarks that this is a detailed matter.

hindi: कहां कुंडली में बैठा उसके अनुसार होगा।
says: The exact result depends on where the Sun sits in the chart, so the father-related damage varies with its house and sign.
cells_derived_method: Sun in 9 or 10 hits the father directly; in 6, 8, 12 it brings separation or health issues of the father; the sign gives its strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius; Sun in the 9th in Libra, debilitated, father or fortune weak.
Derived: lagna Virgo; Sun exalted in the 8th in Aries, father issues come as sudden changes, less harsh.

classical_check: Agrees: house placement modifies the Sun's results.

hindi: पिता से सुख ना मिले।
says: One outcome is no happiness from the father, either through absence or conflict.
classical_check: Agrees with the general Sun-affliction result.

hindi: आप खुद ही पिता समान बनना पड़े आपको मजबूरी में।
says: Another outcome: the native is forced to act as a father himself, taking family responsibility early.

hindi: तो उसके लिए आत्मिक बल लेकर चलने की जरूरत है।
says: For this case the native must carry inner (atmic) strength, advice rather than a ritual remedy.
classical_check: Silent; Sun is the atmakaraka-like soul-strength karaka.

hindi: यह आत्मिक बल को भी तोड़ता है।
says: An afflicted Sun in Libra also breaks inner strength itself, so confidence collapses.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is the soul and vitality karaka; debilitation weakens it.

hindi: सूर्य सात नंबर हो जाए हाईली नेगेटिव कुंडली में नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: Sun in number 7 is highly negative and must not be present in a chart.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 7th changes sign with lagna; Libra is the worst, Aries the best sign for the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun debilitated in the 7th, fits his rule fully.
Derived: lagna Aquarius; Sun in own sign in the 7th, his house rule applies but classical sign strength says otherwise.

ambiguity: House 7 or sign 7 again.
classical_check: Agrees on Libra; the 7th house is also an unfavourable place for the Sun in classical texts.

hindi: दोष ही दोष बनाता है ये।
says: Sun in number 7 creates only faults and no benefits.
classical_check: Overstates; classical texts give mixed results.

hindi: इसमें कोई भी लाभ और बेहतरी की स्थिति नहीं होगी।
says: There will be no gain or improvement from this placement at all; he denies any good effect.
classical_check: Overstates; ignores exaltation in Aries when the Sun is in the 7th for a Libra lagna.

gist: Transition: 'negative totally; next the Moon comes'.
Says the next case, a planet sitting anywhere in number 7, is made up only to illustrate.

hindi: कि चंद्रमा सात नंबर।
says: The next case: Moon in number 7, a hypothetical used to compare Moon with Sun in Neptune's seat.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Libra changes with house: it lords a different house for each lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra; Moon in the 1st in Libra, lord of the 10th in lagna, career and public image link to the self.
Derived: lagna Cancer; Moon lagna lord in the 4th in Libra, home and mother absorb the person.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Moon lord of the 7th in the 10th in Libra, partner and career overlap.

ambiguity: House 7 vs sign 7 again; sign is assumed here since Libra is the topic.
classical_check: Silent on any special result for Moon in Libra beyond a friendly sign.

hindi: अब चंदा मामा उतर के आ गए सूरज के पास।
says: Now the Moon has come down to the Sun's side, so Moon and Sun are placed together in the sea sign; the meaning is 'near the Sun'.
ambiguity: Could be 'near the sea' by caption error, as the context is Neptune's sign.

gist: Rhetorical 'what is the difference between Moon and Sun?'.

hindi: सूरज वर्णन करने वाला है सारा दिन भर में
says: The Sun is the one that burns through the whole day (caption 'वर्णन' is read as 'burning'), so the Sun is the heater of the pair.
ambiguity: Caption word 'वर्णन' (description) likely a mishearing of 'बर्न'.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is a hot, fiery planet.

gist: Rhetorical 'and who is the Moon?'.

hindi: चंदा मामा उसको खींचता है।
says: The Moon pulls the Sun's salt and sea water (as in tides), so the Moon moves things.
ambiguity: 'उसको' (it) is unclear: sea or Sun.

hindi: धरती पे सूरज को वो हिलाता रहता है।
says: On earth the Moon keeps stirring the Sun (the salt), so the Sun does not settle.

hindi: अगर पानी को समुद्र के इकट्ठा करके रख दिया जाए तो उसमें नमक नीचे बैठ जाएगा और साफ सुथरा ऊपर आ जाएगा।
says: If sea water were collected and left still, the salt would settle at the bottom and clean water would rise on top; an image of what happens when the Moon's stirring stops.

hindi: तो चंदा मामा सूरज को उसमें घुलाए रखने में मदद करते हैं।
says: The Moon helps keep the Sun dissolved in the water, so Moon keeps Sun's heat blended and not separated.

hindi: अच्छा हिलता रहता है, डुलता रहता है तो समुद्र कभी अशुद्ध नहीं होता।
says: Because the sea keeps moving, it is never impure; movement is what keeps Neptune clean.

hindi: यह कहा जाता है कि समुद्र में कुछ भी डाल दो समुद्र अशुद्ध नहीं हो सकता क्योंकि वह रेगुलरली मूवमेंट पर है।
says: It is said you can put anything into the sea and it cannot become impure, because it is in constant movement.

hindi: तो चंदा मामा सफाई के देवता साफ कर रहे हैं।
says: The Moon is the god of cleaning, continually purifying; Moon is the cleanser of the chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon is a purifying planet in folk use; not a classical karaka as stated.

hindi: एक वाशिंग मशीन की तरह कार्य कर रहे हैं।
says: The Moon works like a washing machine, agitating and rinsing out impurities.

hindi: चंदा मामा वाशिंग मशीन है हमारे कुंडली में और बृहस्पति देवता वैक्यूम क्लीनर है।
says: In the chart the Moon is the washing machine and Jupiter is the vacuum cleaner; two different cleaners.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as purifier is classical (guru, removes doshas).

hindi: ये वैक्यूम की तरह सारी गंदगी को खींच लेता है।
says: Jupiter pulls out all the dirt like a vacuum, i.e. it removes the stains and negativity from what it influences.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter's aspect reduces afflictions.

gist: Student says he has a question.
Instructor says 'yes sir', inviting the question.

hindi: किसी भी भाव में जैसे उस भाव से रिलेटेड बॉडी ऑर्गन्स भी होते हैं।
says: Student's premise, accepted: every house has body organs related to it.
ambiguity: Said by a student.
classical_check: Agrees: kala-purusha assigns body parts to the 12 houses.

hindi: भाव से रिलेटेड रिश्ते भी होते हैं।
says: Each house also has relationships tied to it (mother in the 4th, father in the 9th and so on).

hindi: चीजें भी होती हैं।
says: Each house also stands for things and objects, not only organs and people.
classical_check: Agrees: houses carry objects, for example vehicles in the 4th.

gist: Instructor echoes 'things also'.
Student asks: if a planet like Neptune damages one aspect of life, do the other aspects remain safe? (question only, answer follows in the next batch).

hindi: हां बिल्कुल रहेंगे।
says: Answer to the student's question: yes, when one planet damages one aspect of life, the other aspects of life remain safe (at least in the first instance).
ambiguity: Later sentences say the damage may spread to other aspects, so this is a first answer, not absolute.
classical_check: Agrees in general: a house is judged by its own lord and occupants, so damage to one bhava need not damage others.

hindi: अब चंदा मामा यहां पढ़ाई खराब कर दी अगर तो बाकी के मदर के साथ रिश्ता ठीक रहेगा।
says: If the Moon spoils education (the 5th house matter), the relationship with the mother, a different Moon matter, can stay fine.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the 5th changes with lagna and sign. A weak Moon sign spoils studies, a strong one helps them; the mother is the 4th house and Moon's own karakatwa, so she is judged separately.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; Moon is lagna lord debilitated in the 5th, studies and children get disturbed while the mother bond may remain.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Moon exalted lord of the 7th in the 5th, a contrast case where studies and romance are helped instead.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a gesture to the 5th house, read from the later 'पांचव घर' mention.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th house shows education and the Moon is the karaka of the mother, separately.

hindi: बहुत ज्यादा अच्छा करेगा।
says: The same Moon will do very good for the mother relationship, i.e. its damage in one area comes with extra goodness in another.

hindi: अब जैसे सूरज यहां खराब है तो ये खुद को आदमी आंकेगा नहीं।
says: If the Sun is spoiled here, the person will not value himself, so low self-worth.
cells_derived_method: Sun in lagna in different signs: debilitation in Libra gives the strongest low self-worth; own sign Leo gives pride instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra; debilitated Sun in lagna, doubt about self-worth.
Derived: lagna Aquarius; Sun in the lagna in an enemy sign, lord of the 7th, self-worth tied to partners.

ambiguity: 'यहां' a gesture; lagna is named in the next sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: weak Sun in the lagna lowers self-confidence.

hindi: लग्न में बैठा है।
says: The case being worked: the spoiled Sun sits in the lagna, the 1st house.
classical_check: Agrees as a setup of the example.

hindi: इसके सर पे चोट आएगी पत्नी लाजवाब मिलेगी।
says: With the afflicted Sun in the lagna, the head gets injured but the wife turns out to be excellent (the Sun in the 1st aspects the 7th).
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 1st aspects the 7th house, so the spouse's quality depends on the 7th sign; the head hurt is the lagna body part.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; Sun lord of the 2nd in lagna aspects the 7th Capricorn, a disciplined or older spouse.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Sun lord of the 9th in lagna aspects the 7th Gemini, a clever and communicative spouse.

ambiguity: A head injury is a medical/accident claim recorded as said.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun in the lagna aspects the 7th; classical texts usually say troubled marriage, not an excellent wife.

hindi: गवर्नमेंट सर्वेंट जॉब वाली लड़की मिल सकती है इसको या पति मिल सकता है।
says: The spouse may be in a government service job (a wife for a male native or a husband for a female native).
cells_derived_method: Sun is the government karaka; Sun's gaze on the 7th gives a spouse in public service; the sign of the 7th adds the type of service.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; exalted Sun in the lagna aspects the 7th Libra, spouse in administration, law or diplomacy.
Derived: lagna Taurus; Sun in lagna aspects the 7th Scorpio, spouse in police, defence or revenue service.

classical_check: Agrees that Sun aspecting the 7th can show a spouse in government work.

hindi: ऐसा अगर लड़की हुई तो यह यहां पर लाजवाब करेगा।
says: If the native is a girl, the same placement works wonderfully here (the husband side), so the result is especially good for a female chart.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is unclear: lagna or the 7th house.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give a separate gender-based result for this.

hindi: चंदा मामा यहां प्रॉपर्टी देता है।
says: The Moon in this position gives property.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the 4th in different signs: own sign Cancer gives the best property result; Saturn's Capricorn gives property with delay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Moon in its own sign in the 4th, house and land from mother and home comfort.
Derived: lagna Libra; Moon lord of the 10th in the 4th in Capricorn, property through career, with delay.

ambiguity: The 4th is named only in the next sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon in the 4th is a classical sign of property and comfort.

hindi: मान लो चौथे ही घर में बैठा है।
says: The example is set with the Moon in the 4th house.

hindi: प्रॉपर्टी एसेट जमीन जायदाद मां का प्रेम यहां
says: The 4th house stands for property, assets, land and inheritance, and mother's love.

hindi: बेरोजगार बेरोजगार उसी भाव में उसी भाव की अगर नीचता हो रही है जैसे सूर्य यहां नीचता कर देता है।
says: If that house is being debased, as the Sun debases it here, its matters (property, mother's love) stay 'unemployed', i.e. non-functioning.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled ('बेरोजगार' is read as 'idle, not working'); low reliability.

hindi: हां तो लाइफ के बाकी एस्पेक्ट अप कर देगा।
says: The rest of the life aspects will be lifted up by the same planet, though the afflicted house suffers.

hindi: उसी भाव के उसी भाव के लायक कुछ नहीं करेगा उस भाव का तो सत्यानाश करके बर्बाद कर दिया उसने।
says: The afflicted planet does nothing worthwhile for its own house and ruins that house completely.
classical_check: Overstates the classical idea that a malefic in a house spoils its signification.

hindi: पर पेमेंट एक एस्पेक्ट पे चली गई है।
says: The 'payment' (penalty, likely 'punishment') has gone onto one aspect only, so the damage is confined to that single life area.
ambiguity: 'पेमेंट' is probably a caption error for 'पनिशमेंट'.

hindi: सारा घर खा जाएगा वो।
says: The afflicted planet can eat up the whole household or the entire house matters, a warning against the previous 'confined' view.
ambiguity: Reads as the opposite of the previous sentence; 'घर' could be bhava or family.

gist: Student asks whether, if relationships are eaten up, the body organ will survive or be lost too.

hindi: बॉडी के ऑर्गन पे भी चोट मारेगा।
says: The afflicted planet will also strike the body organ tied to that house; the damage goes to relationships and the organ both. Medical claim recorded as said.
cells_derived_method: Each house's organ (head 1st, heart 4th, kidney or bladder 6th-7th) shows the target.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; afflicted Sun in the 4th gives chest and heart strain along with trouble to the mother.
Derived: lagna Libra; afflicted planet in the 7th gives urinary or kidney strain along with marriage trouble.

classical_check: Agrees in method: kala-purusha links each house to a body part.

gist: 'Good, it will strike there too' - echo of the previous answer.

hindi: यस 100% चोट मारेगा।
says: He gives it as certain: the organ also gets hit 100 percent; he states it without any condition.
ambiguity: '100%' is rhetorical; later he says remedies reduce the effect.
classical_check: Overclaims; classical texts do not give certainty.

gist: Praises the student's question as very good.

hindi: मान लो सूर्य यहां पर है पांचव घर के अंदर।
says: New example: the afflicted Sun sits in the 5th house.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 5th changes with the lagna: own sign Leo gives pride and children, debilitation in Libra gives weak intelligence and children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Sun in own sign in the 5th, its own house, a strong placement despite his rule.
Derived: lagna Gemini; Sun lord of the 3rd debilitated in the 5th, the case where his rule is strongest.
Derived: lagna Libra; Sun lord of the 11th in the 5th in Aquarius, gains and children are linked but strained.

classical_check: Classically Sun in the 5th is mixed: pride and trouble with children, but strong for politics.

hindi: तो इस बंदे को मान लो पहले किडनी स्टोन देगा।
says: For this person the Sun in the 5th first gives a kidney stone. Medical claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The link of the 5th house to kidney is not given; it comes from the earlier Sun-in-Libra rule.
classical_check: Silent; no classical link between the 5th house and the kidney.

hindi: उपाय नहीं किया।
says: If the person does not do the remedies, the damage runs on to the next stage, as the following sentences describe.

hindi: किडनी खा भी सकता है।
says: Without remedies the Sun can destroy the kidney. Medical claim recorded as said.

hindi: किडनी खाएगा उससे पहले इस बच्चे की पढ़ाई खराब करेगा।
says: Before reaching the kidney, the afflicted 5th-house Sun first spoils the child's education.
ambiguity: 'बच्चे' here may mean the native (a student) or the native's child.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th house shows education, and an afflicted 5th disturbs it.

hindi: फिर इसके बच्चे को जान से मार भी सकता है।
says: After that it can even take the life of the native's child. He says it as a possibility; recorded as his claim, not a prediction about anyone.
classical_check: Overstates: classical texts say loss or trouble to children, with other conditions.

gist: Student recalls: 'we said at some level otherwise it will kill the kidney'.
'Yes, it will kill' - confirmation of the student's recall.

hindi: तो इसलिए जिस लेवल पे उपाय कर लिए और एक्सेप्ट कर लिया वही प्लनेट शांत हो जाएगा।
says: The planet calms at whichever stage the person does the remedies and accepts the situation; the harm stops at that level.

hindi: धीरे धीरे धीरे खराबी खत्म।
says: After the remedy the fault ends slowly, step by step, not at once.

hindi: सात नंबर का सूर्य यहां आ गया।
says: New example: the Sun has come in number 7, the 7th house (marriage).
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 7th changes with lagna: Libra debilitation (lagna Aries) is the harshest; Aries exaltation (lagna Libra) is softer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; debilitated Sun lord of the 5th in the 7th, marriage and children strained.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Sun lord of the 9th in the 7th, partner linked to father and fortune.

ambiguity: As earlier, 7 may be house or sign; marriage results below point to the 7th house.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun in the 7th is bad for marriage.

hindi: तलाक कराएगा।
says: Sun in the 7th will bring a divorce.
cells_derived_method: Divorce risk is strongest with Sun debilitated in Libra and the 7th lord also afflicted; Sun in own or exalted sign softens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; debilitated Sun in the 7th, divorce risk is highest here.
Derived: lagna Libra; exalted Sun in the 7th, he would still call it divorce-prone but classical dignity softens it.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun in the 7th is among the classical causes of marital friction; 'will bring' is stronger than texts.

hindi: एक तलाक कराएगा दूसरा तलाक धीमा पड़ जाएगा।
says: The first divorce happens and the second one comes with less force, a progressive weakening with repeated events.

hindi: तीसरे में पत्नी को बीमार डाल देगा शायद या पति को बीमार डाल देगा।
says: In the third round the Sun may make the wife or husband ill (stated with 'perhaps'). Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: पति पत्नी दोनों ठीक है।
says: A further variant: both spouses are fine, so the damage must go elsewhere (children, as the next lines say).

hindi: बच्चे ही पैदा नहीं होने देगा।
says: If the spouses are well, the Sun may block the birth of children altogether.
classical_check: Silent for Sun in the 7th; Sun in the 5th is the classical child-denying placement.

hindi: बच्चे पैदा हो जाते हैं।
says: The other variant: children are born in spite of the Sun.

hindi: एक बच्चे को मार देगा, पंग कर देगा।
says: In that case it takes the life of one child or cripples one. Recorded as his claim only, not a prediction.
classical_check: Overstates; no classical basis for this specific outcome.

hindi: छोड़ेगा नहीं।
says: The Sun will not leave the person alone; some harm is certain without remedy.

hindi: न्यून होता जाएगा।
says: The effect keeps decreasing over time.

hindi: हल्का असर होता जाएगा।
says: Each repeated blow is milder; the planet's impact lightens from event to event.

hindi: ये इसकी बात जरूर आती है क्योंकि धीरे-धीरे ग्रह उम्र के साथ पक्का हो जाता है।
says: This lightening is said to happen because a planet gradually 'settles' (matures) with age.
ambiguity: 'पक्का' (firm, settled) is used loosely; not a ripening of results classically (dasha).
classical_check: Differs: classical texts tie results to dasha periods, not to age maturing.

gist: Rhetorical 'how does a planet become settled?'.

hindi: क्योंकि उम्र के साथ हम एक्सेप्ट कर लेते हैं।
says: The reason: with age we accept the planet's blows, and acceptance is what settles the planet.

hindi: पहली बार की चोट पे हम कहते हैं हाय क्या हुआ?
says: At the first blow from a planet we react with shock and complaint ('what happened?').

hindi: दूसरी पे हम कहते हैं चलो कोई बात नहीं ग्रह हल्का हो गया।
says: At the second blow we say 'never mind', and by that the planet becomes lighter.

hindi: अगर पहली पे किसी ने सीख लिया कहना ठीक है हो जाएगा हो जाएगा।
says: If someone learns to say 'it is fine, it will pass' right at the first blow, the planet's effect lightens from the beginning.

hindi: आप मजे की बात देखेंगे ह्यूमन कॉन्शियसनेस पहला चोट भी नहीं लगेगी।
says: With developed human consciousness even the first blow is not felt, so awareness can prevent the hit.

hindi: इसीलिए कहते हैं ह्यूमन कॉन्शियसनेस बहुत बड़ी चीज है।
says: Hence human consciousness is called a very big thing in his teaching.

gist: Says they have always held classes on human consciousness, by God's grace.

hindi: इसलिए वो सर्वोपरि है।
says: Consciousness is supreme, above any single planet's effect, so work on awareness first.

hindi: इसलिए कहते हैं क्षमा कर जान दे छोड़ परे देवता लगेगा देवता लगा ले माइंड में यार किसी गुरु को रख ले सियापा खत्म कर
says: So the advice is: forgive, let go, put a deity or a guru in your mind and end the drama; a mind-based remedy for planetary blows.
ambiguity: Caption wording is informal and partly garbled ('देवता लगेगा').

gist: Says this is a lesson in learning astrology: awareness and know-how have come.

hindi: लेकिन यदि आप पहली बार में कहते हैं अच्छा ठीक है कोई बात नहीं देखा जाएगा यही साक्षी भाव है आपका वो ग्रह काम ही नहीं करेगा
says: If at the first blow you say 'OK, it will be seen', that is the witness attitude (sakshi bhav) and the planet will not work at all on you.
classical_check: Silent; philosophical claim, not a classical rule.

hindi: आप अपनी मानसिकता से प्लनेट को प्लेस कर सकते हैं
says: One can place (decide) the planet's effect by one's own mindset; the mind determines how a planet behaves.

gist: Says this too is a class topic and will be covered.
'If the time has come, as God wills' - closing the digression.

hindi: ये सात नंबर का चंद्रमा है यहां पर तो ये चंद्रमा जब यहां आता है तो बहुत हिचकोले देता है और उठा देता है उस भाव को
says: Moon in number 7 (Neptune's seat) gives big swings and heaves, and lifts the house it sits in.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Libra or in the 7th takes its house by lagna: it lifts that house's matters with emotional swings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Moon lord of the 4th in the 7th in Libra, the home and mother matters swing through partnership.
Derived: lagna Libra; Moon lord of the 10th in the 7th in Aries, career fluctuates with partners.

ambiguity: House 7 versus sign 7 again; same ambiguity as the Sun rows.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon in the 7th is generally liked for marriage but makes the mind changeable.

hindi: बहुत सुंदर समुद्र द्रु को उठाता है।
says: The Moon lifts the sea water very beautifully, as it raises tides (caption 'द्रु' read as 'जल').
ambiguity: Garbled word 'समुद्र द्रु'.
classical_check: Agrees with the tidal control by the Moon.

hindi: समुद्र में खूब लहरें देता है।
says: The Moon creates many waves in the sea, which in life means emotional movement and variety.

hindi: समुद्र में सौंदर्य बनाता है।
says: The Moon makes beauty on the sea, which is the aesthetic uplift of Moon in Neptune's domain.

hindi: आप रात के समय देखेंगे चंदा मामा कितना खूबसूरत है।
says: At night the Moon is very beautiful, which he uses as a picture of the Moon's beautifying power.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is a karaka of beauty.

gist: Fragment 'it is setting'.

hindi: सूरज कितना ज्यादा खूबसूरत है।
says: The Sun is very beautiful to look at in the evening, used as a picture of its softer, beautifying face.

hindi: जब ताकत छोड़ चुका है।
says: This beauty comes when the Sun has given up its strength, i.e. a weakened Sun turns gentle and charming.

gist: Fragment: 'it is getting ready to go'.
Fragment: 'it is getting ready to come here'.

hindi: तो ये बहुत मनोरम बनाता है।
says: This Moon-and-Sun-at-dusk setting makes things very charming, so the Moon in Neptune's seat gives a charming, romantic quality.

hindi: जहां भी चंद्रमा कुंडली में बैठा होगा उस भाव को उठा देगा।
says: Wherever the Moon sits in the chart it lifts that house, improving its matters.
cells_derived_method: The lifted matter is the topic of the Moon's house; a stronger sign gives more lift.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn; exalted Moon in the 5th lifts intellect, romance and children.
Derived: lagna Virgo; Moon in own sign in the 11th lifts gains and friends.
Derived: lagna Gemini; Moon in own sign in the 2nd lifts family, speech and savings.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon aids the houses it occupies; for waning or afflicted Moon this is not true.

gist: Exclamation 'superb'.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया तो बहुत ही सुंदर पति या सुंदर पत्नी मिलेगी।
says: If the Moon sits in the 7th it gives a very beautiful husband or wife.
cells_derived_method: Moon's sign in the 7th shifts the type of beauty: own sign Cancer gives a nurturing spouse, exalted Taurus gives a graceful one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn; Moon in its own sign in the 7th, lord of the 7th itself, a caring and attractive spouse.
Derived: lagna Scorpio; exalted Moon in the 7th, lord of the 9th, a gracious and fortunate partner.

ambiguity: 'यहां' means the 7th, from the sentence that follows.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon in the 7th is classically a sign of an attractive spouse.

gist: Exclamation 'the number 7 does wonders'.

hindi: इसलिए वरुण देवता के घर जब चंद्रमा आते हैं।
says: When the Moon enters Varuna's (Neptune's) house, Libra, the following good results are expected.
classical_check: Silent for Neptune; the Moon in Libra is a neutral sign classically.

hindi: लाजवाब फल क्योंकि जल देवता है ये।
says: The results are excellent because the Moon is the water deity in the sea god's house, so water meets water.
classical_check: Differs: Libra is an air sign, so 'water meets water' is his scheme, not a classical fact.

hindi: चंद्रमा जल को मूवमेंट देता है, कंट्रोल करता है, स्टेबलाइज करता है या खराब करता है
says: The Moon gives movement to water, controls it, stabilises it or spoils it; the Moon governs all water behaviour.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon rules water and tides.

hindi: और वरुण देवता के पास जल ही जल है।
says: Varuna has nothing but water, so in his seat the Moon has the full field to act in.

hindi: तो सारे चंद्रमा की मूवमेंट चंद्रमा के पास कल्पना शक्ति है।
says: All of the Moon's movement gives it imagination power (kalpana shakti); Moon in Neptune's seat is highly imaginative.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled at the start.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the karaka of imagination and mind.

gist: Repeats that Varuna is the sea with no end.

hindi: इसलिए इसकी अंधाधुंध अंधाधुंध शक्ति है इसकी।
says: Because the sea is endless, Neptune carries limitless, unrestrained power.

hindi: अनंत इसकी कल्पना शक्ति है।
says: Neptune's imagination is infinite.

hindi: आर्टिस्ट है।
says: Neptune is the artist planet.
classical_check: Silent for Neptune; classical artist karaka is Venus.

hindi: फिल्मों के अंदर शुक्र का बहुत बड़ा वाला पापा है ये।
says: In the film world Neptune is the big father of Venus; cinema belongs to Neptune and Venus together, with Neptune the larger force.
classical_check: Differs: classical films and arts belong to Venus; Neptune as larger is a modern view.

hindi: शुक्र जो राग रंग महफिल देता है यह उसको बहुत वाइल्ड कर देता है यह और आनंद बढ़ाता है।
says: Neptune takes Venus's music, colour and party life and makes it very wild, increasing enjoyment.

hindi: हृदय के केंद्र पर शुक्र और वरुण दो देवता बैठे हैं।
says: At the centre of the heart two deities sit, Venus and Neptune.
ambiguity: Earlier the Sun was placed at the heart chakra; here it is Venus and Neptune.
classical_check: Differs: the heart is a Sun matter classically (Venus has the lower chakras in some schemes).

hindi: शुक्र के पास मृत संजीवनी है और वरुण देवता के पास कृपा है।
says: Venus holds the Mrita Sanjivani (power to revive the dead) and Varuna holds grace (kripa).
classical_check: Agrees for Venus: Shukracharya is known for Mrita Sanjivani vidya.

hindi: तो दिल की कृपा चलती रहे तो सब सही है।
says: As long as the grace in the heart keeps flowing, everything is right; the heart's health follows Neptune's grace.

gist: 'The Moon is done' - moves on to the next planet.

hindi: मंगल जब सात नंबर का हो जाता है तो आप यह मान के चलें कि एक आग गरमा गरम आग का गोला है उसको उठा के आपने समुद्र में डाल दिया तो क्या होगा
says: Mars in number 7: picture a red-hot fireball thrown into the sea; this is the analogy for Mars in Neptune's seat, a hot planet in cold water.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 7th or Libra changes with lagna, giving the lordships it brings into the partnership area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Mars lord of the 1st and 8th in the 7th in Libra, aggression and sudden events through partners.
Derived: lagna Libra; Mars in own sign in the 7th, lord of the 2nd and 7th, a forceful partner and business.
Derived: lagna Cancer; exalted Mars in the 7th, lord of the 5th and 10th, a powerful partner and career through partnerships.

ambiguity: House 7 versus sign 7; sentences after speak of the sign (sea) and later of the 10th aspect (house).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars in the 7th is Mangal dosha placement.

hindi: वो वहां पर उसको तीव्रता से फूंक डालेगा और गर्म कर देगा यानी समुद्र में गर्मी लेकर के आ जाएगा
says: The fireball burns the sea fiercely and heats it, so Mars brings heat and intensity into Neptune's domain.

hindi: लेकिन धीरे-धीरे उसका अपना अस्तित्व समाप्त हो जाता है
says: But slowly the fireball's own existence finishes in the water, so Mars loses its own identity in Neptune's seat.

hindi: अपना आग उसकी समाप्त हो जाएगी
says: Its own fire will end, the second statement of Mars losing force over time in the water.

hindi: तो मंगल देवता जब यहां आते हैं तो जिस खाने में ये बैठ जाते हैं वहां का अस्तित्व तो धीरे धीरे धीरे डाउन हो जाता है।
says: When Mars comes here, the house in which it sits slowly goes down; the matters of that house decline.
cells_derived_method: Take the house where Mars sits in Libra and apply gradual decline to its topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo; Mars lord of the 3rd and 8th in the 2nd in Libra, family and savings decline slowly.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Mars lord of the 4th and 11th in the 10th in Libra, career status erodes slowly.

hindi: लेकिन इसकी सबसे बड़ी खासियत है आग नष्ट तो होती नहीं।
says: But the biggest speciality of Mars is that fire is never really destroyed, so Mars survives even in the sea.

hindi: इसको हम हनुमान जी से जोड़ के चलते हैं कि हनुमान जी थे जो थे इतने समझदार इतने चालाक या बुद्धिमान जैसा शब्द कहे कि वो समुद्र के से द्वारा भी रास्ता मांग लेते हैं।
says: Mars is linked with Hanuman, who was so wise that he could ask the sea itself for a path.
classical_check: Agrees: Hanuman is the traditional deity of Mars.

hindi: एक छलांग में उसको कवर अप कर जाते हैं।
says: Hanuman covers the sea in a single leap; Mars in Neptune's seat can cross a huge obstacle in one jump.

hindi: तो इसकी सबसे बड़ी पॉजिटिविटी ये बन जाती है कि मंगल की 10 नंबर के ऊपर दृष्टि हो चुकी होती है।
says: The biggest positive of Mars in number 7 is that its aspect already falls on the 10th (Mars's 4th aspect from the 7th).
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 7th aspects the 10th by its 4th aspect; the 10th sign and lordships decide the career flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; the 10th is Capricorn, where this planet is at its strongest, so career drive is strong.
Derived: lagna Libra; the 10th is Cancer, where this planet is at its weakest, so career has friction.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from itself, so the 10th from the 7th is the 4th aspect.

hindi: चौथी दृष्टि तो ये अकल्ट साइंसेस दे देता है।
says: The 4th-aspect to the 10th gives occult sciences, in his scheme.
ambiguity: The aspect given is the 4th from the 7th, i.e. the 10th house.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not link Mars's aspect to occult sciences.

hindi: यानी मंगल जो है हर चीज में आग लगा देता है।
says: Mars sets fire to everything it touches, meaning it intensifies whatever it is placed with.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Mars as a fiery, intensifying planet.

hindi: अगर कोई सुंदर है तो बहुत सुंदर मकान लेना है तो बहुत बड़ा बंगला गाड़ी लेगा तो बहुत बड़ी करा देगा
says: Mars scales things up: a good-looking person becomes very beautiful, a house becomes a huge bungalow and a car becomes a very big one.

hindi: यानी कि आप छोटी सी गोली बंदूक की गोली को अगर शुक्र मानेंगे तो पूरी मिसाइल जो है वो मंगल बन गई
says: If a small bullet is taken as Venus, the full missile is what Mars makes of it; Mars magnifies Venus's thing into something huge.

hindi: मंगल ने पूरा मिसाइल बना डाली शुक्र और मंगल के कॉम्बिनेशन से
says: The whole missile is made by the combination of Venus and Mars; the Venus-Mars pair gives the large-scale result.
classical_check: Silent; Venus-Mars conjunction is classically passion and desire.

hindi: इसमें शुक्र जरूर आएगा ऐसी स्थिति
says: Venus will certainly come into this situation, as Libra is Venus's sign, so Mars in Libra always works with Venus.
classical_check: Agrees: Libra is ruled by Venus.

hindi: तो ये मंगल क्या करता है यह और बड़ा सबमरीन और बड़ा युद्धपोत या समुद्र की बात हो रही है समुद्र संबंधित और बड़ा करा देता है ज्यादा बड़ी ताकत बनाता है
says: Mars in the sea seat makes bigger submarines and warships and enlarges anything related to the sea, building greater power.

hindi: और ये बर्न करता है इसको बड़ी जबरदस्त तरीके से और मंगल इसको अग्नि देकर के जला के वापस जिंदा करता है।
says: Mars burns the sea powerfully and then revives it through fire; the burning is a rebirth.

gist: Rhetorical 'what happens by burning water?'.

hindi: शुद्ध होता है।
says: Burning the water purifies it, meaning Mars's fire cleanses what it touches in Neptune's domain.

gist: Medical analogy: when a person's heartbeat stops, what do they do?
Doctors take an electric current.
They place the paddles on the chest.

hindi: करंट मार के जिंदा करते हैं।
says: They revive with an electric shock, which he uses as the picture of Mars as the life-restarting shock.
ambiguity: The medical procedure is an analogy, not advice.

hindi: तो समुद्र के अंदर हरकत के लिए मंगल कार्य करता है।
says: Within the sea, Mars is the one that brings motion, stirring Neptune's still water.

hindi: मंगल अग्नि है।
says: Mars is fire itself, the agni element of the planets.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is of fire tattva.

hindi: मंगल घर्षण है।
says: Mars is friction, the force that generates movement and heat by rubbing.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the karaka of conflict and energy; friction is his way of putting it.

hindi: ये मंगल बहुत पॉजिटिव इफेक्ट्स देता है।
says: Mars gives many positive effects in general.

hindi: लेकिन समुद्र के लिए ये नेगेटिव है।
says: But for the sea (Neptune's matters) Mars is negative, since fire and water oppose.

hindi: तो सात नंबर का मंगल जहां पर भी बैठा होगा वहां पर मूवमेंट बहुत ज्यादा सुंदर करेगा।
says: Mars in number 7, wherever it sits, makes the movement in that house very good, so the house's affairs become active.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Libra in any house energises that house; the lordships it holds for that lagna add flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra; Mars lord of the 2nd and 7th in lagna in Libra, active personality, drive in money and partnerships.
Derived: lagna Cancer; Mars lord of the 5th and 10th in the 4th in Libra, movement in home, property and mother matters.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Mars lord of the 4th and 11th in the 10th in Libra, active career and gains.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर का ... जहां भी बैठा' suggests sign number 7 in any house.

hindi: बुद्ध सात नंबर का हवा का समुद्र से लेनदेन हिसाब किताब ही नहीं है।
says: Mercury (air) in number 7 has no dealing or accounts with the sea; air and sea do not interact in his picture.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Libra by house: it lords different houses and acts apart from Neptune's themes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius; Mercury lord of the 5th and 8th in the 9th in Libra, mind and learning keep their own track.
Derived: lagna Libra; Mercury lord of the 9th and 12th in lagna in Libra, thinking is independent of the dreamy Neptune side.

classical_check: Differs: Mercury in Libra, a friend's sign, is treated as comfortable classically.

hindi: हवा अलग ही चलेगी।
says: The air will run on its own, meaning Mercury keeps its independent line.
