hindi: समुद्र अलग ही चलेगा।
says: The sea will go its own way, so Neptune's matters are unaffected by Mercury in his seat.

hindi: नेप्च्यून ग्रह के ऊपर के यह जानकारी ली गई है कि नेप्च्यून के ऊपर तूफान जो आते हैं वो हवा के आते हैं।
says: Information taken about the planet Neptune: the storms on Neptune are wind storms, used to link Neptune with air.
classical_check: Not astrological: planetary science supports strong winds on Neptune.

hindi: तो पूरे के पूरे सोलर सिस्टम में दो2000 कि.मी. की स्पीड से हवा चलती है और ये
says: In the whole solar system the winds on Neptune are the fastest, about 2000 km/h; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
ambiguity: Caption number '2000' is garbled as 'दो2000'; the sentence ends with 'और ये' and continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Not astrological; consistent with observed wind speeds of about 2000 km/h.

gist: Tail of the previous slice's sentence ('...runs in reverse'); the full statement is given in the next sentence.

hindi: तो जब सात नंबर का बुध होता है उस व्यक्ति की बुद्धि उल्टी चलती है।
says: When Mercury is in number 7 (Libra, Neptune's sign) the person's intellect runs backwards, thinking in a twisted way.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Libra takes its house by lagna; the houses it lords decide which area (communication, work, learning) shows the twisted thinking.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo; Mercury lord of the 2nd and 11th in the 3rd in Libra, perverse thinking shows in speech, savings and gains.
Derived: lagna Aries; Mercury lord of the 3rd and 6th in the 7th in Libra, devious dealing in partnerships and disputes.
Derived: lagna Scorpio; Mercury lord of the 8th and 11th in the 12th in Libra, hidden scheming and losses.

ambiguity: A few rows later 6 and 8 are used as sign numbers, so 7 here is the sign Libra.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury in Libra (a friend's sign) is not a bad placement.

hindi: वो कपट भी कर सकता है।
says: Mercury in Libra can make the person deceitful and cunning.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not call Mercury in Libra deceitful.

hindi: जबरदस्त तरीके से धोखा कर सकता है।
says: He can cheat on a big scale, i.e. large frauds, not small tricks.

hindi: ढोंग कर सकता है।
says: He can put on an act and pose as something he is not (hypocrisy).

hindi: झूठ बोलने में उस्ताद हो सकता है।
says: He can become a master at lying.

hindi: चोरी कर सकता है।
says: He can commit theft.
ambiguity: A tendency claim only, not a verdict on any person.
classical_check: Agrees in general: Mercury is a classical karaka of thieves and tricksters when afflicted.

hindi: खराबी कर सकता है।
says: He can do mischief and spoil things for others.

hindi: नेगेटिविटीज ला सकता है।
says: He can bring negativity into the lives of those around him.

hindi: किसी भी दूसरे व्यक्ति के लाइफ में दूसरे को भड़का करके क्योंकि बोलने में बहुत कमाल होता है बुद्ध।
says: He does this by provoking others in their lives, which works because Mercury is very skilled at talking.

hindi: बुद्ध के पास सारी हमारी वाणी है।
says: All of our speech (vani) belongs to Mercury.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the karaka of speech.

hindi: गजब तरीके से बोलता है।
says: Mercury in Libra speaks in a striking, persuasive manner.

hindi: और सबसे बड़ी बात नपुंसकता।
says: The biggest point about Mercury in Libra is impotence (napunsakta), which he uses as 'inability to deliver'.
ambiguity: Used figuratively next ('only talk, no action'), though the literal word is also a medical term; recorded as said.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury is classically a neuter planet, but no text says Mercury in Libra gives impotence.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति यानी करना धरना कुछ नहीं बातें मार रहे हैं बड़ी-बड़ी।
says: This state means doing nothing and only talking big, so big talk with no results.

hindi: तो जहां बैठा हुआ है वहां के हिस्से को एक प्रकार से नपुंसकता प्रदान कर देता है।
says: Whichever part of life the Mercury sits in, it gives that part a kind of impotence, i.e. the house's matters bear no fruit.
cells_derived_method: Take the house where Mercury sits in Libra and make its matters fruitless: 2nd money, 5th children, 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini; Mercury lagna lord in the 5th in Libra, intelligence and children's matters have talk without result.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Mercury lord of the 6th and 9th in the 10th in Libra, work and fortune stay unproductive.

hindi: ये प्राप्ति जैसी चीज कोई खास नहीं देके चलता।
says: It does not give anything special by way of gains (prapti); little is attained.

hindi: छह ही नंबर में होता लाजवाब करता।
says: If Mercury were in number 6 (Virgo, its own and exalted sign) it would do wonders.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Virgo is strong in every house; the house it falls in shows where it excels.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Mercury in the 6th in Virgo, lord of the 3rd and 6th, skilled in service, analysis and competition.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Mercury in the 10th in Virgo, lord of the 7th and 10th, excellent business and communication career.

ambiguity: '6 नंबर' read as the sign; the next sentence uses 8 for Scorpio.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is exalted and in own sign in Virgo.

hindi: आठ नंबर होता मंगल के साथ घर्षण कमाल।
says: If Mercury were in number 8 (Scorpio, Mars's sign) its friction with Mars would be excellent, giving energy and sharpness.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Scorpio in different houses shows where the sharp, probing intellect is used.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Mercury in the 8th in Scorpio, research, occult and investigation skills.
Derived: lagna Virgo; Mercury lagna lord in the 3rd in Scorpio, sharp and bold communication.

classical_check: Differs: Mercury and Mars are not friends classically, so friction is his reading.

hindi: लेकिन सात नंबर बीच में आ जाता है।
says: But number 7 (Libra) sits between 6 and 8, i.e. between the two good signs for Mercury and takes the worst result.

hindi: लगभग लगभग ओके।
says: Mercury in Libra is almost okay, so its harm is moderate and not total.
ambiguity: Contradicts the strong negatives just listed; may refer to the Virgo and Scorpio neighbours.
classical_check: Agrees with classical neutrality of Mercury in Libra.

hindi: इसको अब यूं कनेक्ट कर सकते हैं जहां सूर्य अच्छा नहीं होगा वहां बुध भी खास अच्छा नहीं होगा क्योंकि सूर्य बुध लगभग साथ रहते हैं।
says: Link the two: where the Sun is not good, Mercury also will not be very good, because Sun and Mercury almost always stay together.
classical_check: Agrees on the fact that Mercury is never more than about 28 degrees from the Sun; the weakness link is his reading.

gist: Rhetorical 'who is Mercury?'.

hindi: बहन, बुआ, साली, बेटी, बकरी जैसी जानवर और चीजें आपकी नपुंसक चीजें, छोटी कन्याएं ये सारे के सारे बुध हैं।
says: Mercury signifies sister, father's sister, wife's sister, daughter, goat-like animals, neuter things and small girls.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury is the karaka of sisters, maternal aunt and young girls; goat is a Mercury animal in some lists.

hindi: तो ऐसी स्थिति में उनके द्वारा आपका रिलेशनशिप खराब होगा।
says: With Mercury in Libra, your relationship with those Mercury people (sister, aunt, daughter, sister-in-law) will go bad through them.
classical_check: Partly agrees: afflicted Mercury hurts relations with sisters and young female relatives.

hindi: अगर ये मान लो शत्रु स्थान में बैठ गया है तो ऐसी ही स्थिति में बहन, बुआ, बेटी, साली इत्यादि के साथ आपके रिलेशनशिप को खराब कर देगा।
says: If the Mercury sits in an enemy house the same relation damage with sister, aunt, daughter and sister-in-law is repeated and made worse.
cells_derived_method: Enemy placement for Mercury means signs of planets inimical to it; the house gives the type of relative.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius; Mercury lord of the 5th and 8th in the 6th in Cancer (an enemy sign), relations with sisters and daughters are marked by disputes and illness.
Derived: lagna Gemini; Mercury lagna lord in the 2nd in Cancer (an enemy sign), family speech and ties with female relatives are strained.

ambiguity: 'शत्रु स्थान' is not defined: enemy sign or dusthana is possible.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury in an enemy sign gives troubled relations with female relatives.

hindi: कोर्ट कचहरी के अंदर आपको बहुत ज्यादा झंझट और दिक्कतें दे देगा।
says: Mercury in Libra gives a lot of trouble in court and legal cases.

hindi: आपके कैश बैलेंस की स्थिति बहुत ज्यादा खराब कर देगा।
says: Mercury in Libra badly worsens the cash balance and money in hand.
ambiguity: This is a general finance tendency, not investment advice.

hindi: बीमारी डालेगा और बीमारी ठीक नहीं होने देगा किसी भी हालत के अंदर।
says: It brings illness and does not let it be cured under any circumstances. A health tendency recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: तो जहां यह बैठा है बुध सात नंबर नॉट वेरी गुड।
says: Summary: Mercury in number 7 is not very good wherever it sits.
classical_check: Differs from the neutral classical result.

gist: 'OK OK' - closing the Mercury case.

hindi: बृहस्पति जब वरुण देवता के घर आते हैं।
says: Next case: Jupiter coming into Varuna's (Neptune's) house, Libra.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Libra takes lordships by lagna and acts as the guru in the sea house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; Jupiter lord of the 6th and 9th in the 4th in Libra, wisdom and duty shape home and mother matters.
Derived: lagna Libra; Jupiter lord of the 3rd and 6th in lagna, restraint in the personality.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Jupiter lord of the 3rd and 12th in the 10th, guiding role in career with losses of effort.

classical_check: Silent for Neptune; Jupiter in Libra, an enemy sign, is mixed classically.

gist: 'Jupiter is number 7' - restates that Jupiter is in Libra.
'The guru has come to Varuna's house.'
Rhetorical 'what is Varuna's work?'.

hindi: हिचकोले मारना।
says: Varuna's work is to heave and swing things; Neptune creates unsettling movement.

hindi: कुछ भी बांट रहे हैं दे रहे।
says: Neptune is giving and distributing anything and everything, without a filter.

gist: Rhetorical 'what is Jupiter's work?'.

hindi: ग्रेबर पकड़ लिया।
says: Jupiter grabs him by the collar (caption 'ग्रेबर' read as 'गिरेबान'); Jupiter's work is to restrain and discipline.
ambiguity: Garbled word.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter is the planet of discipline and dharma.

gist: Jupiter's quoted words: 'hey, where are you going?'.
Jupiter's quoted words: 'what are you doing?'.

hindi: तमीज से चलो।
says: Jupiter demands proper manners and conduct, a correct way of behaving.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter as upholder of dharma.

hindi: एक घेरा बनाओ।
says: Jupiter says draw a boundary or circle: it sets limits on the formless sea.

hindi: नियम बनाओ।
says: Jupiter says make rules; he stands for law and regulation.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter signifies law and codes.

hindi: सिस्टम से चलो।
says: Jupiter says follow the system; he insists on orderly procedure.

hindi: तो मैं सबको पकड़ के चलूंगा।
says: Jupiter's stance: 'I will hold everyone and move together', the binding, collective role.

hindi: हमारे सोलर सिस्टम के अंदर बृहस्पति ने सबको बांधा हुआ है।
says: In our solar system Jupiter has bound everyone together, his astronomical image for binding power.
classical_check: Silent; astronomy used as an analogy (Jupiter's mass does shape the system).

hindi: सूर्य घसीट कर ले जा रहा है और बृहस्पति अकेला ग्रह जो कह रहा है बंधो।
says: The Sun is dragging everything along while Jupiter is the only planet calling out 'stay bound'.

hindi: पीछे वाले मेरे साथ-साथ बंधो।
says: Jupiter calls to the planets behind him to stay bound together with him.

hindi: तो शनि यूरेनस, नेप्च्यून, प्लूटो, इंद्र, वरुण ये चारों ग्रह बृहस्पति को पीछे धकेल रहे
says: The outer planets (Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, with Indra and Varuna as the names of Uranus and Neptune) are pushing Jupiter backwards.
ambiguity: He says 'four planets' but names six names; Indra=Uranus and Varuna=Neptune, so the four are Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto.

hindi: के इधर को आ हमारे साथ और बृहस्पति को सूर्य अपनी ओर धकेल रहा है।
says: The outer planets say 'come to our side' while the Sun pushes Jupiter toward himself, so Jupiter is pulled in two directions.

gist: Refers to a diagram: the planets just before Jupiter, such as Mars, will fit in it.
Gesture sentence: 'they will come here with us' pointing at the diagram.

hindi: यहां पर हमारा बृहस्पति को यह सारे नीचे पीछे की ओर खींच रहे हैं।
says: In the picture all the inner planets drag Jupiter down and backward.
ambiguity: Depends on a diagram not visible in the text.

gist: 'पूछ है छोटी सी पीछे खींच रहे हैं' - garbled, perhaps 'the tail is small, they pull it back'.

hindi: इधर को आ रहा और बृहस्पति को सूर्य आगे खींच रहा है कि अंदर घुसा लूंगा।
says: The Sun in front is pulling Jupiter forward, saying 'I will take you inside myself'.

gist: Rhetorical 'what is the Sun's real aim?'.

hindi: धरती को खा जाऊं।
says: The Sun's real aim, in his picture, is to swallow the earth.

hindi: अब धरती को ये पीछे खींच रहा है।
says: Jupiter holds the earth back from the Sun's pull, protecting it.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter as protector.

gist: 'Jupiter says let me pull the earth back' - repeats the previous.

hindi: अगर बृहस्पति को ये तीनों के तीनों पीछे ना खींचे तो बृहस्पति, पृथ्वी, मंगल, शुक्र सारे सूर्य निकल लेगा।
says: If the others did not pull Jupiter back, the Sun would swallow Jupiter, Earth, Mars and Venus alike.
ambiguity: Wording about 'three' pullers is unclear.

hindi: क्योंकि सूर्य इतना ज्यादा बड़ा और इतना पावरफुल है कह रहा है घसीट के चलूंगा।
says: The Sun is so big and powerful that it says it will drag everything along with it.

gist: 'Think of it across all of space.'
Repeats the quip that nobody knows where the Sun is taking us.
Rhetorical 'where does it actually go?'.

hindi: महासूर्य की ओर ले जा रहा है।
says: The Sun is taking us toward the Great Sun (Maha Surya).

hindi: हमारे अंतरिक्ष हमारे सौरमंडल के हमारे सौरमंडल जैसे बहुत सौरमंडल है और हमारे मिल्की वे गैलेक्सी के अंदर एक महा सूर्य है।
says: There are many solar systems like ours, and inside our Milky Way galaxy there is one Great Sun.
ambiguity: A galactic centre is not a star like the Sun; he is speaking figuratively.

hindi: वहां पर ये जा रहा है।
says: Our Sun is travelling toward that Great Sun.

hindi: तो ये बृहस्पति जो है इसने संभाल के रखा।
says: Jupiter has kept things in hand throughout, holding the system steady.
classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter as the protector.

hindi: अब इतना ताकतवर है बृहस्पति।
says: Jupiter is that powerful, a strong planet in the scheme.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the greatest benefic.

hindi: जब ये नेप्च्यून के घर आता है तो कहता है बांध दूंगा, पकड़ दूंगा, सेट करूंगा।
says: When Jupiter comes into Neptune's house, it says it will tie, hold and set everything in order; it disciplines the endless sea.

hindi: तो शांति ले आता है।
says: As a result it brings peace; Jupiter in Libra calms the restless Neptune side.

hindi: परम ज्ञानी बनाता है।
says: Jupiter in Libra makes the person supremely wise.

hindi: जबरदस्त तरीके की बंदे में इंट्यूशन आ जाती है।
says: It brings strong intuition into the person.

gist: 'Very impressive' - exclamation.
Lead-in: 'but Jupiter has one main issue'.

hindi: वो किसी की चलने नहीं देता।
says: Jupiter does not let anyone's will run; he overrides other people's plans with his own order.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति बिना ज्ञान के कोई व्यक्ति होगा तो उसके नेप्च्यून की राशि में आने के बाद उसकी ऐसी तैसी फेर देगा।
says: For a person without knowledge, Jupiter in Neptune's sign will turn his life upside down, with the result that his wisdom-lacking ways are broken.

hindi: उसकी चलने नहीं देगा।
says: His own will will not be allowed to run; he is blocked in whatever he wants to do.

hindi: किसी भी हालत में क्योंकि बृहस्पति के एक बहुत नेगेटिव फॉल्ट होगा कि जहां बैठा है वहां से इसकी पांचवी दृष्टि 11 नंबर पर आ गई।
says: The reason is a negative fault of Jupiter in Libra: from Libra its 5th aspect falls on number 11, Aquarius.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's 5th aspect from Libra lands on Aquarius; which house that is depends on where Libra falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; Jupiter in the 4th in Libra aspects the 8th house, Aquarius.
Derived: lagna Libra; Jupiter in lagna aspects the 5th house, Aquarius.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Jupiter in the 10th aspects the 2nd house, Aquarius.

ambiguity: '11 नंबर' is the sign Aquarius, since 5th from Libra (7) is 11.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th from itself.

hindi: नौवीं दृष्टि तीन नंबर पर आ गई।
says: Its 9th aspect from Libra falls on number 3, Gemini.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's 9th aspect from Libra lands on Gemini; the house varies by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; Jupiter in the 4th aspects the 12th house, Gemini.
Derived: lagna Libra; Jupiter in lagna aspects the 9th house, Gemini.

hindi: दोनों जगह खराब है तो बृहस्पति इसकी शक्ति को क्षीण कर देगा।
says: Both places hit are bad for Jupiter, so it will thin out the power of whatever it aspects there.
ambiguity: 'इसकी' (its) is unclear: the aspected places or the person's strength.
classical_check: Differs: Jupiter's aspect is normally protective, not weakening.

hindi: यानी बृहस्पति अगर बहुत दारूबाज आदमी है बहुत थोड़ी पिएगा।
says: A heavy drinker with this Jupiter will drink very little; Jupiter curbs the habit. Recorded as his claim about intoxication, not advice.

hindi: अगर बहुत ज्ञान का आदमी है ज्यादा ज्ञान बता नहीं पाएगा।
says: A man of great knowledge will not be able to express much of it.

hindi: बहुत जबरदस्त तरीके से मौज मस्ती वाला आदमी उसकी मौज मस्ती को कट कर देगा।
says: A very pleasure-loving person will have his fun cut down by it.

hindi: तो ये इतनी ताकत घटा देगा कि व्यक्ति कुछ कर नहीं सकता कह नहीं सकता।
says: It reduces power so much that the person can neither do nor say anything; an overall suppression of the person's strong traits.

hindi: क्योंकि बिल्कुल साथ में शुक्र पड़ा है।
says: Because Venus lies right alongside, Libra being Venus's sign; Jupiter is in its enemy's house.
ambiguity: 'Alongside' may mean Venus is the sign lord of the Libra seat.
classical_check: Agrees: Libra is Venus's sign and Venus is Jupiter's enemy.

hindi: तो ये शुक्र के साथ बृहस्पति की कोई मित्रता नहीं है।
says: Jupiter has no friendship with Venus.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is Jupiter's natural enemy.

hindi: शुक्र उसके साथ शत्रुता रखता है।
says: Venus keeps enmity toward Jupiter.
classical_check: Differs: in Parashari tables Venus treats Jupiter as neutral, though Jupiter treats Venus as an enemy.

hindi: लेकिन बृहस्पति मित्रता नहीं रखता उसके साथ।
says: Jupiter, however, keeps no friendship in return; it is neither friend nor open foe.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is not friendly to Venus.

hindi: बृहस्पति कहीं बैठा होता है।
says: Introduces a general rule on what Jupiter does wherever it sits.
ambiguity: Fragment; the claim is in the next sentences.

hindi: दो लोगों के अंदर शत्रुता समाप्त करा देता है।
says: Jupiter ends the enmity between two people.

hindi: लड़ाई बंद कराता है।

says: You cannot do anything with a head alone, so the person is powerless to act on his visions.

hindi: आप देख रहे हैं दूर तक कहां तक इल्लुजन क्रिएट होगी।
says: You look far and far, and illusion is created; Rahu in Libra generates illusion the farther one looks.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is the planet of illusion (maya).

hindi: पता नहीं चलेगा।
says: The person will not be able to tell where the illusion ends, i.e. real and unreal cannot be separated.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति ड्रग एडिक्ट हो सकते हैं।
says: Such people (Rahu in Libra) can become drug addicts; a tendency claim only, not a verdict on anyone.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is the classical karaka of intoxicants and drugs.

hindi: दारूबाज हो सकते हैं।
says: They can also become heavy drinkers.
ambiguity: A tendency claim only.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is linked to alcohol.

hindi: उनको विज़न एंडलेस जाती है।
says: Their vision goes on endlessly, a stream of visions without a stopping point.

gist: Rhetorical 'what is the biggest point?'.

hindi: हो सकता है वो दारू पी के ज्ञान बांटे।
says: He may drink and then give out wisdom, i.e. his best insights arrive under intoxication.

gist: 'You will have seen many such people.'
Anecdote: the moment a drinking party starts the person's wisdom starts.
Anecdote: they say wonderful things from who knows where.

hindi: ऐसे लोग जब जब इनका सिर सिर चलता है आईसीयू के सारे पेशेंट होते हैं।
says: Such head-only people are like ICU patients: the head keeps working while the body lies idle.
ambiguity: An analogy, not a health claim.

hindi: धड़ नहीं है उनके पास।
says: They have no body in the sense of working capacity; only the head part is active.

hindi: धड़ है पड़ा हुआ है बेड पे कुछ नहीं कर रहा तो ये चल रहा है।
says: The body lies on the bed doing nothing while the head runs; the analogy with a bedridden thinker.

hindi: ये सारे के सारे ज्ञानी है।
says: All these head-only people are wise ones, so Rahu in Libra produces thinkers.

hindi: यानी कि व्यसन करने के पश्चात मार खाने के बाद बेबस होने के बाद पिटने के बाद उनके जीवन में उनको ज्ञान आ जाता है।
says: Wisdom comes to them only after addiction, beatings and helplessness, so the knowledge of Rahu in Libra arrives through suffering.

hindi: तो ऐसी स्थिति में मनुष्य जब खाली बैठा होता है, चिंतन करता है, बहुत साधना करता है तो यूजली साधु लोग भी क्या करते हैं?
says: When a person sits idle, contemplates and does much sadhana, the same head-only state arises, as with sadhus; he sets up the spiritual use of Rahu.

gist: 'They sit' - short answer about sadhus.

hindi: भक्ति के साधना के नशे में है।
says: They are in the intoxication of devotion and practice, a spiritual form of the Rahu 'nasha'.

hindi: सिर्फ यह चल रहा है।
says: Only the head is working in such states of meditation.

hindi: बॉडी स्थिर की हुई है।
says: The body is held still in meditation, the 'no body' condition of the Rahu head.

gist: Rhetorical 'what is the basic mechanism of meditation?'.
Rhetorical 'when you want grace and to meet God, what to do?'.

hindi: अपना राहु एक्टिवेट करके केतु को शांत बिठा दो और इस खोपड़ी से सोचो।
says: Meditation method: activate your Rahu, seat Ketu quietly, and think with the head (skull); Rahu is the thinking head and Ketu the body.
ambiguity: How to 'activate Rahu' is not stated.

hindi: ऊपर वाले से कनेक्ट हो।
says: Connect with the one above (the divine) through this head-centred meditation.

gist: Rhetorical 'how far do you have to look?'.
One-word answer 'endless'.

hindi: आप इसका पार नहीं पा सकते।
says: You cannot reach the far shore of it, since the endlessness cannot be crossed.

gist: 'Its end is not understood' - repeats the endlessness point.
Rhetorical 'so what is it?'.
'Lost, who knows what' - filler.
'So when you are lost' - lead-in.

hindi: आपका राहु सात नंबर का होगा।
says: The lost, wandering state belongs to a Rahu in number 7, Libra.

gist: 'They are lost' - repeats the state.

hindi: लेकिन यही मार्गदर्शक है और यही आपको इंट्यूटिव पावर्स भी देता है।
says: But this same Rahu is the guide and also gives intuitive powers; the lost state is the road to intuition.

hindi: अंदाजे लगाता है इंसान एग्जैक्ट कुछ नहीं पता चलता।
says: The person makes guesses and never knows anything exactly, because intuition without proof stays approximate.

hindi: इसी को डल्यूजन बोलते हैं।
says: This is called delusion (dilution/delusion), the first name for the state of inexact seeing.
ambiguity: Caption 'डल्यूजन' is read as delusion.

hindi: इसी को इल्यूजन इसी को मोह माया में फंसा हुआ और इसी को के भ्रष्ट भी हो सकता है।
says: This is also illusion, being trapped in moha-maya, and the person can become corrupt as well.
ambiguity: The last words are garbled ('इसी को के').
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is the planet of maya and corruption.

hindi: यह आपका राहु काम करेगा।
says: All this is how your Rahu in number 7 will work.

hindi: इसके बाद इंद्र इंद्र सात नंबर में नाभि के ऊपर बैठा हुआ यह इंद्र देवता समुद्र में जाकर के शांत होता है।
says: Next, Indra (Uranus) in number 7: Indra, who sits above the navel, goes into the sea and becomes calm.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in Libra calms by house: it acts on the matters of the house where it sits, gently instead of violently.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; Uranus in the 4th in Libra, sudden changes at home settle quietly.
Derived: lagna Pisces; Uranus in the 8th in Libra, upheaval and hidden matters are softened.

classical_check: Silent: Uranus is not used classically.

hindi: आपकी नाभि शांत हो जाती है।
says: The navel becomes calm, i.e. the Indra (navel) energy is soothed when it meets the sea.

gist: Says that people report pain or trouble somewhere in the body.
Rhetorical 'what do you put over the navel?'.

hindi: नमक का पानी।
says: Remedy: salt water on the navel.
ambiguity: A folk health remedy recorded as said.

hindi: थोड़ा सा पानी में नमक डाला, थोड़ा सा आपने उसमें नींबू डाला, विटामिन सी की करेक्शन करी।
says: Method: a little salt in water plus a little lemon, which also corrects vitamin C. A health claim recorded as said, not as advice.

hindi: आपकी नाभि करेक्शन हो गई।
says: Your navel gets corrected by this treatment; the navel centre is re-aligned.

hindi: तो यह नाभि के पास जब वरुण देवता आते हैं तो बहुत शुभ फल होता है।
says: When Varuna comes near the navel (Uranus in Neptune's sign) the result is very auspicious.

hindi: लेकिन नाभि जब वहां जाती है तो अग्नि जा रही है।
says: But when the navel energy goes there, it is fire entering the sea.

hindi: वज्र एक प्रकार से लाइटिंग ऊपर से जाती समुद्र के अंदर जाकर शांत होती है।
says: Indra's vajra is a kind of lightning that comes from above and is calmed after entering the sea.
classical_check: Agrees on the myth of Indra's vajra as lightning.

hindi: तो आपकी जितनी भूख प्यास ऐश अय्याशियां है वह सारी की सारी देने वाला वरुण देवता है।
says: All your hunger, thirst, luxury and indulgence are given by Varuna Devta; Neptune is the source of every desire's fulfilment.

gist: People often ask him how to get 100 crore or even 500 crore rupees.

hindi: अंधा आजा करोगे क्या उसका पता तुम्हें है नहीं बस चाहिए
says: Blind craving: people want crores without knowing what they will do with it; he calls this purposeless wanting a Neptune-Indra madness. He gives no investment advice.
ambiguity: Caption 'अंधा आजा' is garbled; sense taken from the surrounding words.

hindi: क्या करोगे कुछ पता नहीं है बस वो पागलपन
says: They do not know what they will do with the money, it is only that madness of wanting, the endless-desire pathology.

hindi: ये जो पागलपन है बुद्धि भ्रष्ट है इंद्र के वहां पर बदनाम है
says: This madness is a corrupted intellect, and in Indra's (Uranus) place it is infamous; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
ambiguity: Sentence ends abruptly at the slice boundary.

hindi: बेचारा इंद्र के अप्सराय है स्वर्ग का देवता है उसके पास सोम रस चलता है ऐश अयाशिया चलती है
says: Indra, the king of heaven who keeps apsaras and soma, stands for Uranus as the planet of luxury, indulgence and sensual pleasure.
ambiguity: He calls the planet Indra; in his scheme Indra is Uranus.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus is not a classical graha; Indra here is a Vedic deity mapped on by the speaker.

hindi: ये सारा देने वाला कौन है ये सारा वरुण है जो जितने लोग ये चाहते हैं कि मेरी लाइफ में अंधाधुंध सब कुछ आता है।
says: The real giver behind all of Indra's luxuries is Varuna (Neptune); anyone who wants unlimited abundance flowing into life is really asking Neptune.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not classical; closest classical analogue is Venus or Jupiter as givers of abundance.

hindi: वहां इंद्र देवता कृपा लेने जाते हैं उसके पास।
says: Uranus (Indra) himself must go to Neptune (Varuna) to receive grace, so Uranus is dependent on Neptune for what it distributes.

hindi: तो इंद्र देवता जब सात नंबर के चले जाते हैं तो कृपा के भिखारी होते हैं और वरुण देवता के पास से ही खोद करके लेकर आते हैं।
says: When Uranus goes to the 7th (Varuna's natural seat) he becomes a beggar for grace and digs his supply out of Neptune's domain.
cells_derived_method: 7th house is the natural Libra place, which in his scheme is shared by Venus and Neptune; the result of Uranus there colours through the sign actually on the 7th: air or Venus signs make it a charm-based supply, water signs an emotional/hidden supply, fire signs an impulsive grab.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 7th falling in Libra sits in Venus/Neptune's own sign, so the grace-begging is smooth and comes through partners and social status.
Derived: Uranus in Scorpio on the 7th, a sign he himself rules in his scheme, takes the grace in a hidden, intense, possessive way.
Derived: Uranus in Aries on the 7th is a rash grab for the partner's resources, with Mars-like haste instead of patient receiving.

ambiguity: 'Seven number' could mean the 7th house or the 7th sign Libra; the following sentences say 7th house, so house is taken.
classical_check: Silent; Uranus and Neptune have no classical house results.

hindi: तो यह आपको बहुत गजब का शुभता का फल देता है और अपने आप में इंद्र नष्ट हो जाता है।
says: Uranus placed in Neptune's seat gives the native a remarkably auspicious result, but Uranus consumes itself in doing so.
cells_derived_method: The auspicious outcome is for the native's gains; the self-destruction shows as loss of the planet's own significations (sudden breaks, instability). Strength of the sign on the 7th decides how much of the gain survives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Pisces on the 7th sits in a Jupiter/Neptune-like water sign, so the gain flows readily and the break-up is gradual dissolving.
Derived: Uranus in Aquarius on the 7th is in a sign he co-rules in the usual modern scheme, so the sudden gain and sudden loss are both sharp.

ambiguity: Whether this is a house-7 statement or a general Uranus-meets-Neptune statement is not explicit.

hindi: तो इंद्र अल्टीमेटली क्या करता है? खुद भी कृपा का देवता बन जाता है। तो यह बहुत पॉजिटिव है।
says: In the end Uranus absorbs Neptune's quality and itself turns into a giver of grace, which he calls very positive.
cells_derived_method: Same Uranus-in-7th condition; the transformation is a long-run outcome, so it is expected to show in later dashas rather than early ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in Libra the transformation is easiest, since the sign already belongs to the grace-giving Venus/Neptune side.
Derived: in Capricorn on the 7th the transformation is slow and conditional on discipline, because Saturn's sign resists easy grace.

hindi: सालों साल में बदलते हैं ग्रह। इनके इफेक्ट बड़े दूरगामी है। इस कारण से इनके फल प्रॉपर्ली लोग ना पढ़ते ना उनको ढंग से समझ आता।
says: The outer planets change sign only after many years and their effects are very long-range, so people neither read nor understand their results properly.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not use these planets.

hindi: लेकिन इंद्र नष्ट करता है। बिजली की ऊपर से करंट आता है, फिकता है, गिरता है, नाश हो जाता है।
says: Indra is also a destroyer: like lightning striking from above, Uranus's effect arrives suddenly, falls, and ruins what it hits.
classical_check: Silent for Uranus; the sudden-shock nature is a modern Western reading adopted here.

hindi: तो इंद्र यदि आप मान के चलिए यहां पर सातवें घर में बैठा है तो इसकी शादी खराब कैसे करेगा? मल्टीपल रिलेशन दे देगा।
says: Uranus in the 7th house spoils marriage by giving multiple relationships.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house governs spouse and partnerships; Uranus adds plurality and instability. The sign on the 7th decides the style of the plural bonds: Venus signs give charm-led affairs, water signs emotional entanglements, fire signs impulsive ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Libra on the 7th gives several refined, status-linked partnerships.
Derived: Uranus in Scorpio on the 7th gives secretive, intense, overlapping attachments.
Derived: Uranus in Cancer on the 7th gives emotionally dependent bonds with more than one person.

classical_check: Silent for Uranus; classically the 7th house with malefic occupants troubles marriage, which loosely agrees.

hindi: अब इंद्र तो अपना अच्छा ही काम कर रहा है कि भैया ये तो ढेर सारे रिश्ते दे, ढेर सारे रिलेशनशिप अफेयर दे रहा है। लेकिन होगी तो शादी खराब ही।
says: Uranus thinks it is doing a good job by supplying many relationships and affairs, yet the net result for the marriage is still bad.
cells_derived_method: Same as Uranus in the 7th: the abundance of partners is the symptom and the damaged marriage is the outcome.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Gemini on the 7th gives many talkative, casual connections; the marriage suffers from divided attention.
Derived: Uranus in Leo on the 7th gives admiring partners and ego-driven affairs; the marriage suffers from pride.

hindi: यहां पर इंद्र सात नंबर का बैठा है। क्या करेगा? बहुत सारी प्रॉपर्टीियां दे देगा। लेकिन अल्टीमेटली करेगा क्या? भोग विलास ऐश ऐश्वर्य नाश सत्यानाश कर देगा।
says: Uranus in the 7th gives many properties, but finally wrecks the enjoyment, luxury and prosperity those properties were supposed to bring.
cells_derived_method: Property gain is a general Uranus-in-7 outcome (partner or business-linked); the later ruin follows the sign's stability. Fixed signs hold property longer, mutable signs lose it faster.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Taurus on the 7th, a fixed Venus sign, holds property for long before the sudden loss.
Derived: Uranus in Sagittarius on the 7th, a mutable sign, gains property through travel or partnership and loses it quickly.

ambiguity: Property is classically the 4th house, so it is unclear whether he means 7th-house business property or any property.

hindi: तो यह सात नंबर का इंद्र पावरफुल तो है लेकिन है यह नासी क्योंकि इंद्र के कैरेक्टर के अंदर यही है कि कैरेक्टर ही कोई नहीं है। यह एक नेगेटिविटी है।
says: The 7th-house Uranus is powerful but destructive, because Indra's very nature is to have no moral character, which he calls a negativity.

hindi: तो ये अच्छा है कि बुरा है। यह व्यक्तित्व व्यक्ति देखना पड़ेगा कि आपकी कुंडली क्या कहती है। यह बड़ा डेंजरस हिसाब किताब बन जाता है इसका।
says: Whether Uranus in the 7th is good or bad cannot be fixed in advance; the person's whole chart must be checked, and the combination is dangerous.
classical_check: Agrees with the general classical rule that results depend on the whole chart.

hindi: और यमराज जब सात नंबर का होता है तो धर्मराज की तरह गजब का फल देता है। धर्मराज।
says: Pluto (Yamaraj) in the 7th gives excellent results, acting like Dharmaraj, the just judge.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house is the place of Varuna's grace; Pluto there is softened and becomes a law-abiding giver. The sign on the 7th changes the field: partnership, trade or contract gains in air signs, hidden or inherited gains in water signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Libra on the 7th gives justice-based gains through spouse or partner, a very natural fit for Dharmaraj.
Derived: Pluto in Scorpio on the 7th gives deep transformation and hidden inheritance through the partner.
Derived: Pluto in Gemini on the 7th gives gains through contracts, agents and communication partners.

hindi: यमराज को आप समझ रहे हैं ये मृत्यु का देवता है यहां बैठा हुआ आपकी मौत होती है यहां ये मौत है मौत का देवता है और यहां क्या है कृपा का देवता ये नर्क भी है
says: Yama is the god of death; the place where death occurs is next to the place of the grace-giving god, and that same zone can also be hell. Caption is garbled and the diagram pointing is lost.
cells_derived_method: He appears to place Varuna's grace at the 7th and Yama's death at the next house, the 8th; so the 7th-8th pair is grace followed by death.
ambiguity: Which house is death and which is grace is inferred from the later line that death comes right after; caption is unclear. Not a death prediction.
classical_check: The 8th house as death/longevity house is classical; 7th as a maraka house is classical too.

hindi: अब सूर्य देवता है यहां मनुष्य बैठा है अर्थ में जिंदा जीवित मनुष्य की जीवन यहां है।
says: The Sun's place is the living human being, the life of a living person, which is drawn on the diagram as the starting point before the death and grace places.
ambiguity: 'Here' points at a diagram; first house is inferred because the Sun and the living self correspond to the 1st house.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun as atma karaka and 1st house as self.

hindi: मृत्यु यहां है तो धीरे धीरे धीरे यहां आया कोई कृपा मिल गई ये कृपा के दम के ऊपर बंदा क्या हुआ मर नहीं पाया
says: A person moving step by step toward the death point who receives grace on the way does not die, because the grace holds death off. A tradition claim, not a prediction.
ambiguity: Garbled and diagram-dependent; no death date or medical claim is recorded.

hindi: इसीलिए सब कहते हैं भाई कृपा ले ले भाई दुआ ले ले भाई बद्दुआ मत ले
says: That is why elders say take blessings and grace, do not take curses; the grace and the ill-will both reach through the same channel.

hindi: यही दुआ और बद्दुआ दोनों है पर उनके पास दुआ भी है बद्दुआ भी है इसलिए कहते हैं दुआ से कृपा ले लो भाई प्यार ले लो भाई बद्दुआ मत लो किसी का बुरा ना बोलो बुरा ना देखो टाइप्स
says: These deities hold both blessing and curse power, so the advice is to win blessings and love and never speak or see ill of anyone.

hindi: क्योंकि इसके ठीक बाद मौत है मौत भी टल जाएगी अगर कृपा हो गई
says: Death sits right after the grace seat, and if grace has been earned even death is deferred. A tradition claim only, not a prediction.
ambiguity: Reading 7th then 8th as grace then death; the caption does not name the houses.
classical_check: Silent; classically the 8th house is the house of longevity and death.

hindi: इसलिए आपके पास वरुण देवता जब इसके पास आते आते हैं तो कृपा मिलती है।
says: When Neptune comes near Pluto, the native receives grace.
ambiguity: Garbled; 'comes near' may mean conjunction, aspect, or Neptune's seat adjacent to Pluto's.

hindi: वरुण देवता के पास जब यमराज आता है कृपा मिलती है तो यमराज भी धर्मराज बन जाता है। वह पॉजिटिव फल देता है।
says: When Pluto (Yama) arrives in Neptune's domain and meets grace, Yama too becomes Dharmaraj and gives positive results.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's domain is read as the 7th, so this repeats Pluto in the 7th; the sign on the house sets whether the positive result appears as legal, financial or relationship gain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Pisces on the 7th, in Neptune's own water sign, makes the Dharmaraj effect compassionate and spiritual.
Derived: Pluto in Virgo on the 7th turns the positive result into service, detail and fair dealing.

ambiguity: Neptune's domain taken as the 7th house, following the earlier lines.

hindi: तो सात नंबर का प्लूटो किसी का आस्पेक्ट कर रहा है कुंडली में प्लूटो सात नंबर एक नंबर से भी करेगा।
says: Pluto in the 7th aspects the 1st house opposite it, so the same grace-or-damage reaches the native's own self.
cells_derived_method: Opposition from the 7th lands on the 1st; the sign on the 1st (lagna) sets how the self absorbs it: movable lagnas act on it, fixed lagnas resist it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 7th (Libra) aspecting an Aries lagna pressures the self toward bold transformation.
Derived: Pluto in the 7th (Capricorn) aspecting a Cancer lagna works through emotional and family-linked change.

classical_check: 7th-aspect on the opposite house is classical for all grahas; applying it to Pluto follows the same logic.

hindi: 12 नंबर से भी शिफ्ट हो के कर सकता है। दो से शिफ्ट हो के कर सकता है।
says: Because Pluto is slow and its aspect is wide, it can also reach the 12th and the 2nd houses by shifting the aspect on either side of the 1st.
cells_derived_method: The 12th and 2nd flank the 1st; Pluto in the 7th touches them by orb. Effects: 12th loss, sleep, foreign; 2nd wealth, family, speech.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto's shifted aspect on a Pisces 12th brings hidden expenses and spiritual dissolution.
Derived: Pluto's shifted aspect on a Taurus 2nd transforms the family wealth and speech.

ambiguity: Could also mean Pluto sitting in the 12th or 2nd aspecting; the 'shift' wording points to the first.
classical_check: Silent: classical drishti is by whole house only; wide-orb aspect is the speaker's own.

hindi: छह से कर सकता है और आठ से कर सकता है।
says: By the same wide-orb logic Pluto can also act from the 6th and the 8th, which flank the 7th where it sits.
cells_derived_method: 6th and 8th flank the 7th; the planet is read as acting by shifting one house either way. 6th gives debt, enemies, service; 8th gives transformation, in-laws, inheritance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto effect from a Virgo 6th works through illness-recovery, service and debts.
Derived: Pluto effect from a Scorpio 8th is a strong inheritance and occult transformation.

ambiguity: Unclear whether this means Pluto from the 6th/8th aspects the 1st, or Pluto in the 7th touching the 6th/8th.

hindi: क्योंकि ये लंबे चलने वाले ग्रह हैं। 21 साल है। एक राशि में मोटे तौर पे चलता है। 18 भी चलता है। 24 भी चलता है। 21 मोटे-मोटे तो उसके अंतर्गत यहां पर जहां बैठ गया बैठ गया फिक्स है।
says: Pluto stays about 21 years in one sign (18 to 24), so wherever it sits it stays fixed for decades.
classical_check: Real Pluto sign stays range from about 12 to 31 years, mean about 20.6; his 18 to 24 is a rough but fair figure.

hindi: आपको सालों साल के लिए ऐश कराएगा। खानदानी रईस बनाता है।
says: A well-placed Pluto gives luxury for years on end and makes the native hereditarily rich.
ambiguity: Refers to the grace-receiving Pluto in the 7th discussed above; 'well placed' is implied.

hindi: अंधा पैसा शुरुआत से लेकर आखिर तक मिलता है।
says: Pluto gives 'blind' money (windfall or unaccounted money) from the start of life to the end.
ambiguity: 'Blind money' is read as unearned or unexplained income; condition is the same well-placed Pluto.

gist: Rhetorical transition: you will say find this planet in your chart, but what will it do for you?

hindi: ऐसे किसी व्यक्ति को देखो जिसके पास कररेक्टर्स हैं और मात्र उससे मित्रता कर लो।
says: If you lack the grace planet, find a person who carries those qualities and simply befriend them.
ambiguity: 'Characters' is garbled; likely 'a person with that planet strongly placed' or a person of good character.

hindi: मंगल का एक धागा होता है मित्रता। वह मात्र डाल लो और देखो उसी के थ्रू कृपा आनी शुरू हो जाएगी।
says: Friendship is Mars's thread; just tie that thread with such a person and grace will begin to arrive through them.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of brothers and companions is classical; friendship specifically is more usually Mercury or the 11th, so this is partly his own.

hindi: ये बड़े बुजुर्ग शुरू में कहा करते थे कि पैसे वाला बनना है बेटा पैसे वाले लोगों के बीच रह। उनके वाइबेशंस को पकड़ो। उनकी वाइबेशंस मिलेंगी तुझे।
says: Elders used to say that to become rich you should live among rich people and absorb their vibrations.
classical_check: Silent: folk wisdom, not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Work gets done through vibration; if you learn to receive it you will not even notice.
Audience may be bored and the mind resists, but everything is still being heard by the brain somewhere.
Ancestral lineage argument: you come from great-grandparents, so great-grandmother's samskaras reach you and yours reach your granddaughter.
Story start: a famous learned saint draws everyone to his katha, and an old deaf man of the town starts attending.
The deaf old man grabs a seat first, smiles at the start, smiles and folds hands in thanks at the end, then leaves.
Others begin coming with him; people report to the saint that the man hears nothing and may be a fraud.
The saint has the man brought to his room; he cannot hear or speak, so they write on paper, and he says he comes for the divine touch of satsang.
Story: the deaf old man says that when a person connects with God he thinks grace may come, so he attends for grace.
Story: the saint is amazed that the old man senses vibration and has understood what many learned listeners miss.
Story: the man writes that grace came: first he came alone, then his suspicious wife, her friend, the friend's husband, the children and now the grandson.
Story: asked what they do sitting there, he says let it go to hell, they may not understand but something will enter their ears.
Moral: whatever enters the ear goes into the DNA.
Saints and scientists do not just appear in a house by chance.
Great souls are born into families of apparent fools; the world calls the person a donkey but the soul saw something in him.
That DNA was nourished over many births; vibration is string theory, electron to quark to strings, up to the 10th or 14th dimension.

hindi: आप अनभिज्ञ आपको पता ही नहीं लेकिन वो जा रही है और हो सकता है आपके डीएनए को पोषित करे आगे कंगाल माता-पिता के बच्चे राजा पैदा हो जाते हैं यह कृपा कहीं ना कहीं से चल रही है।
says: Unseen vibration may nourish your DNA for the future, and that is how children of penniless parents are sometimes born as kings: grace is running from somewhere behind the scenes.
ambiguity: He does not tie this to any chart factor; it is a general statement of grace.
classical_check: Silent; closest classical idea is purva-punya (merit of past births) shown by the 5th and 9th houses.

hindi: आपको अनलॉक करनी नहीं आई। किसी को आ जाएगी। इसीलिए यह समागम का बड़ा महत्व है। आपके पल्ले कुछ नहीं पड़ा यह मत सोचना। आपके अंदर कुछ है उसके पल्ले पड़ रहा है।
says: You may not know how to unlock grace but someone will; this is why attending gatherings matters, because even if you think you got nothing, something inside you is taking it in.
classical_check: Silent; satsang is a general devotional practice, not a Jyotish remedy.

hindi: यह कृपा देने वाला देवता वरुण है। अंधकार का देवता है। इस ये छुपा रहता है।
says: Varuna (Neptune) is the deity that gives grace; he is a god of darkness and remains hidden.
classical_check: Silent for Neptune; Varuna as lord of the waters and the west is Vedic, and the west is his Vastu direction.

hindi: हजार आंखों वाला देवता इंद्र को कहते हैं। लेकिन इसकी हजार दृष्टियां है क्योंकि ये स्पाय है। धोखेबाज है।
says: The thousand-eyed epithet belongs to Indra, but Varuna has a thousand gazes because he is a spy and a deceiver.
ambiguity: Thousand gazes may mean Neptune sees (aspects) everything; he does not say so as a drishti rule.
classical_check: Vedic myth gives Indra the thousand eyes; Varuna is also called thousand-eyed in the Vedas, so the attribution is partly his own.

hindi: ये छुप के रहता है। ये पता दिखता ही नहीं है। ये अकेला ग्रह है जो वैसे आसमान में दिखेगा नहीं। टेलिस्कोप चाहिए और बड़ी कठिनाई से दिखता है क्योंकि छुपा हुआ देखता है।
says: Neptune hides and cannot be seen in the sky without a telescope, which he ties to its hidden watching nature.
classical_check: Fact check: Neptune is not visible to the naked eye, correct; but he says it is the only such planet and Pluto is also invisible without a telescope.

hindi: आइस जॉइंट है। बर्फ का गोला और कृपा देने वाला इसी को माना गया।
says: Neptune is an ice giant, a ball of ice, and this is the planet taken to be the giver of grace.
classical_check: Silent; the ice-giant description is astronomy (correct).

hindi: पूरे वास्तु शास्त्र में यह सबसे महत्वपूर्ण कृपा देने वाला भगवान है। अगर इसने सुन ली तो सबने सबकी सुन ली।
says: In the whole of Vastu, Varuna is the most important grace-giving deity; if he listens to you, everyone has effectively listened.
ambiguity: Vastu link only: no chart cells are stated.
classical_check: Varuna is the classical Vastu lord of the west, so he is classically important, but 'most important' is the speaker's ranking.

hindi: जो अंधे पैसे जिनके घर में लक्ष्मी माता दरवाजा ठोक के कह रही है आने दो। दरवाजा खोला अंदर गिरी इतनी गिरी कि दरवाजा बंद करना पड़ा जैसे तैसे
says: Varuna's grace looks like blind money: Lakshmi knocks on the door asking to come in, pours in so much that the door has to be shut, and the family cannot even store it.
ambiguity: Image rather than a rule; the caption is run-on.

hindi: जितने लोग इस चक्कर में लगे हुए हैं बस मनोरथ पूरा हो जाए। मुंह में बोलने की शक्ति आ जाए। किसी को कुछ कह दिया यह वो देवता है।
says: Varuna is the deity for everyone who wants their wishes fulfilled and wants the power of speech whereby whatever they tell someone comes true (vak-siddhi).
classical_check: Silent: vak-siddhi is usually linked to Jupiter, Mercury and the 2nd house classically.

hindi: इसकीेंस और गहराई समझना बहुत जरूरी है। अक्सर क्या होगा इसकी खोपड़ी हमारा माइंड प्रोसेस इसकी बात खोपड़ी प्रोसेस नहीं कर पाएगी।
says: Neptune's depth is important to understand, but the rational mind cannot process it, so it will not be grasped by logic alone. Caption is partly garbled.
ambiguity: A garbled word ('इसकीेंस') makes the first clause uncertain.

hindi: निगी नन्नी का भी यही देवता है।
says: Sleep or the nap state ('nini' in the caption) is also ruled by this same deity, Neptune.
ambiguity: 'निगी नन्नी' is garbled; read as sleep from the next sentence.
classical_check: Sleep is classically the 12th house and Venus or Moon; Neptune is the modern assignment.

hindi: नींद के दौरान जो बॉडी हील करती है वो ये देवता है।
says: The healing the body does during sleep is this deity's work, so Neptune governs restoration during rest. A general health claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: रात को जो लिख करके हम छोड़ देते हैं। घर के वेस्ट डायरेक्शन में जो सफेद कागज पर काले से लिख के छोड़ते हैं कि ये हो जाए वो होता है। यह वो देवता है।
says: Remedy: at night write a wish in black on white paper and leave it in the west of the house; it gets fulfilled because the west and wish-granting both belong to Varuna.
classical_check: West as Varuna's Vastu direction is classical; the paper-writing practice is not a classical remedy.

hindi: यह वो देवता है जो यह कहता है बेटा तू मुंह से मांग क्या चाहिए? दूसरे के लिए मांग।
says: Varuna is the one who says child, ask aloud for what you want, and the advice is to ask for someone else.

hindi: कॉस्मिक एनर्जी को ट्रैप करके वापस लाने वाला यह देवता है।
says: Varuna is the deity that traps cosmic energy and brings it back to the native, the receiving side of manifestation.

gist: Claim that ida and pingala, activated through sushumna, meet at the heart portal and send electromagnetic signals into space at c-squared or c-cubed speed.
All manifestation comes from the heart chakra, so once you think from the heart it is set.
Shah Rukh Khan dialogue: when I wished with all my heart, the whole universe conspired; the universe works through ida, pingala and sushumna at the heart chakra.

hindi: यहां पे तो जाके ज्ञान हो गया सब व्यर्थ है इसलिए फालतू ज्ञान होना बड़ा लफड़े वाली बात है इंसान को मोह माया से मुक्त हो जाता है उसका मन ही नहीं करता मैनिफेस्ट करने का
says: Once a person reaches the level where he knows all is futile, he is free of attachment and no longer wishes to manifest anything; so too much useless knowledge is a problem.
ambiguity: Caption mixes the heart-chakra point with the detachment point; Neptune is implied but not named.
classical_check: Silent; detachment is the classical Ketu and 12th house theme.

hindi: इसलिए जो यहां फंसा है वो चीजी बना लेता है और यहां वाला जो दूसरे के घर बना के दे देता है उसको अपने से समझ आता है निरर्थकता
says: The person stuck at the lower level builds things for himself, while the one at the higher level who builds houses for others sees their futility on his own.
ambiguity: Two 'here' gestures at a diagram; who 'builds houses for others' may be a Vastu consultant or an architect.

hindi: तो यह एक अलग देवता है ये अलग कहानी हो जाएगी तो यही ये वाला देवता है। ये इतना ज्यादा ताकतवर और बड़ा देवता है।
says: Varuna is a distinct deity with a separate story and is extremely powerful and great.

gist: Audience member says Ketu has not been discussed yet, although signs were covered.
Banter: he barely got through Rahu and now Ketu is pending; he teases a listener as a good enemy and says past-life debts are what they are.

hindi: अब केतु महाराज केतु जब सात नंबर में आता है। अब आप सोच के चलिए समुद्र के पास समुद्र के पास बादल आ गया। खूब सारे बादल आ गए।
says: Ketu in the 7th is pictured as clouds arriving next to the ocean, with the 7th house as the sea (Varuna's seat).
cells_derived_method: The 7th house carries the sea symbol; Ketu's cloud effect on it varies with the sign: water signs make the clouds heavy and emotional, air signs make them thin and intellectual.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces on the 7th puts clouds right on the sea itself, a strong mystical and withdrawn partnership side.
Derived: Ketu in Gemini on the 7th gives thin high clouds, a detached and verbal handling of partners.

classical_check: Silent: classical texts treat Ketu in the 7th as spouse trouble and detachment, with no sea imagery.

gist: Self-mocking remark that his drawn clouds look so dangerous someone might want to end it all; not advice.

hindi: अब ये बादल जब समुद्र के पास आते हैं तो क्या हाल होता है? इसमें से पानी चुरा लेते हैं।
says: Clouds coming over the sea steal its water; so Ketu in the 7th steals what the Varuna zone holds.
cells_derived_method: What is stolen depends on what the 7th holds: partner, trade, public dealing. Water-sign 7ths lose emotional supply; earth-sign 7ths lose material supply.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Cancer on the 7th drains emotional nourishment from partnership.
Derived: Ketu in Taurus on the 7th drains money and comfort that partners would bring.

hindi: कितनी विचित्र बात है। केतु जो है यह भी बहुत बड़ा दाता है। केतु एक बड़ा मिस्टीरियस प्लनेट है। कमाल का है।
says: Ketu is also a very great giver and a very mysterious planet.
classical_check: Classical texts call Ketu a moksha and mystery karaka; calling him a big giver is the speaker's emphasis.

hindi: ये सूरज और चंदा मामा को ढप लेता है। जब इसके ऊपर आ जाता है समुद्र भी ढप जाता है।
says: Ketu covers the Sun and the Moon, and when it comes over the sea the sea is covered too, so Ketu also blots out Neptune's domain.
classical_check: Agrees with classical eclipse symbolism for Rahu and Ketu covering Sun and Moon.

gist: Story: a woman swam a channel, and he cites 141 hours of swimming, which is impossible and likely a wrong caption number or misremembered case.
Story: about 600 metres from the shore a cloud came, she could not see the coast, lost heart and quit; people asked why she gave up so soon.

hindi: तो केतु क्या है बादल ये इसकी सीमाएं बना देता है हमें लगता है बस यहीं तक है
says: Ketu is the cloud that creates limits and boundaries in our mind, making us feel that this is as far as it goes.

hindi: तो केतु जो है यह कृपा के आड़े आ जाता है। कृपा के आड़े आता है और यहां से पानी चुरा लेता है।
says: Ketu stands in the way of grace and steals water from the sea, meaning it obstructs the blessing that Varuna's zone would give.
cells_derived_method: Obstruction shows as grace not reaching the native; the sign decides the visible form: in earth signs as delayed money, in water signs as emotional distance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Virgo on the 7th blocks grace through over-analysis and fault-finding in partnerships.
Derived: Ketu in Sagittarius on the 7th blocks grace through doctrinal or philosophical distance from the partner.

ambiguity: 'Here' is taken as the 7th, in line with the preceding lines.

hindi: पानी चुरा के ले जाता है तो जीवन तो यह देता है संसार में। तो ऐसा व्यक्ति औरों के लिए फायदेमंद होता है।
says: The water Ketu steals becomes rain and gives life to the world, so a person with this Ketu benefits other people.

hindi: जिसका केतु सात नंबर है वो औरों के लिए फायदेमंद है। उसकी अपनी ऐसी की तैसी है। अपना पूरा सत्यानाश है उसकी अपनी लाइफ का।
says: The person with Ketu in the 7th benefits others, while his own life is badly ruined.
cells_derived_method: 7th house stands for partner, trade and public dealing: he serves others there and loses personally. Sign on the 7th decides whom he serves: Venus signs serve spouse and clients with charm, Saturn signs serve through duty, fire signs through zeal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Libra on the 7th gives to partners and clients with grace but leaves his own marriage hollow.
Derived: Ketu in Aries on the 7th lets him champion others' causes impulsively while his own home life suffers.
Derived: Ketu in Capricorn on the 7th makes him a dutiful provider for others with cold personal returns.

classical_check: Classical texts agree that Ketu in the 7th harms the spouse or marriage; 'benefits others' is the speaker's own addition.

gist: Sentence is cut off at the end of the slice: 'and this is his state, that from others...'.

hindi: चीज ला के इससे लाके उसे दे दी। उससे लाकर के इसे दे दी। भाई दानवीर बनते गए। मैं लूटता रहूं। तुम तरते रहो। हां जी।
says: The Ketu-in-7th person acts as a conduit, taking from one person and giving to another, becoming a great donor who is himself looted while others get across safely.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house is dealings with others; Ketu there makes the person a pass-through. The sign on the 7th sets the channel: Mercury signs pass information and goods, Venus signs pass money and favours, Saturn signs pass labour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Gemini on the 7th passes information and contacts between people while keeping none for himself.
Derived: Ketu in Taurus on the 7th passes money and goods between others and stays poor himself.
Derived: Ketu in Aquarius on the 7th lends organised labour and networks to others without a share.

classical_check: Silent; consistent with the classical Ketu-in-7th picture of detachment from partners.

hindi: कई लोगों का यह होता है कि अपने लिए तो कुछ नहीं है। तो दूसरे के लिए करेंगे तो वो किंग मेकर बन जाएंगे। यस वो किंग मेकर बनते हैं। तो ऐसे बहुत से लोग हैं।
says: Many such people have nothing for themselves but when they work for others they become kingmakers, the person behind someone else's success.
cells_derived_method: Kingmaker role fits the 7th house as the house of partners and the public; the sign sets the field: Sun-Leo signs make political kingmakers, Mercury signs make advisers and brokers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Leo on the 7th makes him the power behind a leader or ruler.
Derived: Ketu in Virgo on the 7th makes him an indispensable adviser or fixer behind a business partner.

ambiguity: The subject is Ketu in the 7th by the flow of the previous lines, but he does not name the planet in this sentence.

hindi: आपको शेयर मार्केट के अंदर बोलने वाले बहुत मिलेंगे। भाई जो शेयर मैं लोगों को बताता हूं उसमें वो नोट पीट लेते हैं। मैं कुछ करता हूं मैं लुट जाता हूं यार।
says: Example: share-market tipsters whose clients make money on the tips while the tipster loses when he trades himself. An anecdote of the same give-to-others pattern, not trading advice.
ambiguity: He does not name the planet here; it is the Ketu-in-7th pattern by context. Investment content, recorded only as a case illustration.

hindi: तो तुम्हें मालिक बनने का योग नहीं है। तुम्हें दूसरे की सर्विस पे लगना है। जब तक तुम दूसरे की सर्विस करते रहोगे वहां से तुम्हें छींट मिलती रहेगी।
says: Verdict for this pattern: the person has no yoga to become an owner and should serve someone else, from whom he keeps getting a trickle of income.
cells_derived_method: Ownership versus service is read from the 7th (partnership) with the 10th. Ketu in the 7th removes the ownership side; sign shows whom he serves: fixed signs give stable employers, movable signs changing ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Scorpio on the 7th, a fixed sign, gives a long stable dependence on one employer or partner.
Derived: Ketu in Sagittarius on the 7th gives service in advisory, teaching or travel fields rather than ownership.

ambiguity: A career verdict; he does not give the chart conditions beyond the Ketu pattern.

hindi: ऐसे केसेस हमारे पास आते हैं जिसमें लोग कंपनी के अंदर काम करते हैं। एक नई कंपनी बॉस को बोल के शुरू कराते हैं। 95% बॉस खा जाता है। 5% उसे मिलता है।
says: Case from his practice: an employee gets his boss to start a new company, the boss takes 95 percent of the gain and the employee gets 5 percent.
ambiguity: The case is the Ketu-in-7th pattern by context; no chart is given.

hindi: फिर वो कहता है यार सारा काम मैं करता हूं। अरे बॉस को 95 मुझे ₹5 मिलते हैं। मैं खुद ही ना कंपनी चला दूं। तो फिर वो अपनी कंपनी चलाता है और उसके ऊपर कर्जा हो जाता है और वो बर्बाद हो जाता है।
says: The employee then leaves to run his own company, falls into debt and is ruined, showing that this person cannot succeed as an owner.
ambiguity: Debt amount in the caption ('5 rupees') is garbled.

hindi: तो ऐसे लोग हैं दूसरे को पालते पालते ही आप पल सकते हैं। यह वो केतु के खेल है जिसकी वजह से केतु महाराज इसको चुरा लेते हैं।
says: Such people can only thrive by sustaining others, which is the Ketu game by which Ketu steals the water.

hindi: केतु की दूसरी नेगेटिव साइड डाउन साइड इसमें यह होती है कि केतु जब सात नंबर का आ गया तो इसकी 8 9 10 11 12 एक दो तीन चार पांच छ यह जहां पर बैठ गया उसके पश्चात यह अपने मल्टीपल दृष्टियों के द्वारा तीन नंबर नीच कहीं ना कहीं मनुष्य के जीवन को बर्बाद कर देता है।
says: The second downside: Ketu in the 7th aspects all the other houses, 8 through 12 and 1 through 6, with multiple aspects, so somewhere it ruins a part of life. 'Three number' in the caption is garbled.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the 7th touches every other house, so the area damaged follows the topics of the house hit: 1 self, 2 family, 4 home, 6 service, 10 career. Which one is hit depends on what the chart already stresses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu's wide aspect landing on a Capricorn 10th damages career standing.
Derived: the aspect on a Cancer 4th damages home peace and the mother's side.
Derived: the aspect on an Aries 1st harms vitality and self-confidence.

ambiguity: A garbled phrase ('तीन नंबर नीच') might be a third-house point or a downward aspect; not resolved. Whether this is aspect or influence on every house is also unclear.
classical_check: Classical drishti gives only the 7th-house aspect for Ketu (and some texts allow the 5th and 9th); aspect on all houses is the speaker's own wide-orb idea.

hindi: तो जो व्यक्ति ज्यादा इस चक्कर में रहते हैं ना ला यार तेरे से लेकर उसकी मदद कर दूं भला कर दूं भाई किसी का उनकी लाइफ नर्क हो जाती है बर्बाद हो जाती है
says: People who keep taking from one person to help another, always doing good to others, find their own life turning into hell.

hindi: क्योंकि यह केतु महाराज ने नर्क के देवता से पानी चुरा लिया और जब वरुण केतु से मिलता है तो लाजवाब फल देता है
says: Reason: Ketu has stolen water from the god of hell (probably caption slip for Varuna); and when Neptune joins Ketu the result is excellent.
ambiguity: 'God of hell' is odd here: Varuna is expected; and 'meets' could be conjunction, aspect or exchange.

hindi: अब केतु अपना कार्य ही कर रहा है कि भैया इससे उठाया उसे दे दिया दूसरे के लिए क्योंकि यह शरीर है केतु इतना हिस्सा है राहु मुंडी
says: Ketu is just doing its job of lifting from one and giving to another, because Ketu is the headless body and Rahu the head.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic myth: Rahu is the head, Ketu the headless trunk of the demon.

hindi: मुंडी मुंडी यह किसके लिए काम आ रहा है? यह दूसरे के लिए काम आ रहा है।
says: The body that Ketu stands for is working for someone else, not for the native.

hindi: अगर आपकी मुंडी किसी ने काबू कर रखी है, हिप्नोसिस में डाला है, राहु हिप्नोसिस का दे देता है, तो आपका शरीर का वो दूसरा काबू ही कर रहा है। भोग कर रहा है, आपको इस्तेमाल ही कर रहा है।
says: If someone has your head under control, hypnosis being a Rahu gift, then that other person controls your body, enjoys you and simply uses you.
ambiguity: A general principle of control; no chart cells are given.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as hypnosis and delusion is a modern reading, though Rahu as illusion is classical.

hindi: तो अल्टीमेटली क्या होगा? आपके जीवन के अंदर जितना आप दूसरों के भला करने के चक्कर में रहोगे, उतना आपका शरीर का अंग खराब होगा। जहां पर भी केतु है उसके अनुसार यहां बैठा है, यहां बैठा है, यहां बैठा है। जहां है आपके शरीर के अंग का सत्यानाश होना है।
says: The more you spend your life doing good for others, the more the body part ruled by Ketu's house is damaged. A tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's house maps to a body part by the zodiac body scheme (kalapurusha): 1 head, 2 face and throat, 3 arms, 4 chest, 5 upper abdomen, 6 lower abdomen, 7 kidney region, 8 genitals, 9 thighs, 10 knees, 11 calves, 12 feet. The sign on that house adds its own body area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 3rd with Gemini points at arms, shoulders and hands as the vulnerable area (tradition claim, not a diagnosis).
Derived: Ketu in the 10th with Capricorn points at the knees and joints (tradition claim, not a diagnosis).
Derived: Ketu in the 12th with Pisces points at the feet (tradition claim, not a diagnosis).

ambiguity: Whether he means the house or the sign for the body part is not said; he says only 'where Ketu sits'.
classical_check: Body-part by house follows the standard kalapurusha scheme, but linking it to over-giving is his own.

hindi: इसलिए जो लोग ज्यादा भला करने के चक्कर में रहते हैं वो दूसरे के दुख खरीद लेते हैं। फ्री फंड के दूसरे को सुख पकड़ाते रहते हैं। यह बड़ी डेंजरस व्याख्या है।
says: Those who do too much good buy other people's sorrows, handing out happiness free of charge; he calls this a dangerous interpretation.

hindi: इसलिए फ्री फंड के दान जो होते हैं ये बड़े बुरे। तो करना क्या है? अगर करना ही है गुप्त दान। गुप्त करो। यानी किसको गया पता नहीं। जिसके गया उसे भी पता नहीं किसने दिया।
says: Remedy: avoid free-of-cost open charity; if you must give, give in secret so the receiver does not know the giver and the giver does not know the receiver.
classical_check: Secret donation (gupt dan) is a recognised traditional remedy; calling open charity bad is the speaker's view.

hindi: वो अकाउंट में नहीं है। वो जीरो अकाउंट में है। वो किसके अकाउंट में गया? वो ईश्वर के अकाउंट गया।
says: A secret gift is off the books, in a zero account, and goes to God's account.

hindi: किसके? वरुण के। नेकी कर कहां डाल? कुएं में डाल। अगर वो डालना सीख गए आप तो जिंदगी सफल हो गई। सुधर गई।
says: The account is Varuna's; do good and throw it in a well; if you learn to do that, life becomes successful and corrected.
classical_check: Silent; the proverb 'do good and throw it in the well' is folk wisdom.

hindi: अब सात नंबर में मंगल आ जाता है। तो यह लावा है। आपने देखा होगा समुद्र के अंदर लावा होता है। गर्म। क्या करता है? फुकता रहता है, जलता रहता है, नष्ट होता रहता है।
says: Mars in the 7th is lava under the sea; it keeps burning, smouldering and destroying.
cells_derived_method: Mars is a fire planet; the 7th house stands for the sea of Varuna. Result is an inner burn, shaped by the sign: fire signs make it outward and blazing, water signs make it hidden and bubbling.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Libra on the 7th, a Venus sign where Mars is uneasy, makes an inner burn over relationships that is shown politely.
Derived: Mars in Aries on the 7th, its own sign, gives open blazing aggression inside partnerships.
Derived: Mars in Pisces on the 7th gives an underwater simmer of suppressed anger.

ambiguity: Seven number could be Libra sign or the 7th house; later lines go through planets in Libra order, so the two may be mixed.
classical_check: Classically Mars in the 7th is a Mangal dosha placement that harms marriage, which agrees.

hindi: ऐसे लोग जो है अंदर अंदर लावा धक रहा है उनके अंदर। वो अंदर ही कुड़ते रहते हैं, सड़ते रहते हैं।
says: Such people carry lava burning inside; they fret and rot inwardly instead of expressing it.

hindi: स्किन वाइट हो जाती है। अक्सर कहीं दाग आ गया, वाइट कुछ-कुछ खराब हो गया। ब्लड में प्रॉब्लम आ गई। ये इसलिए मंगल महाराज यहां गलत है।
says: This Mars is said to bring white skin patches and blood problems; recorded as his tradition claim only, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Health claim; flagged, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as blood is classical, white-patch skin disease is not tied to the 7th in standard texts.

hindi: परम वेग अग्नि आग की तरह अग्रेशन होता है व्यक्ति के अंदर। बिल्कुल आग लगा दूंगा। यह स्थिति बना देता है।
says: Mars in the 7th gives extreme fire-like aggression, an urge to set everything on fire.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical Mars in the 7th as a quarrelsome, aggressive placement.

gist: Meta: he says the Libra analysis should start from the Sun, asks where the Sun is, and notes he has already covered it.

hindi: सूर्य का प्रभाव नीच फल सत्यानाश बर्बाद कर देता है। यह हमारी बात हो ही गई है।
says: The Sun in Libra is debilitated and its result is ruinous; he notes this was already discussed.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Libra is debilitated in any house; the topics hit follow the house: 1st self and vitality, 10th career and status, 9th father and fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra in the 1st weakens self-confidence and vitality.
Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra in the 10th weakens authority and career standing.
Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra in the 7th puts ego problems into partnership.

ambiguity: Libra is the 7th sign and also called the seven number; he is walking the planets through Libra.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun is debilitated in Libra.

hindi: फिर चंदा मामा आकर्षक करता है। ज्वार भाटा सफाई ज्वार भाटा पूरा का पूरा समुद्र के अंदर वेग आता है।
says: Moon in the 7th (Varuna's sea) attracts and works like tides, a sweeping and cleansing movement through the whole sea.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the 7th pulls partners and public toward the native with tidal swings of mood; the sign gives the style: Cancer and Taurus steady, Scorpio and Pisces stormy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus on the 7th, its exaltation sign, makes a strong steady attraction and calm tides.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio on the 7th, its debilitation sign, makes intense, turbulent swings in relationships.

ambiguity: As with Mars, 7th house versus Libra is not separated.
classical_check: Silent for tides; classical Moon in the 7th gives attractive, emotional partners, which loosely agrees.

hindi: सुनामी अगर यह नेगेटिव ग्रहों के साथ हो तो ज्वार भाटा सुनामी दे देता है। यह नेगेटिव ग्रह है।
says: If the Moon is with negative planets, the tide becomes a tsunami, a destructive wave.
ambiguity: 'These' malefics are unspecified.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with Moon afflicted by malefics giving emotional turmoil.

gist: Says positive planets and signs must be known; Jyotish is a very complicated and heavy subject.

hindi: बुध जो है हवा का वेद, बुद्धि की मलिनता, वाणी का तेज। बुद्धि को मलिनता गंद बोलता है।
says: Mercury in this seat gives impurity of intellect (dirt) and sharp speech; he names the dirt in the mind as the defect.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's speech and mind soil in the 7th by dealings and gossip; sign shows form: Gemini and Virgo verbal and critical, Libra diplomatic, Scorpio cutting.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Gemini on the 7th gives quick sharp speech that tends to gossip in partnerships.
Derived: Mercury in Scorpio on the 7th gives cutting, secretive speech.

ambiguity: 'हवा का वेद' is garbled (possibly air-speed); 7th house versus Libra not separated.
classical_check: Silent; classical Mercury in the 7th is usually good for trade and speech, which differs.

hindi: फालतू की बकवास बातें जिसमें गंदगी डर्ट हो। सम्मान के विपरीत विरुद्ध बात करना घटिया बातें करना गिरी हुई बातें ये चीज बुध के इस राशि के अंदर आ जाने से होता है।
says: When Mercury is in this sign it gives useless dirty talk, disrespectful, low and degraded speech.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Libra by house: 2nd gives foul family speech, 3rd crude writing and media, 7th dirty talk with partners.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Libra in the 2nd gives coarse speech at home.
Derived: Mercury in Libra in the 3rd gives vulgar content in writing and media.
Derived: Mercury in Libra in the 7th gives low talk and quarrels with partners.

ambiguity: 'इस राशि' is read as Libra from the walk; not explicit.
classical_check: Differs: Mercury in Libra is classically a friendly, balanced placement, not foul speech.

hindi: बृहस्पति महाराज कहां है? बृहस्पति अनंत विशालता रिश्तों पे दबाव। वो रिश्ते दबा लेता है। गैबर है। पकड़ता है। दबा के रखता है। पकड़ के रखता है। ये इसकी समस्या बैठती है।
says: Jupiter here brings vastness but puts pressure on relationships: it holds and suppresses them like a Gabbar, and that clinging is its problem.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's expansion in the 7th turns into possessive pressure on partners; the sign changes the style: fixed signs hold longest, fire signs dominate, water signs smother.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio on the 7th holds relationships with possessive intensity.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini on the 7th presses with talk and opinions rather than force.
Derived: Jupiter in Cancer on the 7th, its exaltation sign, smothers partners with care.

ambiguity: 7th house versus Libra not separated.
classical_check: Differs: Jupiter in the 7th is classically good for spouse, though over-expansion is seen in some views.

hindi: आठवां कहां गया? इंद्र महाराज भोग विलास पागलपन की शांति मोह माया भोग और विलास का देवता है यह बढ़ा देता है बहुत ज्यादा ऊंचे लेवल पर और मोह माया भंग कर देता है सबसे पॉजिटिव बात है
says: The eighth planet in his walk is Indra (Uranus): god of enjoyment and luxury, he raises it to a very high level and then breaks attachment to illusion, which he calls the most positive aspect.
ambiguity: 'Eighth' means the eighth in his sequence of planets, not the 8th house.

hindi: इंसान कहता है क्या रखा है संसार में क्या रखा है मोह माया कुछ नहीं रखा सब चीजों में भोगो छोड़ नहीं दो ऐश करो ये वो वाला है यानी ये बेपर परहेजा हो जाता है अय्याश हो जाता है मस्ती मारता है
says: This Uranus makes the person say there is nothing in the world, enjoy everything, enjoy fully, so he becomes unrestrained, a pleasure-seeker having fun.
cells_derived_method: The 7th stands for appetites with others; the sign shapes the form: Taurus and Libra sensuality, Gemini variety, Scorpio intensity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Taurus on the 7th gives a sensual appetite for food, comfort and partners.
Derived: Uranus in Gemini on the 7th gives a restless appetite for variety and new contacts.

hindi: एक होता है कुछ नहीं रखा छोड़ दो त्याग दो ये त्याग तयुग का चक्कर नहीं है इसे बोले आने दे कोई शर्म कर तेरे तेरे घर में भी बीवी बच्चे हैं। बोले छोड़ परे वो भी हैं। ये वाले भी बच्चे हैं।
says: There is renunciation (nothing is worth it, give it up) and there is Indra's version: this is not saintly Tyag, it is a shameless 'bring it on'; he says even with a wife and children at home, leave that, these are my children too.
ambiguity: The dialogue with an unnamed person is garbled; the point is hedonism that disregards family, not renunciation.

hindi: ये ऐसा अय्याश और खराब कर देता है। इसका ये नियम तोड़ने वाला बन जाता है। गंदा कहते हैं जिसको सामाजिक दृष्टिकोण से पर ये इसकी ऐश प्रस्थिती है। इसीलिए वहां इंद्र स्थापित होता है।
says: This makes him debauched and a rule-breaker, called dirty by society, though to Uranus it is simply his state of luxury; that is why Indra is established in that seat.
ambiguity: 'वहां' is read as the 7th seat of Varuna.

hindi: अब हम संसार के अंदर के जितने बड़े-बड़े पैसे वाले लोग हैं कसीनो रन कर रहे हैं। बड़े-बड़े क्लब्स चला रहे हैं। यार इतना वैभव है उनके पास। मतलब इंद्र के महल जैसा सुख है।
says: The world's rich people who run casinos and big clubs enjoy a splendour like Indra's palace, which he links to this Uranus influence.
ambiguity: Link to a chart cell is not stated.

gist: Illustration: huge casinos in Las Vegas with amazing lighting and money flowing like liquor.

hindi: ऐसी अय्याशी करने वालों के पास क्यों धन दे रखा है ईश्वर ने? ये ईश्वर के टोटके बड़े निराले हैं। वो कहता है बेटा तुझे माया चाहिए। तो माया का अंतहीन अंबार लगा दूंगा। कृपा चाहिए। कृपा का अंतहीन अंबार लगा दूंगा।
says: Why does God give wealth to such pleasure-seekers? Because God grants what you ask: ask for maya and you get an endless heap of it, ask for grace and you get an endless heap of grace.

gist: Start of an anecdote about Swami Yogi Paramanand; cut off at the end of the slice.

hindi: स्वामी है आप देख के चलिए कमाल अंधाधुंध दुनिया भक्त भक्तों की तरह पीछे पड़ी है अब कौन से अमीर है वो पैसा है कहीं वो तो खाली है भाई साधु सन्यासी है कंगाल आदमी है धन से तो लेकिन दूसरी संपदा कितनी बड़ी है
says: Illustration of Varuna's grace: a swami with no money has another kind of wealth so large that the world runs after him like devotees; grace need not come as cash.
ambiguity: Continuation of an anecdote that started at the end of the previous slice; the swami is not identified.

hindi: तो ये संसार में परमात्मा का देने का तरीका निराला है इंद्र देगा तो ऐसे देगा कहेंगे तू क्लब क्या है तू भाई तू बिल्डिंग बिल्डिंग बना तू पूरे होटल बना होटल के होटल ट्रंप के ट्रंप टावर्स हैं
says: When Indra (Uranus) gives, he gives through clubs, buildings and whole hotels like Trump Towers, with so much money that it would not end even if burned.
ambiguity: A named business example, not a chart cell.

gist: Audience asks where Venus is after Indra, since Indra was eighth and Venus is ninth; he answers it is the 2nd house and Libra.

hindi: तुला राशि शुक्र हो गया तो सौंदर्य यात्रा समुद्री यात्रा वगैरह बहुत कराता है शुक्र का ये स्थिति हो पॉजिटिविटी बहुत है धनवान बहुत बनाता है
says: Venus in Libra, its own sign, gives beauty, much travel including sea travel, a very positive position that makes the person very wealthy.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Libra is in its own sign for any house; house sets the field: 2nd family and finances, 4th home comforts, 9th fortune and foreign journeys, 12th overseas stays and pleasures.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Libra in the 2nd gives wealth through speech, art or trade and a refined family life.
Derived: Venus in Libra in the 9th gives good fortune and long sea or foreign journeys.
Derived: Venus in Libra in the 12th gives comfort and pleasure abroad, with spending on luxury.

ambiguity: 'The second house' remark may point at Venus owning the second sign Taurus as well; he did not elaborate.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus in its own sign Libra is strong and gives comfort, beauty and wealth.

gist: Meta: he says wealth was already discussed and he repeats it so a snapshot appears that people can view easily.

hindi: मौज मजा रंग रंग मस्ती
says: Venus in this seat also gives enjoyment, fun, colour and playfulness.
ambiguity: A list of qualities with no verb, taken as the end of the Venus description.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus signifies pleasure and colour.

hindi: फिर शनि महाराज है तुला में शनि का प्रभाव खजाना
says: Saturn in Libra gives treasure; he begins the Saturn entry with the idea of stored wealth.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Libra (exalted) by house: 2nd and 11th hold the treasure, 10th gives lasting status, 7th gives a stable, orderly partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 2nd builds a steady bank of savings.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 10th gives durable authority and a fair-minded career.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is exalted in Libra and gives gains with discipline.

hindi: इसकी सबसे बड़ी बात है यह अपनी ही विचित्र राय होती है मतलब सात नंबर का शनि यदि हो जाता है मान लो सातवें घर शादी में तो ऐसे लोगों को होता है शादी हो सकता है रुचि ना हो शादी के प्रति के छोड़ो क्या रखा है शादी काम के प्रति हो
