says: The biggest trait of Saturn in the seventh position is its own odd opinion; in the 7th house, marriage, such people may have no interest in marriage and say what is in it, while being keen on work.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 7th delays or cools marriage; sign adjusts this: Libra (exalted) gives a principled opinion, Aries (debilitated) gives bitter views, Capricorn/Aquarius own signs give duty without warmth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Saturn in Libra on the 7th gives a fair-minded, independent view that may skip or postpone marriage.
Derived: debilitated Saturn in Aries on the 7th gives a bitter or dismissive view of marriage.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn on the 7th gives a dutiful, work-first attitude to marriage.

ambiguity: 'काम के प्रति' may mean work or desire; the sentence is unclear. Seventh number could be Libra or the 7th house, he says both.
classical_check: Agrees with classical Saturn in the 7th giving delay or lack of interest in marriage.

hindi: तुला राशि में शनि का प्रभाव न्याय खजाना शनि महाराज हो गए तो शनि इसकी विचित्र राय होती है क्योंकि सर्वोत्तम मतलब वरुण के पास सर्वश्रेष्ठ श्रेष्ठ फल ही शनि महाराज का है।
says: Saturn in Libra stands for justice and treasure, and its odd opinions arise because in Varuna's seat Saturn gives its very best fruit.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn gives its best results in Libra (exaltation).

hindi: सेकंड नंबर प्लूटो का है। मृत्यु भी कहती है कोई बात नहीं जी दे। शानदार मौत होती है बंदे के पट्ठे की। लाजवाब
says: Second best fruit in that seat belongs to Pluto: even death says no problem and gives, so the native has a splendid end. A tradition claim about the manner of death, not a date or prediction.
ambiguity: 'Second number' is read as second in the ranking of fruits; it could also mean the second house.

gist: Restates that Saturn in Libra has an odd opinion, especially about marriage.

hindi: ऐसे लोग अगर नाइंथ हाउस में हो गए धर्म स्थान में तो कहते हैं कुछ नहीं रखा हिंदू धर्म में कुछ नहीं रखा। मुस्लिम धर्म में कुछ नहीं रखा। इसमें उसमें भाई किस में रखा है? नया धर्म है अपना। हमारी अपनी राय बनेगी।
says: Saturn of the Libra type placed in the 9th house of dharma makes the person say nothing is in Hinduism or Islam and build his own faith and opinion.
cells_derived_method: Same Saturn-in-Libra opinion, moved to the 9th house of religion and belief; sign changes the flavour: own-sign Capricorn/Aquarius gives a disciplined, conservative religion instead, Aries debilitation a rejecting one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 9th gives a strict, orthodox faith, the opposite of rejection.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 9th gives a reformist, universal outlook on religion.
Derived: debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 9th gives hasty rejection of tradition.

ambiguity: 'Such people' is Saturn with Libra's nature; whether he means Saturn in Libra in the 9th or Saturn simply in the 9th is not explicit.
classical_check: Silent; classically Saturn in the 9th gives a doubting or unorthodox attitude, loosely agreeing.

hindi: काम ऐसे नहीं वैसे करो। 10वें घर में शनि सात सात नंबर का हो गया। ऐसे लोग कहते हैं दो नंबर क्या है तीन नंबर का काम करते हैं अपन तो उसमें भी नोटों का अंबार है। भगवान तो दो नंबर पे पाप मानता है ना।
says: Saturn of the Libra type in the 10th house gives people who say number-two (black) money is nothing, they do number three, four and six work and still pile up notes, even though God counts number two as sin.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Libra in the 10th is the career house: unorthodox methods and a grey-money tolerance. With own-sign Capricorn or Aquarius the career is orthodox and honest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 10th gives a lawful, patient career.
Derived: debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 10th gives career friction and rule-bending.

ambiguity: Recorded as his claim about moral attitude; no endorsement of tax evasion or crime.

hindi: क्योंकि ये कहता है मैंने अंधा देना है। ब्लैंक ब्लाइंड तू क्या करता है? लेनदेन नहीं मतलब ऐसे ऐसे बेवकूफ लोगों को देखा है। हमने सफल होते हैं जो हम सोच रहे हैं बेवकूफ है। कि इनको सफलता मिल क्यों रही है? ये वो कृपा है।
says: Reason: Varuna says I will give blind, unconditionally; so even fools succeed and people wonder why; that success is grace, not a transaction.

hindi: अगर आप ऐसा स्वभाव ला सकते हैं कि ब्लैंक छोड़ते हैं, ईश्वर पे छोड़ते हैं, न्यायप्रिय करते हैं कि हां ये सही है। मैंने गिल्ट लानी ही नहीं। आपके ऊपर शनि सात नंबर जैसे स्वभाव का ओपनिंग ऑन हो जाएगी और वहां से धन आएगा।
says: Remedy: if you adopt the attitude of leaving things blank to God, judging it as fine and feeling no guilt, the Saturn-seventh nature switches on in you and money will come.
ambiguity: Advice to feel no guilt about right and wrong is his claim and is recorded without endorsement.

hindi: यह जुगाड़ का देवता है। जो लोग कहते हैं नहीं यार पैसे नहीं है। रात को सो गए। अब देखी जाएगी यार सुबह पता नहीं कहां से पैसे आ गए। ये वो सात नंबर का शनि है। ये आप ऑन कर सकते हैं। आपकी कुंडली में ऑन हो चाहे ना हो।
says: This Saturn is the god of jugaad: you sleep saying there is no money and by morning money arrives from nowhere; and you can switch it on whether or not it is active in your chart.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that the effect can be switched on regardless of the chart is his own.

hindi: राहु महाराज तुला राशि में राहु शक्ति दूर दृष्टि धोखा। धोखा भी ये देता है। धोखा क्रिएट करता है। पता ही नहीं।
says: Rahu in Libra gives power, far-sightedness and deception; it also creates deception without anyone being aware.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Libra by house: 7th business and partner deceit, 10th scheming ambition, 12th foreign hidden dealings, 2nd misleading speech.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 7th gives powerful, far-seeing but deceptive partners or deals.
Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 10th gives ambitious, strategic career moves with a risk of deception.
Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 2nd gives persuasive, misleading speech about money.

classical_check: Classically Rahu in Libra is often considered favourable (friendly Venus and Saturn sign) so the deception emphasis is his own.

hindi: सूरज मुंडी देख रही है। राहु देख रहा है। समुद्र को पता ही नहीं है।
says: Rahu, the head, watches while the sea does not even know; the watcher is unseen, the watched unaware. The caption is garbled.
ambiguity: 'सूरज मुंडी' may be the Sun-head image or a caption error.

hindi: सात नंबर का अपूर्णता जिद्दी नियम का पक्का महाजिद्दी होता है। ऐसा मनुष्य जो करना है करना है। नहीं करना नहीं करना है।
says: The seventh-position Rahu person is incomplete, stubborn and rigid about rules, very obstinate: what he decides to do he does and what he decides not to do he never does.
cells_derived_method: Obstinacy shows by sign and house: in fixed-sign houses it is immovable, in movable signs it is a rigid rule enforcement.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 1st gives a rigid self-image and obstinate personal rules.
Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 10th gives rigidity in career rules and policies.

ambiguity: Seven number is read as Libra; he does not separate it from the 7th house.

hindi: ऐसे में राहु व्यक्ति कोई महाजिद्दी इस टाइप की राशि का हो या राहु के स्वभाव में महाजिद्दी हो उसको पिघाले कैसे? बॉस महाजिद्दी है। अडियल सडियल मानता नहीं। तो उसको इल्लुजन देनी है आपने। इल्लुजन का देवता है राहु।
says: To melt a very stubborn person, such as a boss, you must give him an illusion, because Rahu is the god of illusion.
ambiguity: A practical tactic framed through Rahu rather than a ritual.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as illusion is classical.

hindi: उसको दारू की बोतल दो। कैसा विचित्र काम होता है कि लोग कहते हैं भाई शराब चलती है वहां पार्टी में। यह भाई जो बड़े-बड़े अफसर हैं इनको दारू की बोतल दे दो। काम हो जाता है। ये कैसे होता है? ये राहु है।
says: Give the stubborn person a bottle of liquor; big officers get their work done that way, and it works because liquor is Rahu. Recorded as his claim; not an endorsement of bribery or drinking.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as intoxicants is classical.

hindi: उनका राहु यहां से शिफ्ट किया कि तेरे बारे में फैसला नहीं तेरे से दारू आ गई। अरे अरे पापा घर आए हैं। राहु शनि का एजेंट है। तो ये पापा है इसके।
says: The liquor shifts his Rahu away from judging you; and Rahu is Saturn's agent, so Saturn is its father, with the 'papa has come home' joke.
ambiguity: Garbled; the Rahu-Saturn agent relation is clear, the dialogue is not.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu acts like Saturn in classical texts.

hindi: राहु बियर है, वििसकी भी है और राहु का राहु बेटा है तो पापा शनि है। शनि हो गई दारू की।
says: Rahu is beer and whisky, with Saturn as its father, so Saturn becomes the master of liquor.
classical_check: Rahu for liquor is classical; Saturn as its master is his own.

gist: Keep the liquor bottle coming home, the officer is pleased and says your work will be done, no tension.

hindi: दो नंबर का काम क्या है? दो नंबर की लक्ष्मी क्या है? सारी की सारी शनि है। शुक्र साथ में है।
says: Number-two (black) work and black-money wealth are all Saturn, with Venus alongside.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn for hidden and unaccounted money is a modern reading.

hindi: क्या काम होगा? राहु के पास ठीक रहता है। दारू अगर आपका लिवर पचा रहा है। ठीक है। खाना खा के भी लोगों के लिवर फेल होते हैं। मौत तब भी आती है क्योंकि सांस लेते हैं हम। यह सब तो बातें बनी हुई है। हमारे माइंड ने कुक कर लिया है कि इससे ऐसा होगा। यह इल्लुजन है। यह राहु है।
says: Alcohol is fine with Rahu so long as your liver handles it; the fear that it harms is a mind-made illusion, which is Rahu. A health remark of his, not advice.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged, not a recommendation.

hindi: आपको शक है। आपको वहम है। चरित्र पे वहम है। शुक्र का दोष है। भगवान पे वहम है। वरुण का दोष है। काम करने वाले नौकर चाकर के ऊपर दोष है। अपना शनि का वहम है।
says: Suspicion maps to planets: doubt about someone's character is a Venus defect, doubt about God is Neptune's, and doubt about servants and workers is Saturn's.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as servants is classical, the others are his mapping.

hindi: ये साले ये चोर है। ये गलत है। मंगल खराब है। आप हमेशा कहोगे डॉक्टर साला चोर है। ये चोर है। ये गलत है। लूटता है।
says: When Mars is spoiled you always suspect doctors of being thieves who loot you.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as the surgeon and doctor karaka is classical.

hindi: ये लुटेरा है। बृहस्पति का दोष हो सारे पंडित पुजारी सर धर्म लुटेरे हैं। ये ये दोष बनता है। जिस पर वहम आ जाए ये उसको खराब कर देता है।
says: With a Jupiter defect you suspect all pandits, priests and religion of looting you; and whoever is the target of such suspicion is spoiled by it.
ambiguity: The last sentence generalises: the suspicion damages the suspected person.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as priests and religion is classical.

hindi: जी सात नंबर आप जहां पे होश में वहां पे काला धागा पहुंचने तो अब ये सात नंबर अभी धागे की बात पर आएंगे हम थोड़ी देर में। पर वो एक नंबर को मार देगा।
says: A black thread is wanted where the seventh position acts, to be explained shortly; but the seventh influence will strike the 1st number. Caption is garbled.
ambiguity: Garbled; whether it is the 7th house or Libra, and whether the 'one number' is the 1st house or the first planet, is unclear.

hindi: तभी तो शनि बिाना होता है। काले धागे से ही उपाय होता है इसका सारा और रेयर केस में लाल मंगल बैठाते हैं वहां हम। अभी बात करते हैं इसकी।
says: Remedy: the black thread (Saturn) is the remedy for all this, and in rare cases a red (Mars) thread is set there; details promised later.
ambiguity: 'वहां' is not named; it is the position under discussion.
classical_check: Silent; black thread as a Saturn remedy is a popular, not classical, practice.

gist: He thinks all planets are done, asks what is left; the seventh remains.

hindi: केतु केतु बादल छुपा हुआ ज्ञान है। बैलेंस बनाता है। केतु ज्ञान देता है बहुत तगड़ा।
says: Ketu in the Libra seat is the cloud of hidden knowledge; it creates balance and gives very strong knowledge.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in Libra by house: 5th gives deep mantra and intuitive wisdom, 9th occult philosophy, 12th liberation insight.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Libra in the 5th gives hidden wisdom and past-life mantra memory.
Derived: Ketu in Libra in the 9th gives deep, unorthodox philosophy.
Derived: Ketu in Libra in the 12th gives insight toward liberation and solitude.

ambiguity: Seventh seat read as Libra; earlier Ketu lines were about the 7th house.
classical_check: Agrees with Ketu as knowledge and moksha karaka; the balance idea is his.

hindi: नेपच्यून अपनी राशि में सातव राशि में सातवें राशि का नेपच्यून वरुण देवता जब सातवें नंबर सात नंबर राशि में कहीं पर भी है
says: Neptune sits in its own sign, the seventh sign Libra, in his scheme, wherever in the chart that sign falls.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Libra by house: the house gives the arena in which Neptune's grace and illusion work; 7th partnership, 10th career, 12th spirituality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Libra in the 7th gives idealised, spiritually tinted partnerships.
Derived: Neptune in Libra in the 10th gives a career of art, healing or hidden service.
Derived: Neptune in Libra in the 12th gives strong spiritual grace and escapist tendencies.

ambiguity: A garbled audience line ('उल्टा वरुण') interrupts; Libra as Neptune's sign is stated in his scheme, not classically.
classical_check: Silent: Libra is Venus's sign classically; Neptune as co-lord is his scheme.

hindi: आपका छह नंबर का है तो सात को आस्पेक्ट कर सकता है आठ है तो सात को थोड़ा आस्पेक्ट करेगा एक नंबर भी आस्पेक्ट करेगा दो भी करेगा और 12 भी करेगा तो छह राशियां हैं जो सात को आस्पेक्ट करेंगी थोड़ा-थोड़ा
says: Neptune in the 6th can aspect the 7th, and from the 8th aspects the 7th slightly; the 1st, 2nd and 12th also touch it, so six signs or houses aspect the seventh a little each.
cells_derived_method: Wide-orb aspect: Neptune adjacent to or around the 7th touches it. Results then depend on what the 7th holds: a Libra 7th receives it as grace, others as idealism or confusion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in a Virgo 6th touches the 7th and brings service-based, healing-flavoured partnerships.
Derived: Neptune in its own-type Pisces 12th touches the 7th with deep spiritual idealism toward partners.

ambiguity: He lists five positions (6, 8, 1, 2, 12) and says six; the sixth (the 7th itself) is presumably included.
classical_check: Silent: classical aspect is full on the 7th only, so the wide-orb idea is his own.

hindi: तो सबसे बड़ी बात क्या होगी आपके जीवन में कहीं ना कहीं स्पिरिचुअल इच्छा होगी। यानी संसार में 12 खानों के आधे लोग हमने यह फिक्स कर दिए कि इनके मन के अंदर स्पिरिचुअलिटी के प्रति आकर्षण है।
says: Result: somewhere in life there will be a spiritual desire; since half of the 12 boxes fall under Neptune's reach, half of all people are fixed as having an attraction to spirituality.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next slice ('therefore somewhere every person...').

hindi: के अंदर यह अनंत को जानने की इच्छा। अरे क्या है संसार? आखिर क्या होता है यार? कृपा कहां से मिलती है? इसमें आधी दुनिया तो गई। ये तो नेप्च्यून कर रहा है।
says: The desire to know the infinite, what the world is and where grace comes from, is Neptune's doing, and it catches half the world.
ambiguity: Continues the sentence about half the houses at the end of the previous slice.
classical_check: Silent; spiritual longing is classically Ketu, Jupiter and the 12th house.

hindi: चाहे कैसे भी हो जाए। छह राशियां तो ये काम कर ही रहा है। इसलिए हम सब बड़े अज्ञात को जानने के विषय में रहते हैं। हम सबके मन में इच्छा रहती है। अनजाना क्या है? सत्य क्या है? संसार क्या है?
says: Whatever the chart, Neptune is working through six of the twelve signs, which is why all of us have a curiosity about the unknown, truth and the world.
ambiguity: 'Six signs' refers to the wide-orb aspect on the 7th given earlier.

hindi: और नेप्च्यून की एक खासियत है। यह अनलिमिटेड है। इसलिए यह धन देगा अनलिमिटेड। चोरी कराएगा अनलिमिटेड। दारू पिलाएगा अनलिमिटेड। प्यार कराएगा अनलिमिटेड।
says: Neptune is unlimited in nature, so it can give unlimited money, unlimited theft, unlimited drinking and unlimited love.
classical_check: Silent: classically Rahu is the planet of excess and unlimited desire.

hindi: अनैतिक संतान पैदा करता है। अनैतिक संबंध बनाएगा। अनैतिक बच्चे पैदा करके उनके उनका माता-पिता भी बन जाएगा। अनैतिक पत्नी अनैतिक दोस्त हर किस्म की चीजें रखेगा। क्योंकि यह थोड़ा नहीं इसे विशालता चाहिए।
says: Neptune can bring illegitimate children, improper relationships, an unconventional wife and friends of every kind, because it wants vastness, not a small amount.
ambiguity: 'Immoral' is his word; recorded as his claim about conventional norms.

hindi: इसलिए जब भी आप अपने बच्चों के डांट डपट रहे हैं कि बेटा तू क्या कर रहा है? गंदे दोस्तों के साथ रहता है। तो उसकी कुंडली के नेप्च्यून को चेक कराओ कि उसके वरुण देवता की स्थिति है क्या? वो किसके किस ग्रह के साथ बैठा है?
says: When scolding a child for bad company, check Neptune in his chart: its position and which planet it sits with.
ambiguity: Which positions or conjunctions mean bad company is not given here.
classical_check: Silent; classically the 5th house and Rahu/Mercury are checked for children's company.

hindi: क्योंकि हो सकता है उन्हीं के रास्ते वो साधु बने। उन्हीं के रास्ते एनलाइटेंड हो। उन्हीं के द्वारा ही ज्ञान प्राप्ति करें और उनके साथ रहने मात्र से ही नोट छापे।
says: Those same strange friends may be the route by which the child becomes a sadhu, gets enlightened, learns, or even earns money by being in their company.

hindi: आपको हो सकता है आपका सेवक ही कृपा दे रहा हो। जब तक वो साथ है तब तक आप जो डील करते हो काम हो जाते हैं। इसलिए वो ज्यादा इंपॉर्टेंट है आपके लिए।
says: The grace in your life may be coming through your servant; while he stays with you your deals work out, so he is more important to you than you think.
ambiguity: Link to Neptune is implied from the preceding grace theme.
classical_check: Silent; classically servants and staff relate to Saturn and the 6th house.

hindi: ये लेकिन छोटी चीज से संतुष्ट नहीं होता। भयंकर पावरफुल देवता है।
says: Neptune is not satisfied with small things and is a fearsomely powerful deity.

hindi: जन्मत्री में होता तो कहीं नहीं है। हां यही तो लफड़ा है हमारे वैदिक सिस्टम में दिखाते हैं। इंद्र वरुण यम की राशियों का कोई उल्लेख ज्यादा नहीं क्योंकि इसके बारे में वैदिक साहित्य में वैदिक ज्योतिष में ज्यादा उल्लेख ही नहीं है। ये वेस्टर्न फिलॉसफी वेस्टर्न ज्योतिष में बहुत ज्यादा मान्यता है इसकी।
says: Indra, Varuna and Yama (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) are not shown in the traditional Vedic horoscope or its literature; they are heavily recognised in Western astrology, which is why signs of these three get little mention in the Vedic system.
classical_check: Agrees: classical Jyotish uses only the nine grahas, Sun to Ketu.

hindi: इन तीनों ग्रहों के पास नक्षत्र नहीं होते। ये नक्षत्र एक अलग कहानी है। बहुत लंबी खिचड़ी है। इसलिए इनकी दशाएं नहीं आती कभी भी।
says: These three planets have no nakshatra rulership, so they never get dashas.
classical_check: Agrees: Vimshottari dasha lords are the nine grahas only.

hindi: 84 साल के लिए तो इंद्र आता है। 150 साल के लिए मोटा-मोटी तौर पर इससे ज्यादा ही बल्कि हमारे नेप्च्यून महाराज आते हैं और 250 साल के लिए तो इतनी तो एक दशा आएगी तो ये इसी में बीत जाएगा।
says: If given dashas they would be far too long: Uranus about 84 years, Neptune roughly 150 or more, Pluto about 250, so a single dasha would swallow a whole life.
ambiguity: The 250 years is read as Pluto's; the caption does not name it.
classical_check: Orbit periods: Uranus 84, Neptune about 165, Pluto about 248 years, so the figures are roughly right.

hindi: इसलिए 20 साल का शुक्र है ये तो पूरी जिंदगी खत्म हमेशा रहता है। तो 20 साल का शुक्र आता है। सबसे छोटा हमारा सूर्य आता है छ साल के लिए। फिर दशाएं बदलती रहती है। तो प्रेडिक्शन कहां से होगी?
says: The longest Vimshottari dasha is Venus at 20 years and the shortest is the Sun at 6; dashas keep changing so prediction is possible, whereas a 84 to 250 year dasha would never change.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus 20 years, Sun 6 years in Vimshottari.

hindi: यह प्रधानमंत्री है तो यही है कई जन्मों तक। तो इसलिए इनको नक्षत्र ना होने की वजह से दशाएं अलॉट नहीं की गई है क्योंकि इनके बहुत सूक्ष्म असर हैं और लगातार चलने वाले असर हैं।
says: If one of them were the prime minister it would stay so for many lifetimes; so since they have no nakshatra they get no dashas, because their effects are very subtle and continuous.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no reason; this is his explanation.

hindi: आपको कई बार पैर की तकलीफ हो रही है सात साल के लिए रहेगी तो ये इंद्र के क्लेश है। अब सात साल तक आप लड़ते क्लेश करते रहोगे, दुखी होते रहोगे, रोते रहोगे।
says: A leg or foot problem that lasts about seven years is Indra's (Uranus) trouble, and for those seven years one quarrels, suffers and weeps. A tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Uranus stays about seven years per sign. Foot trouble reads from the 12th house and Pisces by the body scheme, so Uranus passing through a person's 12th or Pisces fits his example best.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Pisces in the 12th is where the seven-year foot trouble would fit best (tradition claim, not a diagnosis).
Derived: Uranus in the 6th with Virgo would show the seven-year trouble as conflict and work or health stress instead.

ambiguity: He does not say which house or sign the Uranus must be in.
classical_check: Uranus takes about 7 years per sign, so the 7-year duration is astronomically right; the foot link is his own.

hindi: ये रोक दो। इसलिए ज्ञान है। परमानेंट इलाज है ना इनका। स्टोन पहनो इनका। इसका स्टोन एककोमरीन है। ब्लू एककोमरीन पहना जाता है।
says: Remedy: stop this by wearing the gemstone, a permanent fix for these planets, which he names as blue aquamarine.
ambiguity: 'इनका' and 'इसका' could be Indra or the three outer planets; aquamarine is traditionally a Neptune stone.
classical_check: Silent: aquamarine is not a classical gem.

hindi: अगर यह पहनते हो तो रिलीफ की स्थिति बनेगी आपके शनि महाराज की उंगली में पहनो इसको। ब्लू एककोमरीन स्टोन है इसका।
says: If you wear the blue aquamarine, relief follows; wear it on Saturn's finger, the middle finger.
ambiguity: Saturn's finger is the middle finger in the usual convention.
classical_check: Middle finger for Saturn gems is the standard convention.

gist: Says threads, donations and tattoo remedies will be discussed shortly.

hindi: अब वरुण देव एक नंबर राशि के अंदर जाते हैं। नेपच्यून खुद क्या कर रहा है? नेप्च्यून हमारा यहां हृदय चक्र है। सागर है। अब ये सागर जो है ये अग्नि के पास जा रहा है। नाभि पे।
says: Neptune in the first number sign is the sea (heart chakra) moving next to fire at the navel, the Aries/Mars zone.
cells_derived_method: Aries is the fire sign and the 1st house is the self, so Neptune there puts water on the body's fire. Other signs on the 1st change the fire/water balance: a water-sign 1st absorbs it well, an air-sign 1st disperses it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Cancer in the 1st makes water meeting water, with no fire to quench, giving emotional and imaginative selfhood.
Derived: Neptune in Leo in the 1st puts water on the strong fire of the Sun's sign, diluting confidence.

ambiguity: 'One number sign' is Aries by his numbering; he also treats it as the 1st house. Both are read as Aries in the 1st.
classical_check: Silent; Aries is classically the head, not the navel, so the navel link is his.

hindi: अब सागर जब नाभि पे जाएगा तो क्या करेगा? नष्ट कर देगा इसको। नष्ट करके क्या करेगा? सारी आग बुझा देगा। सारी आग बुझाने के बाद सत्यानाश।
says: When the sea reaches the navel fire it extinguishes all the fire, and after that comes ruin: Neptune in Aries snuffs out the person's drive and digestive fire.
ambiguity: Digestive fire versus ambition fire is not separated; he uses both images.

hindi: तो यदि आपके पेट के अंदर उल्टी-पुल्टी आग भी बुझी हुई है तो नमक का पानी आपको दिया जाता है। लेकिन यह भोगने योग्य नहीं होता। समुद्र का पानी बिल्कुल नहीं पिया जा सकता। तो नमक थोड़ी सी मात्रा में देते हैं ताकि थोड़ी बैलेंसिंग हो जाए। उसके साथ विटामिन सी, नींबू इत्यादि डालते हैं।
says: If the stomach fire is put out, doctors give salt water, but sea water cannot be drunk, so a little salt with vitamin C and lemon is given to balance. A medical remark, not advice.
ambiguity: Health analogy; no dosage or diagnosis is given and none is endorsed here.

hindi: पर अन्यथा आप मान के चले समुद्र का पानी नाभि पे गया आपकी डेथ है। मार ही देगा देर समय। डिहाइड्रेट करता है। पानी को सोख के खत्म कर देगा।
says: Otherwise, in his picture, sea water reaching the navel means death, dehydrating the body slowly. An image of the damage to the vital fire, not a prediction of anyone's death.
ambiguity: Not a death or medical prediction; flagged.

hindi: क्योंकि यह अग्नि के ऊपर पानी डला नष्ट जिसका नेप्च्यून एक नंबर राशि से इनफ्लिक के टच करता है। यानी 12 नंबर दो नंबर एक सात आठ और छह।
says: Neptune in the first sign touches or afflicts the 12th, 2nd, 1st, 7th, 8th and 6th, the same wide-orb spread he gave earlier.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 1st reaches these six houses by wide aspect; the topic hit follows the house: 12 loss and sleep, 2 family and speech, 7 spouse, 8 hidden things, 6 enemies and health.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune's touch on a Scorpio 8th blurs hidden resources and gives secret or confusing inheritance matters.
Derived: Neptune's touch on a Taurus 2nd dilutes the family wealth and gives vague speech.

ambiguity: The list matches the earlier six-house spread; reading is mine and the caption here is run-on.
classical_check: Silent: classical drishti is full on the 7th only.

hindi: अगर इनके साथ टच करके इस पर आता है बहुत उग्र स्वभाव का व्यक्ति रहेगा। बहुत क्लेशी रहेगा। उसके नेचर में जहां जहां पर वो बैठा है वहीं क्लेश।
says: A Neptune that comes touching these houses in Aries makes a very fierce, quarrelsome person, with conflict in the area of whichever house it sits in.
cells_derived_method: Aries Neptune brings conflict to the house topic: the house number tells where.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Aries in the 10th brings conflict at work and with superiors.
Derived: Neptune in Aries in the 9th brings quarrels over beliefs and with father or teachers.

ambiguity: 'Touch' is unclear: conjunction, aspect or house relation. It is read from the next line as sitting in a house.

hindi: लग्न में बैठा खुद क्लेशी, दूसरे नंबर घर के लोगों से क्लेशी, तीसरा भाई बहनों से, चौथा माता से क्लेश, पांचवा बच्चों से, छठा शत्रु से, पत्नी पत्नी या पति ऐसे ऐसे इसकी नेचर के अंदर युद्ध ये युद्ध ही करेगा।
says: Neptune in Aries by house gives conflict with: self in the 1st, family in the 2nd, siblings in the 3rd, mother in the 4th, children in the 5th, enemies in the 6th and spouse in the 7th; the nature is warlike.
cells_derived_method: Each house names who the quarrel is with, using the usual significations: 1 self, 2 family, 3 siblings, 4 mother, 5 children, 6 enemies, 7 spouse. The other houses follow the same logic: 8 in-laws, 9 father or guru, 10 bosses, 11 friends, 12 hidden enemies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Aries in the 4th gives quarrels with mother and about home peace.
Derived: Neptune in Aries in the 7th gives conflict with the spouse and partners.
Derived: Neptune in Aries in the 11th gives conflict with friends and social circles (same logic extended, not said by him).

ambiguity: He lists houses 1 to 7 only and trails off; it is taken as Neptune in Aries in each house.
classical_check: House significations are standard classical ones; the quarrel link is his.

gist: Repeats the warlike note: 'brother, my business is to fight.'

hindi: दो नंबर का रहेगा। खुद भले ही नष्ट हो जाओ। दूसरों को स्वभाव बचाने वाला करके चलेगा।
says: Neptune in the second position has a self-sacrificing, protective nature: even if he is destroyed himself he saves others.
cells_derived_method: Taurus 2nd places Neptune in Venus's sign in the house of family and resources; the protector instinct is directed first at family, then dependents.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Virgo in the 2nd gives a protective service to family through practical care and sacrifice of own money.
Derived: Neptune in Sagittarius in the 2nd gives a generous, over-giving protector with speech full of ideals.

ambiguity: Is it the 2nd house or Taurus, the second sign? Both coincide in the natural chart.

hindi: दूसरे के लिए सौंदर्य के लिए कार्य करने वाला, सुख के लिए कुछ भी करने वाला, जल्दी प्रसन्न, जल्दी रुष्ट। तो बहुत छोटे बच्चे की तरह होता है। बहुत मस्त मलंग स्वभाव होता है।
says: He works for others' beauty and comfort, will do anything for pleasure, pleased and angered quickly, childlike and carefree.
ambiguity: Continues the 2nd-position description; still the second-position Neptune.

hindi: धनवान बहुत बनाता है। रूपवान होता है। ऐसे लोग लोग लोग इससे बहुत ज्यादा अट्रैक्ट होते हैं। लाइकेबल व्यक्तित्व हो जाता है इसका बहुत।
says: Neptune in the second position makes the person wealthy and good-looking, strongly attractive to others and very likeable.
cells_derived_method: Wealth and looks come from the 2nd house (wealth, face) and Taurus (Venus). With other signs on the 2nd the charm remains but the wealth changes in form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Gemini in the 2nd gives charm through speech and income from words, with less solid savings.
Derived: Neptune in Leo in the 2nd gives a striking face and dramatic wealth that flows in and out.

classical_check: Silent; 2nd house for wealth and face is classical.

hindi: तीसरे नंबर का हो जाता है तो तीन नंबर मिथुन राशि है। मिथुन राशि में एक लड़का लड़की दिखा जाते हैं। दो ऐसा मान के चलें आप। तो ऐसे व्यक्ति अकेले नहीं रह सकते। या उल्टा असर होगा तो एकाकी ही रहेंगे।
says: Neptune in the third position, Gemini (the sign of the boy-girl pair), makes people who cannot live alone; or with the reverse effect they stay alone.
cells_derived_method: Gemini is the twin sign so Neptune there needs a companion; the 3rd house is siblings and courage. Other signs on the 3rd lose the twin symbolism: a Capricorn 3rd would be solitary and driven.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Libra in the 3rd also seeks a partner but through balance and diplomacy rather than twinning.
Derived: Neptune in Capricorn in the 3rd tends to solitary effort, losing the need for company.

ambiguity: Third number, Gemini and the 3rd house are used together.
classical_check: Silent; Gemini as the pair sign is classical.

hindi: डुअलिटी का देवता है ये। हाइपर कंफ्यूज यह करूं वो करूं ना करूं।
says: This Neptune in Gemini is the god of duality: hyper-confused between doing this or that or nothing.

hindi: कम्युनिकेशन बहुत जबरदस्त होती है इनकी बातचीत करने में लाजवाब लेकिन फालतू की बातें भी बहुत करेंगे हर समय पटने पटाने की इच्छा में ही रहते हैं ये कि ऐसी स्थिति बन जाए कि पट जाऊं या पटा लूं
says: Their communication is superb and conversation excellent, but they also talk a lot of nonsense and are always trying to win someone over or be won over.

hindi: यानी यार बंदे के साथ बात हो जाए रिलेशनशिप बन जाए कैसे ना कैसे ये बंदा काम आ जाए एक मजे की बात समझ लीजिए नेप्च्यून देवता वो है जो आपको ग्रांट करता है सारी विशेस अब आप किसी बंदे से मिले ये तीन नंबर के नेप्च्यून की बड़ी खतरनाक बात है
says: They always hope to start a relationship so this person may prove useful; and Neptune is the deity who grants all your wishes, so when you meet someone thinking he may be useful, that wish gets granted, which is the dangerous side of Neptune in the third.
ambiguity: The sentence runs from 57:02 into 58:05; the story that follows explains it.

gist: Meta: the slide says only 'madly in love'; not everything can be written, only the broad points.
Story: a man comes to meet you, hands over his card, your work gets done, and he says call me if you need anything; he is a jail superintendent; you say that is a very useful man and keep the card.

hindi: अब देवता ने सुन ली बात। कमांड हमेशा जा रही है। कमांड जा चुकी है परमात्मा के पास। आप जो बोल रहे हो वो कमांड है। हमेशा याद रखो। अब आपने कमांड दे दी। ये काम आएगा। तो अब आपको जेल जाना पड़ेगा।
says: The deity has heard it: whatever you say is a command that always goes to the Divine; by saying this man will be useful you commanded it, and now you must go to jail to need him. Remember what you say.
ambiguity: A cautionary story about careless speech, not a statement about jail in charts.

gist: Story end: you ask God what you did to deserve this; God says you kept a dangerous man's card as useful, and there he will be useful; the line is cut off at the slice end.
Joke ending the jail-superintendent story: do not make him wash toilets, he is our acquaintance; the jail trip is complete.

hindi: तो यह बड़ा ध्यान से देकर चलिए कि यह ऐसी स्थिति में मनुष्य ने ईश्वर से क्या बोल दिया? अपने मन में क्या अंतर मन में मांग लिया? क्योंकि यह यहां काम कर रहा है।
says: With Neptune placed this way, be very careful what you say to God or ask for in your inner mind, because Neptune works exactly there and grants it.
cells_derived_method: The inner-mind wish power is Neptune's; the house sets the area where the casual wish tends to materialise: 3rd skills and contacts, 7th partners, 10th work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a careless wish about partners by Neptune in Libra in the 7th would show up in partnership matters.
Derived: a casual remark about career by Neptune in Capricorn in the 10th would show up at work.

ambiguity: 'Such a position' continues the third-number Neptune of the previous slice; the caution applies to Neptune generally.

gist: Claim that the three nadis and a c-cubed electromagnetic pulse are formed at the heart chakra, which is dangerous because you may wish for something by accident.

hindi: वेस्ट डायरेक्शन का अधिपति है। अगर वहां पर बैठे आपने चाह लिया तो ये ग्रांट हो गई। विश पूरी होएगी। और हमें पता ही नहीं हमने मांगा क्या था।
says: Neptune (Varuna) rules the west direction; a wish made while seated in the west is granted, and we often do not even know what we asked.
ambiguity: Vastu link; no chart cells are given. 'Sitting there' means sitting in the west of the room or house.
classical_check: Agrees: Varuna is the classical Vastu lord of the west.

gist: Second story: you keep a doctor's card thinking he is a great neurosurgeon who will be useful; he ends up operating on your own child's head.
Story ending: you thank the doctor for being there at the right time, since without the operation a small injury would have ended the child.

hindi: हम मांग बैठते हैं कैसे हमें पता नहीं। इसलिए बड़ा खतरा है। कभी मत सोचो ये मेरे काम आएगा। वही आएगा।
says: Remedy: never think that this person will be useful to me, because exactly that need will come about; we ask without realising it, which is the danger.

hindi: अगर कोई बंदा भी आपको आकर कह दे ना भाई साहब हम उस पद पर बैठे हैं हम करेंगे काम आपका तो बोलो भैया वह जहां बैठा है मैं उसी से करा लूंगा मैं भीख मांगूंगा उससे मांगूंगा तुझसे के मांगना
says: Remedy: if someone says he holds a post and will do your work, reply that you will get it done from the one above him, whom you will beg, and not ask the middleman.
ambiguity: 'The one where he sits' is read as the higher power.

hindi: अब लोग कहेंगे वो भी तो ईश्वर के रूप में आया है हां तो उस टाइम भी उसी को कॉल लगा लेना उसे कॉल लगाना सीखना यह नेप्च्यून है
says: If people say the helper too is God's form, then call God even at that time; learning to call the source is Neptune.

gist: Audience question about taking a goat along with you, answered yes; the caption is garbled and its link to the topic is unclear.

hindi: जब वो पॉजिटिव कर मेष में खतरनाक हो जाता है भ्रष्ट हो जाता है एडिक्ट होता है दारूबाज होता है
says: A negative Neptune in Aries becomes dangerous, corrupt, an addict and a drunkard.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Aries by house: 1st self-destructive habits, 5th speculation and children, 8th hidden vices, 12th isolation with substances; positive Neptune turns the same energy into inspiration.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: negative Neptune in Aries in the 1st shows addiction as a personal trait and weak self-control.
Derived: negative Neptune in Aries in the 8th hides the addiction and brings secretive vices.
Derived: negative Neptune in Aries in the 12th gives escape into drink or drugs and isolation.

ambiguity: The beginning of the sentence is garbled ('जब वो पॉजिटिव कर'): which condition makes Neptune negative is unknown.

hindi: और यह दवाइयों का एडिक्शन होती है इसको। इसको दवाई खानी ही खानी है। यह पेन रहता है बॉडी में इसके और यह पेन किलर खाता ही खाता है। एक नंबर का नेप्च्यून वाला।
says: This Aries Neptune person becomes addicted to medicines, has body pain and keeps taking painkillers. A tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health claim; recorded as his statement only.

hindi: अब जब जिन दिनों में ये अगर वक्री पैदा वक्री था जन्म के समय और वक्री ही के साथ जीवन भर चला है। तो इसकी बॉडी के अंदर यह हाल होगा कि जबजब मार्गी होगा तब-तब गोली खाएगा। तो कम बीमार पड़ेगा।
says: If Neptune was retrograde at birth and the person lives with it retrograde, then in the periods when it turns direct he takes pills, and he falls ill less. The last clause is unclear.
cells_derived_method: The retrograde-at-birth versus direct-in-transit contrast applies to any sign; sign Aries sets the aggressive, medicated form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune retrograde in Aries in the 1st at birth gives a person whose health and drive swing with each direct phase.
Derived: Neptune retrograde in Aries in the 6th at birth ties the pill-taking phases to work stress and illness periods.

ambiguity: Sentence about 'ill less' contradicts 'takes pills'; possibly meant he is sick less when retrograde. Health claim, not advice.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not treat Neptune, and retrograde-at-birth reversal logic is his own.

hindi: जबजब मार्गी होगा उस उस टाइम अग्रेसिव होगा। बाकी टाइम ठीक होगा। विपरीत स्वभाव हो गया उलट। और उन दिनों में दवाइयां खाएगा।
says: Whenever Neptune turns direct he is aggressive, at other times he is fine; his nature is reversed, and he takes medicines in those days.

hindi: ऐसे ही दो नंबर का है। बहुत जल्दी प्रसन्न होता है।
says: The same retrograde and direct reversal applies to Neptune in the second position, who is naturally very quickly pleased.
ambiguity: Second number is the 2nd house or Taurus; the next lines tie both.

hindi: लेकिन जन्म के समय से यह व्यक्ति का नेप्च्यून मार्गी वक्री वक्री था। पैदा हुआ। अभी भी पैदा हुआ संसार के अंदर तो वक्री चल रहा है। यह स्वस्थ रहेगा, प्रसन्न रहेगा, सही जलेगा।
says: If this person's Neptune was retrograde at birth and is retrograde now, he will stay healthy and happy and run well.
cells_derived_method: Same retrograde phase applied to the 2nd house Taurus: speech and finances stay steady while Neptune moves retrograde.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Neptune in Gemini in the 2nd would keep speech and income steady and cheerful during retrograde phases.
Derived: retrograde Neptune in Virgo in the 2nd would keep habits and food intake orderly during retrograde phases.

ambiguity: Garbled 'direct retrograde' wording; it is read as retrograde at birth and retrograde now.

hindi: जैसे ही मार्गी होगा इसका स्वभाव गंदा हो जाएगा। जब मर्जी हर किसी से लड़ मरेगा, हर समय पैसे के लिए टीटी करेगा, महालालची हो जाएगा। पैसे की हाय-हाय मचाएगा, रिश्तेदारों से घर वालों से लड़ेगा।
says: As soon as Neptune turns direct his nature turns foul: he fights with everyone, nags for money, becomes extremely greedy and quarrels with relatives and family.
cells_derived_method: Greed and family quarrels follow the 2nd house of money and family; with other signs the greed takes a different form, Gemini through trade, Leo through status.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: direct Neptune in Gemini in the 2nd gives quarrelsome talk about money with relatives.
Derived: direct Neptune in Leo in the 2nd gives greed tied to status and showy spending.

hindi: पत्नी से विशेष तौर पे खूनम खान करने को राजी होगा और गाली बके बिना बात नहीं करेगा। यह गाली गलौज बहुत करते हैं। दो नंबर आठ नंबर वाले पति या पत्नी ये विशेष तौर पे संबंध के अंदर मित्रों के साथ गाली बके बिना बात नहीं करते। ये समस्या बन जाती है।
says: Especially with the wife he turns violent (the caption word is garbled) and speaks only with abuse; spouses with the second and eighth positions swear at partners and friends, which becomes a problem.
cells_derived_method: The 2nd (speech) and 8th (conflict, in-laws) shape abusive speech; Neptune's pulls then move it to partners and friends. With a gentle sign on the 2nd the abuse is lighter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Libra in the 2nd softens the abuse into sarcastic charm.
Derived: Neptune in Scorpio in the 8th makes the abuse sharp, wounding and secretive.

ambiguity: 'खूनम खान' is garbled (maybe bloodshed or murder in words); not read as a literal prediction. 'Two number, eight number' could be signs or houses.

hindi: यह वक्री और मार्गी हर जगह चलेगा। उलट चलेगा।
says: The retrograde and direct contrast applies in every placement and works in reverse of what one expects.

hindi: कर्क राशि का हो जाता है तो इसकी जिंदगी भर का यह हाल होगा कि यह विटामिन ही लेता रहेगा। चार नंबर का राशि के अंदर जब यह आता है नेप्च्यून तो यह दवाइयों पर चलता है। दवाइयां लेता रहता है।
says: Neptune in Cancer, the fourth sign, makes a person who lives on vitamins and keeps taking medicines all his life. A claim about habit, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Cancer by house: 4th and 1st give a lifelong supplement habit at home and on the body; 6th ties it to chronic health care.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Cancer in the 1st makes medicine-taking part of the person's identity.
Derived: Neptune in Cancer in the 6th makes health routine and prescriptions a constant thread of daily work.

ambiguity: Health claim, flagged; fourth number taken as the sign Cancer.

hindi: यानी कि एक मान के चलो कि आपने पानी साफ पानी के अंदर समुद्र का पानी डाल दिया। तो जो साफ सुथरा पानी था उसका भी नाश पीट दिया आपने। बर्बाद करके रख दिया। उस पानी का भी अस्तित्व खत्म कर दिया। अब वो पानी भी पीने योग्य नहीं रहा। डाइल्यूशन जरूर हो गई। नेपच्यून हल्का पड़ गया।
says: Neptune in Cancer is like pouring sea water into clean water: the clean water is spoiled and undrinkable, but Neptune is diluted and becomes weaker.

hindi: हल्का पड़ने से यह स्थिति है कि इसका उग्र स्वभाव कम हो गया। इसका तूफानी वेग खत्म हो गया या कम हो गया तो यह ज्ञान बहुत सुंदर ले गया तो बड़ा प्रोटेक्टिव हो जाता है। बड़ा ध्यान देने वाला
says: Once diluted, Neptune in Cancer loses its fierce, stormy nature and becomes protective and very attentive.
cells_derived_method: Cancer's Moon nature turns Neptune into a carer; by house the care is aimed: 4th at the home, 5th at children, 7th at the partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Cancer in the 4th makes a protective, home-minded person who nurtures the family.
Derived: Neptune in Cancer in the 5th makes a protective, attentive parent.

hindi: समुद्र नाश भी करता है। समुद्र यात्रा का कारक भी है। एक देश से दूसरे देश ले जाओ। समुद्र ही लेके जाता है। समुद्र में ही खनन होता है
says: The sea destroys but is also the significator of sea travel, carrying people and goods from one country to another, and of mining from the sea.
classical_check: Silent; classically the 12th house and the Moon are tied to sea travel.

hindi: तो ये शांत हो जाता है। यानी देने वाला बन जाता है। सबकी प्रोटेक्शन करता है। सबका ध्यान देता है। विटामिंस बनाता है। खाने पे विशेष ध्यान देता है।
says: A calmed Neptune becomes a giver who protects and watches over everyone, makes vitamins and pays special attention to food.
ambiguity: Calming is tied to the Cancer dilution just described.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति को यूजुअल तौर के ऊपर प्रोसेस्ड फूड पसंद आता है। ये फास्ट फूड लवर्स होते हैं। उन्हें कहते हैं पका पका दे देना। कौन इतना काम करे? आलस हो रखा है भाई।
says: Such a person usually likes processed and fast food and wants everything ready-cooked, being too lazy to prepare it.
ambiguity: Seems to contradict the line about special attention to food; he offers no resolution.

hindi: बस यूं खचखच खा लिया। कौन तोड़े, भिगोए, डुबोए, खाए। यह बड़ा परेशानी किया हिसाब किताब। पेशेंस की कमी। लेकिन बहुत सुंदर होता है।
says: They eat whatever is quick, without breaking, soaking or preparing it; patience is lacking, but the person is very beautiful.

hindi: घर में सीलन, कीड़े मकोड़े इत्यादि होते हैं ऐसे व्यक्ति के जरूर। नेपच्यून कहीं ना कहीं दूषित है। घर में सीलन आएगी आएगी। चंद्रमा दूषित है।
says: Such a person's home will have dampness and insects, which shows Neptune is afflicted somewhere and the Moon too.
ambiguity: A household sign linked to the planets; no house or sign is stated.

hindi: घर में सीलन आएगी। यदि यह नेगेटिव राशि के होंगे तो सीलन देंगे ही देंगे। हर हालत में। घर में किसी एक मेंबर का है और नहीं है दूसरे का। घर में एक में आदमी का है तो उसी की वजह से होगा सबको।
says: If Neptune or the Moon is in a negative sign, dampness will certainly come; it may come from one member's chart only, but the whole house suffers because of him.
ambiguity: 'Negative signs' are not listed.

hindi: और जब जब सीलन आएगी उसका ही सत्यानाश होगा। जहां उसकी कुंडली में चंद्रमा और वरुण बैठे हैं। उस स्थान के ऊपर उसको तकलीफ आएगी। ये आनी ही आनी है।
says: Whenever dampness arrives, the person whose chart causes it is hurt in the area of life where his Moon and Neptune sit.
cells_derived_method: The trouble appears in the house where the Moon and Neptune sit, by that house's topic: 4th home, 7th spouse, 10th career, 12th losses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon and Neptune in the 4th in Cancer bring trouble at home and to the mother.
Derived: Moon and Neptune in the 7th in Libra bring trouble in marriage and partnerships.
Derived: Moon and Neptune in the 10th in Aries bring trouble in career and public standing.

ambiguity: Whether conjunction or just both being placed in a house is meant is unclear.

hindi: घर के जो साइनस पेशेंट होते हैं ना उनके घरों में अक्सर नॉर्थ वाली बेल्ट नॉर्थ वेस्ट नॉर्थ ईस्ट और नॉर्थ इसके अंदर सीलन आएगी वहां कहीं ना कहीं पानी का लफड़ा होएगा थोड़ा बहुत सीलन आ जाएगी जरा सी पपड़ी उखड़ गई आनी ही है
says: In the homes of sinus patients dampness often appears in the north belt (north, north-west, north-east), with some water problem and peeling plaster. A Vastu link; the health part is not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Vastu observation joined to a health condition; no chart cells given.
classical_check: Agrees in part: north is the Vastu direction of water, though the sinus link is his own.

hindi: वो जिनके चंद्रमा दूषित हो जाते हैं उनके घर की मोटर ही खराब रहती है बिटिया है घर में घर से चली गई शादी ब्याह के बाद सब बढ़िया जिस घर में कहीं वहां पानी कुएं का पानी सूखने लगते हैं। खराब हो जाता है। नया कुआं खोदना पड़ता है।
says: Those with an afflicted Moon have home water pumps that keep failing; the daughter in the house leaves after marriage and things improve, while in her new home the well water dries up or goes bad and a new well is needed.
ambiguity: No afflicted-Moon criteria are given beyond the word 'afflicted'.
classical_check: Silent; Moon rules water classically, so the link is traditional in spirit.

hindi: जब वो फिर मम्मी के पास घर में आती है दोबारा पानी की मोटर खराब हो जाती है। ऊपर डंकी में कबूतर मर जाता है। पता नहीं क्या होता है। जब भी ये घर में आती है पानी का लफड़ा शुरू हो जाता है। वो जाती है ठीक हो जाता है।
says: When that daughter returns to her mother's house the water pump breaks again and a pigeon dies in the tank, and as soon as she leaves it is fixed: her afflicted Moon is activated by her presence.
ambiguity: Anecdotal evidence, not a stated rule with chart cells.

hindi: ये इतने पावरफुल होते हैं ग्रह। एक के कारण सभी को कोरोना हो जाता है।
says: Planets are so powerful that, because of one person, everyone in the house can fall ill with Covid. A claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged; the planet is not named, the context is the afflicted Moon and Neptune.

hindi: जो लड़कियां ब्या के आती है उस घर का हो जाता है और के उसके ये 100% सत्य है। बल्ले बल्ले हो जाता है। राजा को रंक रंग को राजा बनाते हैं।
says: A bride's own chart changes the fortune of the house she marries into; he calls it 100 percent true, for she can make a king a pauper or a pauper a king. The caption is partly garbled.
ambiguity: Which part of her chart drives it is not stated here; the next lines point to the 7th house.
classical_check: Silent; classically the spouse's chart affects fortunes through the 7th and 2nd houses.

hindi: ये कई लड़कियों की पत्री ऐसी आती है जिसके सप्तम भाव में ग्रह खराब है। नीच है, बुरा है, नेगेटिव है, नेगेटिव राशि का है। तो उसको मैं पहले ही कहता हूं राजा से ब्याओगे कंगाल हो जाएगी।
says: For girls whose 7th house holds a bad planet (debilitated, malefic, negative or in a negative sign) he warns beforehand: if married to a rich man she will turn him into a pauper.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated or negative planet in the 7th hits spouse and wealth; the damage depends on which planet and its sign: debilitated Saturn in Aries delays and chills, debilitated Moon in Scorpio brings emotional upheaval, debilitated Mars in Cancer brings domestic aggression.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 7th gives a late or cold marriage and a heavy burden on the spouse's money.
Derived: debilitated Moon in Scorpio in the 7th gives an emotionally turbulent partner.
Derived: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 7th gives domestic friction that drains the family's wealth.

ambiguity: 'Negative sign' is not defined; no specific planet named.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: afflicted 7th houses harm marriage and the spouse's fortune; the 'pauper' outcome is his addition.

gist: Joke: girls reply there is no horse, no prince coming with a sword, which is what every girl wants.

hindi: अब समस्या क्या होती है इसकी कुंडली में योग है नहीं तो पता लगा वो 35 साल तक बैठी है शादी नहीं हो रही क्यों राजकुमार आ ही नहीं रहा सारे प्लंबर है अब प्लंबर से शादी उसने करनी नहीं
says: The problem is that her chart has no yoga for a prince, so she stays unmarried at 35 because only modest suitors, in his words plumbers, come and she will not marry them.
ambiguity: Case example; the planet or chart condition is not stated, only that the 7th has no good yoga.
classical_check: Agrees that a weak or afflicted 7th delays marriage.

hindi: तो उसके उपाय करने पड़ते हैं सप्तम भाव के और उसकी बुद्धि भ्रष्ट करने के बुद्धि भ्रष्ट करने के बहन इस प्लमबर को ही देख तलवार की जगह इसके पास रिच रिच लगा हुआ है
says: Remedy: do remedies for the 7th house and also redirect her mind, so she accepts the modest suitor, saying look, instead of a sword he has a wrench. The slice ends mid-sentence.
ambiguity: 'Corrupting her mind' means changing her expectations; the 7th-house remedies themselves are promised later. Cut off at the end of the slice.
classical_check: Silent; 7th-house remedies are classical in general.

gist: Fragment of an anecdote: a cycle tied below, a 'princess' told to marry and go home; this is fate. No placement or rule stated.

hindi: वो 90% से वो शादी नहीं करती जो उससे शादी करना चाहते हैं वो सारे छोड़ दिए और खुद उसकी चॉइस का मिलना नहीं वो मिलना ही नहीं है चॉइस का लड़का मिलेगा ही नहीं
says: For the placement he was just describing (house/sign not identifiable in this slice, Neptune-type effect), a woman rejects nearly all suitors who want to marry her and the partner of her own choice never turns up, so marriage stays unfulfilled.
cells_derived_method: Marriage-denial effect is tied to whichever house carries the Neptune-type placement; if it falls on the 7th or on the 2nd/4th/5th the unreachable-ideal-partner theme shows in that house's department (partner, family, romance).

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Libra: an idealised spouse is imagined, real proposals feel inadequate and are refused.
Neptune on the 5th in Leo: romantic fantasy; the chosen love interest does not materialise as a spouse.

ambiguity: Preceding slice is missing; the house and sign he is describing are not stated here. He may be finishing the 4th-house Neptune description.
classical_check: Classical texts do not speak of Neptune; the unreachable-partner theme is his own extension.

hindi: और शनि नेपच्यून जैसे लोग हो गए तो कई लड़के मिल जाएंगे उसको शादी करते रहेंगे टाइम पास होता रहेगा बर्बाद हो जाएगी
says: If the partners are Saturn-Neptune type people, she gets many boys, keeps entering marriages and time-pass relationships, and ends up ruined.
cells_derived_method: Saturn+Neptune combination (conjunction or influence) turns the house it falls on into a repeated, unstable, escape-type affair; read through that house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Saturn and Neptune together on the 7th in Capricorn: a string of partners or short marriages, none lasting.
Saturn-Neptune on the 11th in Aquarius: many friendships and affairs, social time-pass, nothing settles.

ambiguity: 'Shani Neptune jaise log' could mean Saturn and Neptune placed together, or men with those natures; unclear.
classical_check: No classical source for Neptune; Saturn alone delays marriage, he reverses this to plenty of partners.

hindi: पांचवा उम्मीदों पर पानी फिर जाना झूठी शान शौकत शनि के घर पे नेप्च्यून महाराज
says: Fifth item: Neptune on the 5th brings hopes washed out and false show and pomp; he words it as Neptune in a Saturn sign, which is probably a caption slip for Leo.
cells_derived_method: 5th is children, romance, intelligence, speculation; a Neptune dissolving effect deflates hopes in whichever of these topics the house carries. In sign terms Leo/Sun gives pomp that is hollow, Saturn signs would give cold bleak hollowness.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 5th in Leo: big claims of talent or children's future, hopes dissolve.
Neptune on the 5th in Aquarius (Saturn's sign, if he did mean Saturn): hollow idealism about children and education.
Neptune on the 10th in Leo: showy career status that proves illusory, public image fades.

ambiguity: 'शनि के घर' contradicts the Sun metaphor in the next sentence (sea poured on sun); the 5th = Leo/Sun's sign is more consistent. Sign number vs house number is also open.

hindi: समुद्र को आप सूरज पे डाल डाल रहे हैं सोच के चलो एक बाल्टी लेकर के तो कैसा होगा समुद्र सूखता ही चला जाएगा नष्ट ही हो जाएगा सारी शानो शौकत झूठी रहेगी
says: Analogy: Neptune (sea) placed in the Sun's sign is like pouring a bucket of sea onto the sun; it keeps evaporating and vanishes, so the whole show of glory proves false.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Leo reads as dissolving of Sun matters (status, authority, father, heart); in other signs the dissolving shows in that sign's nature instead.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in the lagna Leo: personality glamour evaporates, authority is not trusted.
Neptune on the 9th in Aries (Sun exalted sign): a dream of leadership and fortune that is undone.
Neptune on the 5th in Leo: pride in intelligence and children comes to nothing.

ambiguity: Whether he means the 5th house or Leo sign as such is not separated.

hindi: मनुष्य अपने बाल बच्चों से परेशान रहेगा उसको लड़की को एग की प्रॉब्लम और लड़के को स्पर्म की प्रॉब्लम स्पर्म काउंट की सेक्सुअल प्रॉब्लम रहेगी संभोग द्वारा संतान नहीं होगी आईयूआई आईवीएफ कराना पड़ेगा
says: With this 5th-house Neptune the person is troubled by children; he links it to egg problems in a woman and sperm-count problems in a man, so conception needs IUI or IVF. This is a medical-type claim from tradition, not advice.
cells_derived_method: Fifth-house affliction by a Neptune-type planet shows as trouble with children; sign decides flavour (water signs: fluid/hormonal, fire: vigour lost, earth: structural).

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 5th in Leo: heavy worry over children, medical help needed to conceive.
Neptune on the 5th in Scorpio: reproductive-system trouble flavour, delayed or assisted conception.
Neptune on the 5th in Pisces: children come but are a source of anxiety and confusion.

classical_check: Classical texts give 5th lord/Jupiter afflictions for children; Neptune is his addition. Medical statement, flagged.

hindi: पांचवा घर जब भी डिस्टर्ब होगा नेचुरल सेक्स के द्वारा संतान नहीं होगी
says: General principle: whenever the 5th house is disturbed, children will not come by natural conception.
cells_derived_method: Applies to the 5th house in any sign; the disturbing planet nature picks the reason (Saturn delay, Mars loss, Rahu/Neptune confusion or assisted route).

derived_examples.reading: Saturn on the 5th in Taurus: conception delayed; natural route long and slow.
Mars on the 5th in Scorpio: pregnancy loss risk.
Rahu on the 5th in Virgo: unconventional/assisted conception route.

ambiguity: He gives no threshold for what counts as 'disturbed'.
classical_check: Classical putra-bhava affliction yogas agree in spirit; 'only assisted' is stronger than texts.

hindi: उनको टेस्ट ट्यूब बेबी पे जाना ही पड़ेगा यानी संभोग के द्वारा संतान नहीं देगा। अगर पांचवा घर ख़राब है।
says: Such people must go the test-tube-baby route; the afflicted 5th will not give children through intercourse.
cells_derived_method: Same afflicted-5th principle; the route (IUI/IVF) is his reading of a blocked natural conception.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted 5th in Cancer: Moon-ruled house, fertility fluids affected; assisted route.
Afflicted 5th in Capricorn: long delay then medically assisted birth.

classical_check: Not in classical texts (they predate IVF); he modernises putra-sthana affliction.

hindi: यदि पांचवा घर खराब है तो यह स्थिति पक्की है कि संतान यदि गलती से कंसीव हो गई तो आप बर्थ कंट्रोल पे लोगे। कोई ना कोई हालात बनेंगे संसार में जीवन के और बच्चा आपको गिराना पड़ेगा। नहीं तो मिसकैरज होगा। खराब होगा।
says: With a bad 5th, if conception happens by accident either you will end up using birth control or circumstances will force termination, otherwise it ends in miscarriage. Stated as certain; this is a tradition-style outcome claim.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted 5th with a malefic of Mars/Saturn/Rahu type shows pregnancy loss; benefic aspect softens. Sign: fire/Mars signs sudden loss, water signs emotional loss.

derived_examples.reading: Mars on the 5th in Aries: abrupt pregnancy loss.
Ketu on the 5th in Pisces: karmic non-continuation of pregnancy, miscarriage themes.
Saturn on the 5th in Aquarius: repeated delay, termination for circumstantial reasons.

ambiguity: 'पक्की है' (certain) is a strong claim with no conditions on aspects.
classical_check: Classical texts allow abortion/loss of progeny from 5th afflictions; certainty is his.

hindi: राजा से रंग रंग से राजा। ऊंचे-ऊंचे सपने हाइपर एंबिशियस टका कुछ करना नहीं होना कुछ है नहीं। लेकिन बातें इसमें बड़ी-बड़ी होंगी।
says: Nature of this Neptune-in-Leo person: swings from king to pauper and back, sky-high dreams and hyper-ambition, but nothing actually done; only big talk.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in a Sun sign gives grandiose self-image; across houses it inflates that house's field: career (10), gains (11), speculation (5), self (1).

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in lagna Leo: grandiose self-image, talks of kingly plans, little execution.
Neptune on the 11th in Leo: large gain targets that never materialise.
Neptune on the 10th in Leo: a position claimed bigger than delivered; rise-and-fall career.

ambiguity: Not clear if this is Neptune in Leo or the whole 5th-house Neptune.

hindi: मात्र वक्री होने पर वक्री होने पे पॉजिटिव कर देगा थोड़े दिनों के लिए और मार्गी हो के फिर डाउन कर देगा।
says: Retrograde Neptune makes the effect positive for a short spell; when it turns direct it pulls the person down again.
cells_derived_method: Retrograde phases give temporary relief for the Neptune house; direct motion brings the negative effects back. Which house swings depends on the placement.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune retrograde on the 5th in Leo: short good spell in romance/children matters, then a slump on direct.
Neptune retrograde on the 10th in Capricorn: a brief career lift, then it sags when direct.

ambiguity: 'मात्र' may be a caption slip; he says the retrograde effect is only a temporary positive.
classical_check: Classical texts give retrograde planets strength (cheshtabala); his claim that retro helps temporarily differs from Neptune-as-malefic framework.

gist: Audience question about life going good then bad, recovering, then slipping after two years, building a business and losing it in months; he calls it a lovely question.

hindi: इसीलिए इलाज चाहिए। ये सारे जो पिंग पोंग है ये वक्री मार्गी का चक्कर है।
says: The ping-pong of good and bad times in life is a retrograde/direct cycle of the planet, which is why a remedy is needed.
cells_derived_method: Alternating periods tied to a planet's retrograde and direct stations; the house the planet holds decides which area swings.

derived_examples.reading: Retrograde Mars on the 2nd in Taurus: wealth up and down with stations.
Retrograde Saturn on the 10th in Aries: work stalls then restarts with stations.

classical_check: No classical backing for station-driven swings; his own explanation.

hindi: इसलिए वक्री ग्रह का स्टोन सीधा पहन लो। पहनना बहुत जरूरी है।
says: Remedy: wear the gemstone of the retrograde planet directly, and he says wearing it is very important to stop the swings.
cells_derived_method: Applies to any retrograde planet; the stone is chosen by the planet, not by house or sign.
ambiguity: Does not say if stone applies to Neptune (no standard gem) or any retrograde planet.
classical_check: Classical texts caution gems for malefic or functional-malefic planets; blanket advice differs.

hindi: कन्या कन्या राशि में अंतर्दृष्टि हो जाती है।
says: Neptune in Virgo gives inner insight and intuition.
cells_derived_method: Virgo (Mercury/Rahu sign in his scheme) gives analytical clarity and sees through illusion; in different houses the insight is directed at that house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 6th in Virgo: insight into disease, service and enemies.
Neptune on the 10th in Virgo: intuitive handling of work and public matters.
Neptune on the 2nd in Virgo: insightful speech about wealth and values.

ambiguity: He says 'Virgo sign' but sits it as the sixth item; sign vs house six not separated.

hindi: राहु के घर पे ये आए हैं तो राहु के घर जब समुद्र आ गया तो क्या कह रहा है? पूरा खजाना दे रहा है। ज्ञान देता है। राहु के पास ज्ञान है। सारी इल्लुजन क्लियर, सारी क्लेरिटी, क्लियर पॉइंट बोलना आ गया।
says: Neptune in Rahu's sign (Virgo) gives the whole treasure: knowledge, illusions cleared, clarity, and ability to speak a clear point.
cells_derived_method: Rahu-ruled Virgo gives Neptune cleared illusions; in other houses the clarity applies to that house's subject.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 6th in Virgo: clear understanding of debts, health and service.
Neptune on the 3rd in Virgo: clear writing and communication.
Neptune on the 9th in Virgo: clarity of philosophy and teaching.

ambiguity: Rahu as Virgo lord is his scheme; classical texts give Mercury only.
classical_check: Classical texts differ: Virgo lord is Mercury only.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति को गर्दन के ऊपर रॉकेट होता है और गर्दन के नीचे बीमार।
says: The person is a rocket above the neck (brilliant mind) but unwell from the neck down.
cells_derived_method: Virgo is the 6th natural sign (health), so Neptune gives sharp brain with weak body; the body part afflicted tracks the house where the planet sits.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 6th in Virgo: sharp mind, chronic weak body.
Neptune in lagna Virgo: brilliant intellect, delicate constitution.

ambiguity: Medical-type claim; flagged as tradition.

hindi: उसे बीमार होना ही है और उसकी बीमारी की सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम ना वह दवा से ठीक होता ना दारू से।
says: The person will definitely fall ill, and the illness neither responds to medicine nor to liquor. Medical-type claim from him, not advice.
cells_derived_method: Chronic hard-to-diagnose illness is read from the 6th sign/house touched by Neptune.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 6th in Virgo: persistent obscure ailment resistant to treatment.
Neptune on the 8th in Scorpio: hidden chronic illness; diagnosis unclear.

classical_check: Texts speak of 6th house disease but not of drug resistance.

hindi: ये दोनों सिंथेटिक चीज दवा और दारू ये नेप्च्यून की है। सारे दारू के बिनेसेस के पास है। शनि के बाद यानी बड़े-बड़े ठेके। शनि दारू की बोतल है तो ये ठेका है पूरा।
says: Karaka statement: medicine and liquor, both synthetic items, belong to Neptune; liquor businesses are under it. Saturn is the bottle, Neptune is the whole liquor shop.
cells_derived_method: Neptune as karaka of drugs, synthetic liquids and liquor trade; the house it occupies shows where this matter enters (6 disease, 10 trade, 12 intoxication).

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 10th in Pisces: career around liquor, drugs or chemicals.
Neptune on the 12th in Aquarius: pull toward intoxicants and escape.

classical_check: Classical texts give Saturn/Rahu for liquor; Neptune is a modern addition.

gist: Mentions Stephen Hawking as an example (sharp mind, disabled body) and says he cannot comment without seeing Hawking's sign.

hindi: लेकिन उसकी लाइफ के अंदर हर समय छोटी-छोटी चीज की रेजिस्टेंस होगी दवाई लेके परेशान ना राय ली किसी से परेशान
says: In life there is constant resistance in small things; the person is troubled whether he takes medicine or whether he takes no advice.
cells_derived_method: Resistance in small matters falls on whichever house topic carries the planet; 6th = routine obstacles.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 6th in Virgo: daily-work friction and health obstacles.
Neptune on the 3rd in Gemini: small hurdles in effort and communication.

ambiguity: Garbled ending ('ना राय ली किसी से परेशान').

hindi: लेकिन कवि होते हैं लेखक होते हैं पुस्तक लिखते हैं क्योंकि ज्ञान बहुत ज्यादा है दुनिया भर का ज्ञान आ जाता है
says: The positive side: such people become poets, writers, and book authors because a great deal of worldwide knowledge flows to them.
cells_derived_method: Neptune creative and knowledge aspect works through the 3rd/5th/9th as writing; in Virgo the writing is analytical.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 3rd in Virgo: writer, essayist.
Neptune on the 5th in Pisces: poet, imaginative creator.
Neptune on the 9th in Sagittarius: author of philosophical books.

hindi: सातवें घर में तुला राशि का अपना हो गया तो भैया अत्यंत धनवान है खूब मीठी बातें करेगा फालतू बातें बहुत करेगा। मस्त स्वभाव है। तुझे भी पार्टी कराएगा। इसे भी पार्टी कराएगा। समुद्र जैसा विशाल हृदय होगा।
says: Neptune in its own sign Libra on the 7th: extremely wealthy, sweet talker who also talks a lot of nonsense, easygoing, throws parties for everyone, with an ocean-sized heart.
cells_derived_method: Libra as Neptune's own sign (his scheme: Libra lord Venus or Neptune) shows wealth and generosity; by house the same placement colours that house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Libra: wealthy, generous, partner and public dealings pleasant but loose.
Neptune in lagna Libra: charming, free-spending, generous personality.
Neptune on the 11th in Libra: large networks and gains, lavish hospitality.

ambiguity: 'सातवें घर' as the sign number 7 (Libra) vs house 7; he conjoins both so cell [7, Libra] is used.
classical_check: Libra lord is Venus only in classical texts; Neptune-as-co-lord is his scheme.

hindi: अनैतिक संबंध जरूर बनेंगे। आउटर लाइफ के अंदर बाहर की दुनिया में उसके हर हालत में सेक्सुअल रिलेशन रहेंगे। और हर हालत में पकड़ा जाएगा अपने पार्टनर के द्वारा। यह हो ही नहीं सकता कि उसके पार्टनर को पता ना हो कि उसका रिलेशनशिप है।
says: Immoral relationships will surely form; in outside life he will always have sexual relationships and will always be caught by his partner, who always knows of it.
cells_derived_method: 7th house is spouse and others outside; Neptune there gives secret liaisons exposed through the partner; other houses move the arena: 12th hidden bed pleasures, 5th romance.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Libra: extramarital liaisons that the spouse discovers.
Neptune on the 12th in Libra: hidden affairs in private, exposure through secrecy.
Neptune on the 5th in Libra: romantic entanglements outside commitment.

classical_check: Classical 7th-house afflictions give scandals with partners; 'always caught' is his.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति के बाद भी वो यह कहता है चल कोई बात नहीं ना। तू भी खुश रह ले मैं भी खुश। तो यह अनैतिक संबंध, एक्स्ट्रा मैरिटल रिलेशनशिप्स, मोर देन वन मैरिज ऐसी स्थितियां बना देता है क्योंकि यह ज्यादा का देवता है।
says: Even after being caught the person says it is fine, you be happy and I will be happy; Neptune creates extramarital affairs and more than one marriage because it is the god of excess.
cells_derived_method: Neptune as 'more' planet multiplies marriages and partners when it holds the 7th or the 2nd/11th (family and gain houses).

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Libra: more than one marriage or relationship.

says: Such people are surely heavy drinkers; they take medicines permanently and feel fine only after drinking, so liquor works as medicine for them. Alcohol-dependence and medical claim from tradition, not advice.

hindi: आठ नंबर राशि वाले अक्सर देखेंगे आप उनको पैर के ऊपर अगर चादर नहीं रात को सोते हुए तो पैर ठंडे होने लगते हैं और डरते डर जाते हैं। ऐसे बच्चे होते हैं जो बचपन में सुसु निकल गए बेड के अंदर। ऐसी स्थिति होती है कि डरपोक भी होते हैं। डर गए घबरा गए।

hindi: जहां पर कुंडली में बैठी होगी वहां के बारे में व्यक्ति अनिश्चित रहेगा। काम में काम अनिश्चित। सातवें घर के अंदर बैठा है पति या पत्नी से अनिश्चित। पांचवा बच्चों से प्रॉपर्टी अनिश्चित। पता ही नहीं यार क्या हो रहा है। अनिश्चितता रहेगी। यह अनिश्चितता देता है।

hindi: 11वा तीक्ष्ण बुद्धि यह एक मान के चलो कुंभ कुंभ राशि घड़ा होता है। घड़े के अंदर समुद्र है। सबकी प्यास बुझा जाएगा। इसकी एक खासियत होती है। 11वें नंबर का तीक्ष्ण बुद्धि होता है। विरक्त भी होता है।

hindi: इसके पास दारू होगी तो वो दारू को भी गंगाजल की तरह बांट देगा। गंगाजल होगा गंगाजल भी बांट देगा। इसके लिए ना गंगाजल ऊंचा है ना दारू ऊंची है। ऊंच नीचा कुछ नहीं। सब बराबर एक समान।

hindi: तो ऐसे व्यक्ति अनलाइटन होने लगते हैं धीरे-धीरे। ज्ञान की ओर जाते हैं, विरक्त होते हैं। मोक्ष की इच्छा भी समाप्त हो जाती है ऐसे व्यक्ति की। यह मोक्ष की इच्छा भी समाप्त कर देने वाला है और यह मोक्ष देने वाला है। ऐसे व्यक्ति इतना ज्ञान बांटते हैं

hindi: 12 नंबर राशि में चला जाए। ये केतु का घर है।

hindi: 12 नंबर आप मान के चलें नौ नंबर और 12 नंबर दोनों राशियां यहां पर है हमारे स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र पे और यहीं से जीवन आता है। यही स्पर्म यहीं एग यही मंथ की डेट लड़की की। यहीं से यूरिनरी वाटर कंटेंट जो बॉडी का साफ होता है हमारे शरीर का जल तत्व

hindi: यहां पर जब समुद्र यानी किसी जल देवता आता है तो कितनी शुद्धिकरण कर देता है कितना कल्याण करता है कितना कमाल करता है हमारे जीवन की सेक्स लाइफ अच्छी करता है भोग की लाइफ अच्छी करता है

hindi: सेक्स को सिर्फ संभोग ना समझे हम हमने एक बच्चा बनाया संभोग के द्वारा हमने एक सोफा बनाया ये भी हमारा कॉस्मोस के साथ घर्षण हुआ है हमने एक अलमारी खरीदी हमने एक बिल्डिंग बनाई प्रॉपर्टी बनाई यह सारी की सारी हमारे स्वाधिष्ठान से बनती है और यह जल चक्र है।

hindi: इसलिए इन दोनों राशियों में नेप्च्यून का होना जबरदस्त श्रेष्ठ है। यहां जल ही है। इसके नीचे हमारा धरती का चक्र है भूमि का। यह हमारा जल चक्र है।
says: So Neptune in these two water signs is hugely excellent as it is pure water; below it is the earth (root) chakra and this is the water chakra.

hindi: इसके ऊपर अग्नि इसके चार साइन होते हैं। फायर अर्थ एयर वाटर। एक अग्नि स्थान होता है फायर। यह चार किस्म के होते हैं। एक दो तीन चार ऐसे चलता है। पांच छ सात आठ नौ 10 11 12

says: Its most beautiful effect is in 4, 8 and 12 (water signs/houses), which concludes this part.

says: When fire (Mars) and water (Neptune) meet, a false thing results; Neptune is also the god of falsehood, makes people act, and stage performers have it.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति एक्टर बनते हैं। इतने नौटंकीबाज होते हैं कि कोई भी चीज का एक्टिंग फटाफट मन में ला सकते हैं। छोटे-छोटे बच्चों के अंदर तो रेडीमेड ही है जो नौटंकीबाज होते हैं।
says: Mars-Neptune type (fire plus water) people become actors; they are so theatrical that they can bring any acting to mind instantly, and some small children come ready-made with this drama.

hindi: आर्टिस्ट, रॉबरी क्रिमिनल्स। नेगेटिव हो जाए, तो यह चोरी, चकारी, क्रिमिनल माइंड, कत्ल करने वाले, किडनैपर, मर्डर सब कुछ बन सकते हैं।
says: Such people are artists, even robbers; if the placement turns negative they can become thieves, criminal-minded, killers, kidnappers. This is a character-tendency claim from tradition, not a prediction about any person.

hindi: नेपच्यून शुक्र जब साथ है तो आर्टिस्ट, प्लेयर हमें वैसे सूर्य से शुरू करना चाहिए।
