ambiguity: Death claim about father is a generalisation ('usually'), not a timing rule.
classical_check: Classical Sun afflictions harm father; Neptune addition his.

hindi: लेकिन बहुत नियमावली से चलता है और ज्योतिषी तक बना देता है। क्योंकि सूर्य और नेपच्यून सूर्य उसको केंद्रित करता है। नेपच्यून उस स्थान को पकड़ता है।
says: Despite that, the person lives by strict rules and can even become an astrologer, because the Sun concentrates him and Neptune grasps that place.
cells_derived_method: Sun-Neptune gives disciplined subtle-knowledge skills; house shows the field (9 study, 5 intellect, 8 occult).

derived_examples.reading: Sun and Neptune on the 5th in Leo: self-made astrologer, strict code.
Sun and Neptune on the 8th in Aries: disciplined occult researcher.
Sun and Neptune on the 9th in Sagittarius: rule-bound teacher of astrology.

hindi: तो दोनों के दोनों अपने-अपने अनुसार अपना साम्राज्य फैलाना चाहते हैं। दोनों के रह जाने से एक गज़ब की इल्लुजन क्रिएट होती है। और ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर व्यक्ति के अंदर बहुत जबरदस्त नियमावली भी आती है।
says: Both the Sun and Neptune want to spread their own empire, and together they create a remarkable illusion, alongside very strong rule-following in the person.
cells_derived_method: Mechanism of the pair: two dominating karakas in one house create image-making; the house shows what is dramatised.

derived_examples.reading: Sun and Neptune in lagna Leo: powerful illusory self-image.
Sun and Neptune on the 10th in Aries: public persona larger than reality.
Sun and Neptune on the 11th in Gemini: social image magnified.

hindi: नेपच्यून वरुण देवता है और सूखता जरूर है। घटता जरूर है। लेकिन ये देवता सूर्य की शक्ति के साथ मिल जाने के बाद
says: Neptune as Varuna does dry and diminish near the Sun, but after joining the Sun's power the god gains strength; the effect depends on distance.
cells_derived_method: Sun conjunction shrinks Neptune's flow (like combustion) yet adds power; orb condition follows in the next sentence.

derived_examples.reading: Sun and Neptune close on the 9th in Leo: Neptune's sea dries but gains solar force.
Sun and Neptune close on the 10th in Aries: reduced Neptune flow, strong public power.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut and continues into the next slice.
classical_check: Classical combustion rules agree in spirit.

hindi: अगर 10° के विपरीत अलग-अलग चला गया तो इंडिपेंडेंट कम करते हैं अगर ये 10° के अंदर एक दूसरे के पड़े हुए हैं। यानी मान लो ये 4° का है तो ये 14 के पास ये 24 है और ये चार है तो दूर है। फिर कोई फर्क फर्क नहीं है।
says: Orb rule: Sun and Neptune combine only if within 10 degrees; if they are further apart they work independently. Example: 4 and 14 degrees are together, 4 and 24 are far, then no combined effect.
cells_derived_method: Orb rule applies in any house or sign; compare degrees within sign, not just sign or house.

derived_examples.reading: Sun at 4 degrees and Neptune at 12 degrees on the 10th in Aries: combined (within 10).
Sun at 4 degrees and Neptune at 24 degrees on the 9th in Leo: no combined effect.

ambiguity: '10° के अंदर' orb applies to Sun-Neptune; unclear whether the same orb is used for other planets with Neptune.
classical_check: Classical conjunction orbs vary; 10 degrees is a common wide orb.

hindi: फिर हो सकता है काम ही अलग-अलग घरों में कर रहे हो। तो दोनों की डिग्री साथ होनी चाहिए।
says: Separated planets may be working in different houses (bhava), so both degrees must be together to count as one effect.
cells_derived_method: Same sign but different bhava-chalit house means separate effects; check degrees and house boundaries.

derived_examples.reading: Sun and Neptune on the 9th in Leo within the same bhava: combined.
Sun in the 9th and Neptune in the 10th bhava despite the same sign: separate.

hindi: बहुत नेम फेम देता है। बहुत ज्यादा नहीं देता। देता है थोड़ा बहुत।
says: Sun-Neptune gives name and fame, though he qualifies it as not very much, only a little.
cells_derived_method: Modest fame; the house shows which sphere (10 profession, 5 creative, 11 social).

derived_examples.reading: Sun and Neptune on the 10th in Leo: modest public recognition.
Sun and Neptune on the 11th in Aries: small circle fame.

ambiguity: He says both 'a lot' and 'not very much'; the net claim is modest fame.

hindi: अगर ये सूर्य और नेप्च्यून का योग ना हो तो बहुत ज्यादा ऊंचा ले जाता है चंद्रमा इत्यादि के साथ क्योंकि वो उसकी अपनी फैमिली है।
says: If it is not in union with the Sun, Neptune takes the native very high when with the Moon and similar planets, because those are its own family (water-nature planets).
cells_derived_method: Neptune with Moon and watery planets lifts position; house shows the sphere.

derived_examples.reading: Moon and Neptune on the 10th in Cancer: high public standing.
Moon and Neptune in lagna Pisces: elevated by intuition.
Moon and Neptune on the 5th in Scorpio: elevated through creativity and depth.

ambiguity: 'चंद्रमा इत्यादि' is not enumerated.

hindi: ये चंद्रमा और नेप्च्यून जब साथ होते हैं चरित्रवान बनाता है बहुत ज्यादा और बहुत ज्यादा ऊंचा फेम देता है। ऊंचा नेम देता है।
says: Moon with Neptune makes the person highly virtuous and gives very high fame and name.
cells_derived_method: Moon-Neptune pair gives character and reputation; house shows context (4 home standing, 10 career fame).

derived_examples.reading: Moon (exalted) and Neptune on the 10th in Taurus: high-character public figure.
Moon and Neptune on the 4th in Cancer: reputation through home and mother.
Moon and Neptune on the 9th in Pisces: honoured spiritual figure.

classical_check: Silent; classical Moon-afflictions usually give confusion, so this differs.

hindi: जन्मजात ही इंट्यूटिव पावर्स जन्मजात ही ज्योतिषी समझ लो। ज्योतिष को रेफरेंस किए बिना जन्म पत्रिका की रेफरेंस के बिना भी ये लोग ज्योतिषी होते हैं। यानी ऐसे ही बोल बैठे। ऐसे ही बता बैठे। यह ताकत इसमें रहती है।
says: Moon-Neptune natives have inborn intuition, natural astrologers who speak or foretell without any chart reference.
cells_derived_method: Intuition from Moon-Neptune works in houses 5, 9 and 12; sign flavour: water signs strongest.

derived_examples.reading: Moon and Neptune on the 5th in Cancer: spontaneous prediction ability.
Moon and Neptune on the 12th in Pisces: dream and vision-based knowing.
Moon and Neptune on the 9th in Scorpio: hidden-knowledge intuition.

hindi: मंगल के साथ स्टेज फॉर्मर परफॉर्मर आर्टिस्ट शुक्र के मंगल के बाद बुध बहुत सॉफ्ट
says: Mars with Neptune gives stage performer and artist; he follows with Venus and Mars lines and then moves to Mercury (the caption is jumbled).
cells_derived_method: Mars-Neptune pair gives stage energy in houses 3, 5, 10; Venus-Mars ordering is garbled.

derived_examples.reading: Mars and Neptune on the 3rd in Aries: stage performer, strong stage presence.
Mars and Neptune on the 5th in Scorpio: intense artist.
Mars (exalted) and Neptune on the 10th in Capricorn: performer in a career role.

ambiguity: Order of Mars and Venus is unclear; row repeats the earlier Mars-Neptune performing point.

hindi: स्पोकन आराम से प्यार से बात करने वाले जब बुध इसके साथ जुड़ जाता है।
says: When Mercury joins Neptune the person is very soft-spoken, speaks calmly and with love.
cells_derived_method: Mercury-Neptune gives gentle speech; house shows where: 2 family speech, 3 communication, 7 partner.

derived_examples.reading: Mercury and Neptune on the 2nd in Gemini: gentle, persuasive voice.
Mercury and Neptune on the 3rd in Virgo: soft, precise communication.
Mercury and Neptune on the 7th in Libra: tender talk with partners.

ambiguity: Sentence begins at the end of the previous slice ('बहुत सॉफ्ट').

hindi: हालांकि बुध और इसका आपस में जोड़ वरुण का है नहीं। यह नेगेटिव और उल्टे चलते हैं एक दूसरे से। लेकिन अगर पॉजिटिव हो जाते हैं अच्छी राशि के अंदर जैसे कि बुध की राशि तीन नंबर बहुत अच्छी है। नेपच्यून उसमें ओकेओके फल देता है। बुध की राशि छह नंबर लाजवाब है। नेप्च्यून छह नंबर में लाजवाब है।
says: Mercury and Neptune are naturally opposed; they turn positive in a good sign: Mercury's sign 3 (Gemini) is good and gives only okay results with Neptune, Mercury's sign 6 (Virgo) is excellent for Neptune.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Gemini ok, in Virgo best; house shows the field.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 3rd in Gemini: okay results, communication neither great nor bad.
Neptune on the 6th in Virgo: excellent results, insight and service.
Neptune on the 10th in Virgo: strong analytical career.

hindi: तो ऐसी कोई अच्छी राशि मिल जाती है। तो ऐसे में बहुत सॉफ्ट स्पोकन होते हैं। कम्युनिकेटर्स होते हैं। डिप्लोमेट्स बनते हैं। दो लोगों के बीच बैठ के झगड़ा निपटाने वाले सोशल मूवमेंट करने वाले ऐसे लोग कहीं ना कहीं चाहे अपने इलाके के ही सही या आरडब्ल्यू के कॉलोनी के प्रेसिडेंट बन जाते हैं या ऊंचे पद पे आसीन होते हैं।
says: In a good sign, Mercury-Neptune people are soft-spoken communicators and diplomats, settling disputes between two parties, running social movements, becoming local or society presidents, or holding high posts.
cells_derived_method: Good-sign Mercury-Neptune gives mediation roles; house shows type: 3 media, 7 mediation, 10 posts, 11 societies.

derived_examples.reading: Mercury and Neptune on the 7th in Gemini: mediator between parties.
Mercury and Neptune on the 11th in Virgo: society office-bearer, community leader.
Mercury and Neptune on the 10th in Gemini: diplomat or high public post.

hindi: सोशल लोगों की कनेक्टिविटी होती है। कहीं ना कहीं पॉलिटिशियंस के साथ छोटा बहुत लिंक हो जाता है इनका बहुत अच्छा।
says: They have social connectivity and some good link with politicians.
cells_derived_method: 11th house networks and 10th public ties carry the politician links.

derived_examples.reading: Mercury and Neptune on the 11th in Gemini: wide political acquaintances.
Mercury and Neptune on the 10th in Virgo: connections with officials.

hindi: और अगर नेगेटिव साइड हो जाए तो मिसगाइड करते हैं। हिप्नोसिस करते हैं। हिप्नोटिक स्पेल में कहते हैं ना आज एक दो व्यक्तियों ने एक महिला को पता नहीं हिप्नोसिस करके उसके कड़े उतरवा लिए।
says: On the negative side they misguide and hypnotise, as in a news case where two persons hypnotised a woman and made her remove her bangles.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted Mercury-Neptune turns speech into deception; the house shows victims (7 public, 2 family wealth).

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted Mercury and Neptune on the 2nd in Gemini: cheating through persuasive talk.
Afflicted Mercury and Neptune on the 7th in Virgo: fraud through dealings.
Afflicted Mercury and Neptune on the 3rd in Libra: manipulative messaging.

hindi: तो बातें कर कर के ऐसा बेवकूफ बनाते हैं। लोगों को तेरे ऊपर कुछ किया हुआ है। तेरे पास जादू है, टोना है।
says: They fool people by talk, telling them something has been done on them or that magic or spells are on them.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted Mercury and Neptune on the 3rd in Gemini: spreads fear of black magic.
Afflicted Mercury and Neptune on the 8th in Virgo: occult-fraud talk.

hindi: ला मुझे ₹00 तेरे को मैं तोते की आंख लाकर चिड़िया के पंजे के साथ, चील के बाल के साथ तेरी पूजा कराऊं और तेरे को ठीक कर दूं। यह सब बेवकूफ बनाने वाले काम भी यही करते हैं। अगर एक गलत राशि बैड राशि के अंदर हो।
says: Fake healers demanding money and promising a ritual with parrot eye, bird claws and eagle hair also come from this placement when it sits in a bad sign; he calls it fooling people.
cells_derived_method: Bad-sign placement (enemy or fiery sign) gives fraud rituals; sign and house identify the field.

derived_examples.reading: Mercury and Neptune on the 8th in Aries: fake ritual healer.
Mercury and Neptune on the 6th in Sagittarius: false cures sold to the ill.

ambiguity: 'Bad sign' is not defined; he previously calls fire signs negative.

hindi: नेगेटिव बृहस्पति के साथ बैठते हैं तो ये बृहस्पति के साथ तो इसका फल कमाल ही है क्योंकि बृहस्पति ज्ञान का देवता है और ये चीज चीज और ये चीजों का देवता है। इसके पास जबरदस्त इंट्यूशन है।
says: Neptune with Jupiter gives an excellent result because Jupiter is god of knowledge and Neptune of subtle things; the person has tremendous intuition.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter-Neptune pair gives wisdom and intuition; house shows area: 9 guru, 5 mantra, 12 meditation.

derived_examples.reading: Jupiter (own sign) and Neptune on the 9th in Sagittarius: strong intuitive wisdom.
Jupiter (own sign) and Neptune on the 5th in Pisces: inspired mantra and creativity.
Jupiter (exalted) and Neptune on the 12th in Cancer: deep meditative intuition.

ambiguity: Opening 'नेगेटिव बृहस्पति' is garbled; the clear claim is the strong Jupiter-Neptune result.

hindi: कहने का मतलब है कि एक आपका गुरु हो गया। अगर आपकी लाइफ में गुरु है और कोई ना कोई टीले वाले बाबा की कृपा है तो आपकी लाइफ सॉर्टेड है।
says: It means you get a guru; if your life has a guru or some hill-hermit baba's grace, your life is sorted.
cells_derived_method: Guru presence helps any Neptune-Jupiter house; 9th is the guru house.

derived_examples.reading: Jupiter and Neptune on the 9th in Pisces: strong guru grace.
Jupiter and Neptune in lagna Sagittarius: guided by a guru throughout life.

classical_check: Silent; guru grace is common in tradition.

hindi: इसीलिए यह सिर्फ मान्यता होती है कि टीले वाले बाबा में हमने भगवान को मान लिया। जैसे कि नेपच्यून वो देवता है जो कि समुद्र है लेकिन है ही नहीं।
says: Faith is only assumption, like accepting God in a hill-hermit baba; Neptune is the god who is a sea that is also not there.
cells_derived_method: Neptune as belief karaka; any house gets faith-based reality in its topic.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 9th in Pisces: strong faith-based reality.
Neptune on the 5th in Cancer: believes in imagined bonds with children.
Neptune on the 7th in Leo: faith in partner whose reality is unverified.

hindi: पता नहीं अंत कहां है इसका। अंत तो है लेकिन पता नहीं कहां है। समुद्र में इस खजाना पड़ा है पर पता नहीं कहां पड़ा है। समुद्र में तेल है पर पता नहीं कहां पड़ा है। ऐसे ही ये मेरा बच्चा है लेकिन मेरा बच्चा नहीं है। पता नहीं किसका बच्चा है लेकिन अपने बच्चे जैसा मान लिया। वो तार देगा। मेरा ईश्वर तो इस पत्थर में है। पत्थर में नहीं है। लेकिन मैंने इसमें मान लिया।
says: Analogies for Neptune's unknowability: the sea has an end, treasure and oil but nobody knows where; a child assumed as one's own, a god assumed in a stone; belief fills the gap.
cells_derived_method: Illustrates Neptune's unknown quality; house shows what is unknown: 5 child, 2 treasure, 9 god.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 5th in Pisces: doubtful or assumed parentage, adopted-child themes.
Neptune on the 2nd in Scorpio: hidden treasure or untraced family wealth.
Neptune on the 9th in Cancer: faith in an idol or tradition not provable.

ambiguity: Child parentage remark is an illustrative analogy, not a rule.

hindi: मैंने यह मान लिया यह दवाई मुझे कमाल करेगी। यह दवाई आपको कमाल करेगी। मैंने ये मान लिया इस गुरु के द्वारा ही तरूंगा। तो नेप्च्यून वो देवता है जो बिलीफ पेयर है।
says: Believing that this medicine will work wonders or that only this guru will liberate me is Neptune's work: Neptune is the god who gives belief.
cells_derived_method: Neptune as belief/placebo karaka; house shows what belief controls: 6 treatment, 9 guru.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 6th in Virgo: placebo-type belief in treatment.
Neptune on the 9th in Pisces: belief in a particular guru.
Neptune on the 12th in Scorpio: hidden faith practices.

ambiguity: 'बिलीफ पेयर' is probably 'belief giver' or 'pair'.
classical_check: Silent; medical statements here are belief claims, not medical advice.

gist: Example of a known baba telling followers to eat golgappas with yellow, blue and green water, and results follow; used as an illustration that belief produces effects.

hindi: जादू कराने वाला नेप्च्यून है। इसीलिए आर्टिस्ट है, परफॉर्मर है, ड्रामेबाज है और इसीलिए कृपा भी होती है।
says: Neptune is the magic-maker, so it also makes artists, performers and drama persons, and that is why grace also happens.
cells_derived_method: Neptune as magic and performance karaka; any house.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 5th in Libra: performing-art talent, charm.
Neptune on the 10th in Pisces: public performer career.

hindi: ऐसे लोगों को बेवकूफ नहीं कहा जा सकता एक पढ़े लिखे के द्वारा कि भैया क्या तू पेड़ से मांगता रहता है? पेड़ तुझे कुछ देगा? और पेड़ जब उसे देता है तो उसे लगता है भाई पेड़ में कुछ है। यह नेप्च्यून है। यह आपका वरुण देवता है जो आपको सब कुछ पकड़ा के देता है। यह बृहस्पति का काम है।
says: Believers cannot be called fools by the educated, since when the tree he prays to does give, he sees something in it; this is Neptune (Varuna) who hands you everything, and this is Jupiter's work.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter-Neptune faith mechanism: belief begets result; applies in houses 9, 5, 12.

derived_examples.reading: Jupiter and Neptune on the 9th in Sagittarius: faith practices work for him.
Jupiter and Neptune on the 12th in Pisces: devotion fulfilled in solitude.

ambiguity: The tree example is rhetorical; Neptune plus Jupiter in his framing.

hindi: इसकी सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम एक ही होती है। मोटा कर देता है। मोटापा दे सकता है
says: Biggest problem of the Jupiter-Neptune pair: it can make the person fat (obesity). Body claim from tradition.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter expansion with Neptune water retention shows as weight; lagna or 6th house placement strongest.

derived_examples.reading: Jupiter and Neptune in lagna Pisces: heavy body build.
Jupiter and Neptune on the 6th in Cancer: weight-related health issue.

ambiguity: 'इसकी' presumably the Jupiter-Neptune conjunction.
classical_check: Classical Jupiter is karaka of fat/obesity; agrees.

hindi: और भयंकर ईगो देता है। यानी सुनूंगा तो मैं अपने आप की भी नहीं। किसी के बाप की नहीं। सुनता नहीं ऐसा व्यक्ति क्योंकि अपनी ही चलेगी।
says: Also fierce ego: the person won't listen even to himself, not to anyone's father, because only his will runs.
cells_derived_method: Ego with Jupiter-Neptune manifests in the house topic (9 elders, 10 bosses, 1 self).

derived_examples.reading: Jupiter and Neptune in lagna Sagittarius: dogmatic self-will.
Jupiter and Neptune on the 10th in Pisces: refuses authority.

Neptune and Uranus on the 11th in Scorpio: show-off circles.
Neptune and Uranus on the 12th in Libra: indulgent lifestyle.

ambiguity: Planet is inferred as Uranus from 'इंद्र रह गया था'.

hindi: ऐसे लोगों को सबसे बड़ा क्लेश होता है। भाई गाड़ी बड़ी होनी चाहिए। क्वालिटी तो अपने अंदर है नहीं। बड़ी महंगी घड़ी पहनूंगा और उस चक्कर में अगर यह दोष युक्त हो यानी गलत राशि का हो जाए या किसी दूसरे ग्रह की नेगेटिव दृष्टि तो ऐसे आदमी 50 लाख की घड़ी तो खरीद लेता है। बाद में घर तक बिक जाता है उसका।
says: Their biggest affliction is status obsession (big car, costly watch); if afflicted or in a wrong sign or aspected negatively, he buys a 50-lakh watch and later even sells his house. Spending claim, not advice.
cells_derived_method: Affliction makes overspending on status: 2 wealth, 4 home assets, 11 gains.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted Neptune and Uranus on the 4th in Aries: loses house through show-off spending.
Afflicted Neptune and Uranus on the 2nd in Aquarius: wealth drained on status.
Afflicted Neptune and Uranus on the 11th in Leo: gains spent on appearances.

hindi: क्योंकि टशन और शोषण की खातिर वह कुछ भी करता है। अपने आप को भी बेच देता है। अपने को बर्बाद करता है। लड़कियां जो होती है ऐसी स्थिति में हो तो अपना देह व्यापार भी कर लेती हैं। वो एक बहुत नेगेटिविटी बन जाती है। यानी किसी लेवल पे भी धन ऐश अय्याशी के लिए अपने को गिरा देता है इंसान।
says: For show he will do anything, even sell himself and ruin himself; girls with this placement may take to prostitution; a person falls to any level for money and luxury. A moral-character claim by tradition.
cells_derived_method: Severe afflicted case; 7th, 12th and 2nd houses show fall via sex and money.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted Neptune and Uranus on the 7th in Pisces: exploitation through relationships.
Afflicted Neptune and Uranus on the 12th in Taurus: self-degradation for pleasure.
Afflicted Neptune and Uranus on the 2nd in Libra: earns through degrading means.

gist: Audience exchange: 'this negativity is in it; where else?' and a question about Neptune's good sign, debilitation and exaltation, which he calls a lovely point.

hindi: अब यहां दो तीन चीजें प्रमुख उल्लेख देने वाली है के नेप्च्यून वरुण देवता आठ नंबर का अगर है तो यह नाश कर देता है। आठ नंबर का कहीं पर भी है तो यह आपका नीच तुल्य फल देगा।
says: Neptune in sign number 8 (Scorpio), anywhere in the chart, destroys and gives debilitation-like results.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Scorpio in any house gives destructive, debilitation-like results to that house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in lagna Scorpio: self-destructive tendencies.
Neptune on the 5th in Scorpio: loss of children matters.
Neptune on the 10th in Scorpio: career destroyed by illusion.

ambiguity: Contradicts his earlier praise of Neptune in 8 (wealthy yogi) and 'water signs best'; possibly different readings of the sign vs the 8th house.

hindi: नीच और उच्च जैसी स्थिति इस ग्रह की इसलिए गड़बड़ डिफाइंड नहीं है क्योंकि इसकी सब जगह दृष्टि है। समुद्र हर जगह मौजूद है टाइप्स।
says: Neptune's exaltation and debilitation are not properly defined because it aspects everywhere; the sea is present everywhere.
cells_derived_method: No fixed dignity signs for Neptune; read by element friendship instead.
classical_check: Silent; outer planets have no classical dignity table.

hindi: ये लेके चलो। इसकी समस्या सबसे बड़ी क्या है? समुद्र जब जमीन से रगड़ता है मंगल की राशि एक और आठ तो एक में भी बहुत नेगेटिव है। आठ में भी बहुत नेगेटिव है। तो ये नाशक है।
says: Neptune's biggest problem arises when the sea rubs land in Mars's signs 1 and 8 (Aries, Scorpio): very negative in both, so it is a destroyer.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Mars signs is very negative; house shows damage area.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in lagna Aries: self-undoing, impulsive.
Neptune on the 7th in Scorpio: destroys partnership.
Neptune on the 4th in Aries: home disrupted.

ambiguity: Conflicts with his earlier statements about Neptune in Scorpio (8th) as wealthy.

gist: Audience asks whether sign 8 vs 4 are destructive since he said water signs give very good results; he replies by asking what 'very good' means.

hindi: जैसे शुक्र है। शुक्र उच्च का है। उच्च के शुक्र की लड़की कभी गृहस्थ में सुखी नहीं होती। अब उच्च के शुक्र का फल क्या है? शुक्र का काम है ऐश।
says: Analogy for 'very good': an exalted Venus woman is never happy in married life, because Venus's job is luxury and pleasure, so good dignity can still give an unhappy result.
cells_derived_method: Venus exalted in Pisces gives indulgence over domestic happiness; house shows area: 7 marriage, 4 home.

derived_examples.reading: Venus (exalted) on the 7th in Pisces: woman not settled in domestic life.
Venus (exalted) in lagna Pisces: pleasure-seeking, restless in household duties.
Venus (exalted) on the 4th in Pisces: luxury-minded, unstable domestic peace.

ambiguity: He says 'uchcha ka Shukra' without a sign; exalted Venus is in Pisces.
classical_check: Differs from classical: exalted Venus usually gives marital comfort; this is his claim.

hindi: अब वो हो गई उच्च उच्च का हो गया शुक्र। पति का हो गया तो पति क्या करेगा? ऐश करेगा। और वो तो नहीं होना चाहिए। तो मर्यादा के तो विरुद्ध चला गया।
says: Finishing the Venus analogy: when the woman's Venus is exalted, her husband's Venus-like nature shows up as a husband who indulges in luxury and pleasure, which goes against propriety, so exaltation gives an unhappy domestic result.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Venus in Pisces makes the spouse pleasure-seeking; read via 7th house for the spouse and 4th for domestic peace.

derived_examples.reading: Venus (exalted) on the 7th in Pisces: husband pleasure-seeking, steady fidelity lacking.
Venus (exalted) on the 2nd in Pisces: household money spent on comforts.
Venus (exalted) on the 12th in Pisces: bed pleasures dominate, domestic duty slips.

ambiguity: He says only 'exalted Venus' (Pisces) and speaks of a woman's chart; applies to a female native.
classical_check: Classical texts treat exalted Venus as a benefic (marital comfort); his reading is opposite.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में नेप्च्यून क्या करेगा? मल्टीपल देता है। एक से तो पेट भरता नहीं इसका। यह तो मल्टीपल विद्याएं देता है। ज्योतिष जैसा ज्ञान मल्टीपल विद्याओं के आगे की जानकारी है। सिर्फ एक किताब से नहीं चलता। तो ज्योति अच्छी बनाता है। इंट्यूशन क्या होती है? भविष्य देखने की शक्ति हो गई। आगे चला गया।
says: Neptune gives 'multiple' of everything: one is never enough, so it gives many fields of learning (astrology-like knowledge beyond one book) and makes a good astrologer; intuition here means the power to see the future.
cells_derived_method: Neptune as the multiplier karaka: multiple learning, relations or assets in the house it holds (3, 5, 9 for learning).

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 9th in Pisces: many streams of learning, intuitive astrologer.
Neptune on the 5th in Gemini: dabbles in many subjects, creative versatility.
Neptune on the 3rd in Virgo: many skills and writing forms.

hindi: अब ये 4 8 12 में जो होगा तो क्या करेगा? मल्टीपल रिलेशन दे देगा। मल्टीपल मकान देगा। मल्टीपल देगा। एक से चैन नहीं भरेगा।
says: Neptune in 4, 8 or 12 gives multiple relationships and multiple houses; one is never enough.
cells_derived_method: Multiplicity in the water houses: 4 properties/homes, 8 hidden/secret ties, 12 bed and foreign relations.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 4th in Cancer: several homes and property.
Neptune on the 8th in Scorpio: multiple hidden relationships.
Neptune on the 12th in Pisces: multiple bed-partners or foreign homes.

ambiguity: He may mean water signs 4, 8, 12 or the houses; both were used earlier. Houses are recorded here.

hindi: सातवें घर में आ गया तो क्या करेगा? अफेयर्स। मेरिटल अफेयर्स दे देगा आपको। अब ये करेगा क्या? क्योंकि अच्छी राशि का है। इसके कारण सत्यानाश नहीं होगा। तो क्या हुआ? अप्रूव्ड रिलेशन या मल्टीपल काम दे देगा। नाजायज जो दिखावे के हैं।
says: Neptune on the 7th gives marital affairs; since it is in a good sign it does not ruin, so it gives approved relationships or multiple works, though some are illegitimate or just for show.
cells_derived_method: Neptune on the 7th in a water/good sign gives plural relationships without collapse; in a bad sign the damage is serious.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Cancer (water sign): affairs without ruin.
Neptune on the 7th in Aries (fire sign): relationships collapse under quarrels.
Neptune on the 7th in Pisces: idealised approved relationships, plural pairings.

ambiguity: 'अच्छी राशि' is understood as a water sign.

hindi: आठ नंबर का 10वें नंबर में बैठ गया तो क्या काम करेगा? कागजों पे बिल काटते हैं। काम कुछ नहीं करते। उसी में झूठे सच्चे बिल बना के कमाते हैं। पता लग गया तो भी पैसे पकड़।
says: Neptune in sign 8 (Scorpio) on the 10th: the person raises bills on paper without real work and earns through false or genuine invoices; even if exposed money is held. A fraud-style livelihood claim, not advice.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio on the 10th gives paper-trade livelihood; the same sign in 2nd or 11th would show money from billing and hidden channels.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 10th in Scorpio: income from paper billing.
Neptune on the 11th in Scorpio: gains via invoices and commissions.
Neptune on the 2nd in Scorpio: family wealth through documentary dealings.

ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर का' is sign Scorpio; the 10th is a house.

hindi: उसके कारण बर्बाद नहीं होते।
says: Tail of the paper-billing claim: despite being found out, such Neptune-in-Scorpio people are not ruined by it.
cells_derived_method: Resilience of Neptune in a water sign: exposure does not destroy the 10th house livelihood.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 10th in Scorpio: livelihood survives exposure.
Neptune on the 7th in Scorpio: partnerships survive exposure.

gist: Audience asks (about the 9th house and Jupiter) what is positive about Neptune in sign 8 if it is negative; he says Jupiter is not the topic, only sign.

hindi: आठ नंबर में ये नेगेटिव है इसका पॉजिटिव फल क्या है परेशानी अय्याशी दारू पिएगा टुन करेगा बेहोश करेगा
says: Neptune in sign 8: its result is trouble, debauchery, drinking until intoxicated and unconscious. Heavy-drinking claim, tradition not diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Scorpio gives debauchery and drinking; house shows arena: 12 bed/escape, 7 social drinking, 6 habits.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 12th in Scorpio: secret heavy drinking and escape.
Neptune on the 7th in Scorpio: partner or social life tied to drinking.
Neptune on the 6th in Scorpio: habit and health problems from alcohol.

hindi: आठ नंबर और एक नंबर में हो जाएगा तो क्या करेगा एक नंबर फायर साइन हो गया बर्बाद कर देगा आठ नंबर वाटर साइन हो गया जितनी मर्जी दारू पिएगा दारू तो पिएगा बिगड़ेगा कुछ नहीं इसने बिगाड़ना है और इसने देना है।
says: Difference of the two Mars signs: Neptune in Aries (fire) ruins; in Scorpio (water) he drinks as much as he likes but nothing is spoiled; one spoils, the other gives.
cells_derived_method: Element decides: fire Aries destroys, water Scorpio tolerates the Neptune excess.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in lagna Aries: ruin through impulsive indulgence.
Neptune on the 8th in Scorpio: heavy indulgence without harm.
Neptune on the 7th in Aries: partnership ruined by excess.

ambiguity: Contradicts his earlier line that both Aries and Scorpio are very negative.

hindi: यह बड़ी कंफ्यूजिंग स्थिति है। हम बात करते हैं कौन से ग्रह का कैसा फल है। सूर्य का अलग किस्म का व्यवहार है। कोई उच्च का हो गया, नीच का हो गया।
says: Principle: each planet behaves in its own way; exaltation or debilitation does not have the same meaning for every planet, so read planet by planet.
cells_derived_method: Dignity must be read per planet nature, not as a uniform good or bad.

derived_examples.reading: Sun (debilitated) on the 7th in Libra: loses authority; Saturn (exalted) there is a different reading.
Sun (exalted) on the 10th in Aries: authority; Mars there differs.

classical_check: Differs from classical uniform dignity-strength rules.

hindi: अब इंद्र देवता जैसा ग्रह उच्च का हो गया तो क्या करेगा? अय्याशी करा देगा। भयंकर दूसरे की पत्नी को लेके भाग जाएगा। दूसरे के पति के साथ रिलेशन कर देगा। दूसरे से बच्चा पैदा करा देगा। दूसरे की प्रॉपर्टी कब्जा करा लेगा।
says: When an Indra-type planet (Uranus) is in an exalted-like sign it brings debauchery: eloping with another's wife, relations with another's husband, a child by another, grabbing another's property.
cells_derived_method: Uranus strong gives taking what belongs to others in 7th (spouse), 5th (children), 4th (property).

derived_examples.reading: Uranus on the 7th in Scorpio: affairs with others' partners.
Uranus on the 5th in Aquarius: child by another, unconventional romance.
Uranus on the 4th in Scorpio: seizes others' property.

ambiguity: Uranus's exaltation sign is not stated by him.

hindi: इंद्र करता रहता है ना कब्जे? भागता भगाता रहता है। लड़ता रहता है। उसको तो एक ही डर है कि अपना पकड़े। ये स्वभाव पकड़ने वाली बात है। तो इनका जो उच्च नीच है वो बड़ा डेंजरस है। बहुत ज्यादा डेंजरस है।
says: Indra myth: he keeps seizing, fleeing, abducting and fighting, with only one fear of losing his own; this grabbing nature makes the exaltation and debilitation of such planets very dangerous.
cells_derived_method: Uranus karaka of seizing and instability; dignity amplifies this in the house held.

derived_examples.reading: Uranus on the 7th in Scorpio: seizing and abduction themes in partnership.
Uranus on the 10th in Aquarius: seizes status, constant fights at work.

hindi: शनि शनि बैठ गया उच्च का सातवें घर में कम से कम तीन शादी कराएगा। अब बताओ इसमें अच्छा क्या है? सांसारिक रूप मर्यादा के रूप में तो नेगेटिव है। ये चीज आती है।
says: Exalted Saturn sitting in the 7th (Libra) gives at least three marriages; in worldly propriety this is negative though exaltation is supposed to be good.
cells_derived_method: Saturn exalted in Libra on the 7th means lagna Aries; his reading turns exaltation into plural marriage; other houses give other results.

derived_examples.reading: Saturn (exalted) on the 7th in Libra: three or more marriages.
Saturn (exalted) in lagna Libra: strong status with plural relationship tendency.
Saturn (exalted) on the 10th in Libra: reputation conflicts with relationship conduct.

classical_check: Differs from classical: exalted Saturn in the 7th is Sasa yoga, usually delays and stabilises marriage.

hindi: आठ नंबर होके तो ये गुप्त रिलेशन लगाएगा लेकिन बिगड़ेगा नहीं। बुरा नहीं करेगा उस लड़की का या उस लड़के का गुप्त एक चुपचाप रिश्ता चलाता रहेगा काम तो ये करेगा ही वही अपने कार अपना कर्म थोड़ी छोड़े
says: Neptune in sign 8 under Jupiter's influence will keep a secret relationship but will not turn bad or harm the other person; it runs quietly, since it does not abandon its nature.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter influence on Neptune in Scorpio gives hidden ties without harm; stronger if Jupiter aspects.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Scorpio with Jupiter aspect: quiet outside relationship, no scandal.
Neptune on the 12th in Scorpio with Jupiter aspect: private liaison causes no harm.

ambiguity: The Jupiter condition is inferred from the previous (partly audience) sentence.

hindi: एक सर इसी से यही अगर बृहस्पति के इन्फ्लुएंस में भी बृहस्पति के इन्फ्लुएंस में हो गया। बहुत सेट हो गया। चरित्रवान हो गया। ये इन्फ्लुएंस हो गया।
says: If the planet falls under Jupiter's influence it gets settled and becomes virtuous.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter conjunction or aspect on a Neptune or exalted-debilitated planet stabilises and improves character in that house.

derived_examples.reading: Planet on the 7th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's sign): settled marriage conduct.
Planet on the 4th in Pisces (Jupiter's sign): settled home and character.

ambiguity: The planet in question is not named; this follows an audience question and is partly garbled.

hindi: शुक्र नीच का है तो शुक्र उच्च का क्या करता नीच क्या करेगा नीच कम बुरा है बुरा तो वो है ही लेकिन वो नीचता नहीं कर रहा नीच में अब वो कहने को नीच शब्द ये ट्रिक इसकी पकड़नी बहुत जरूरी है
says: Debilitated Venus is less bad than exalted Venus: the bad tendency is there, but 'neech' is only a label and it does not act basely; this is the key trick to grasp.
cells_derived_method: Venus debilitated in Virgo gives restrained pleasure-seeking compared with exalted Pisces.

derived_examples.reading: Venus (debilitated) on the 7th in Virgo: spouse less indulgent than with exalted Venus.
Venus (debilitated) on the 4th in Virgo: modest domestic pleasures.
Venus (debilitated) on the 2nd in Virgo: restrained luxury spending.

ambiguity: Statement is compressed and partly garbled; it contradicts the classical rule that debilitation weakens a planet.
classical_check: Differs from classical: debilitation weakens results.

gist: Audience begins a connected question: 'you said that Sagittarius, sign 9, Neptune result is positive'; the question continues in the next slice.

hindi: में नेप्च्यून का जो रिजल्ट है वो पॉजिटिव रिजल्ट है। नियंत्रित इसका नियंत्रित रिजल्ट है। ये शब्द जाइट वर्ड है कि नियंत्रित नियंत्रित रिजल्ट है।
says: Neptune in Sagittarius gives a positive but controlled result, and he stresses 'controlled' as the key word.
cells_derived_method: Controlled Neptune effect in Sagittarius in any house; dharma/guru topics steadied.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 9th in Sagittarius: disciplined faith, controlled illusions.
Neptune on the 5th in Sagittarius: controlled imagination and children matters.

ambiguity: This may be the questioner's restatement of his earlier claim, not a new rule.

hindi: लेकिन फिर हमने बताया हमने देखा कि जो नौ नंबर राशि है वो फायर की है। हां फायर है ना। अब वो फायर में वहां पर हमने बात करी कि उसका रिजल्ट डाउन आ जाता है। हां डाउन हो जाएगा। इसीलिए नेप्च्यून का रिजल्ट डाउन हो गया। नेपच्यून के तूफान घटे गए।
says: Sagittarius (sign 9) is a fire sign and Neptune's result goes down in fire, so its storms reduce.
cells_derived_method: Fire element lowers Neptune's flow; effect is moderated in house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 9th in Sagittarius: dampened illusions, steadier faith.
Neptune on the 3rd in Sagittarius: tempered imagination in speech.

ambiguity: The 'down' refers both to storms (excess) reducing and results lowering; he reconciles them as reduction of Neptune's turbulence.

hindi: नेपच्यून किसी और राशि का है। नेप्च्यून तूफान तूफान तो हमें घटाने ही थे। तूफान ही तो घटाना है हमें। तो वो फिर नेगेटिव कौन से कौन से तूफान घटे फायर फ्लाइन के अंदर लड़ाकू बन जाएगा।
says: Neptune's storms are exactly what we want reduced; in a fire sign the negative storms drop but the person becomes combative.
cells_derived_method: Fire signs reduce Neptune turbulence but add fighting temperament; house shows fights (3, 7, 10).

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 3rd in Aries: fewer delusions but quarrelsome.
Neptune on the 7th in Leo: combative with partner.
Neptune on the 10th in Sagittarius: fighter at work.

ambiguity: Garbled text ('फायर फ्लाइन' probably 'फायर साइन').

hindi: अच्छा ये बहुत बड़ी ट्रिक है। ये ये चीज घुमानी माइंड में जरूरी है। ब्रेन चारों पांचों चीजें इकट्ठा पकड़ ले तब आप सही प्रेडिक्शन दे पाएंगे।
says: Method principle: keep four or five factors (planet, sign, house, element, dignity) together in mind at once; only then can you predict correctly.
cells_derived_method: Prediction requires combining planet nature, sign element, house topic and dignity, not one factor.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 9th in Sagittarius: combine planet (illusion), sign (fire, controlled), house (dharma).
Neptune on the 7th in Cancer: combine planet, water sign (good), house (partners).

classical_check: Consistent with the project rule of multi-factor combination.

gist: He says grace is needed because astrology is a complicated khichdi, which is why astrologers differ, and the brain must process everything, so one should seek grace.
Completes the grace thought: the right thing should occur to us at the right time; no astrology content.

hindi: अब नेप्च्यून आठ नंबर का है या आठ नंबर का नेप्च्यून क्या करता है? इंट्यूशन को भी पकड़ लेता है। तो ऐसा व्यक्ति जबरदस्त इंट्यूटिव होता है।
says: Neptune in sign 8 captures intuition too, so such a person is highly intuitive.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio Neptune gives intuition in any house; area given by house.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 5th in Scorpio: intuitive intelligence, prediction ability.
Neptune on the 9th in Scorpio: intuitive spiritual insight.
Neptune in lagna Scorpio: strongly intuitive personality.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति मल्टीपल रिलेशन चला देते हैं। यहां का भी मल्टीपल रिलेशन चलाएगा। यहां का भी मल्टीपल चलाएगा। यहां का भी मल्टीपल चलाएगा। यहां वाले छुप-छुप के चलाएगा। चलाएगा जरूर।
says: Such Neptune-in-Scorpio persons run multiple relationships in different places, some in hiding, but certainly run them.
cells_derived_method: Plural relationships; place of each relation by house: 7 partner, 5 love, 12 hidden.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Scorpio: several concurrent relationships.
Neptune on the 12th in Scorpio: relationships kept secret.
Neptune on the 5th in Scorpio: multiple romances.

ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) points to chart positions he is drawing; not clear.

hindi: यहां की खासियत क्या है? सातव घर को नष्ट कर रहा है। पकड़े जाना चाहिए ना। अब उसको पकड़े जाना चाहिए।
says: Its specialty is that it damages the 7th house and he should be caught.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Scorpio spoils the 7th house of spouse via exposure.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Scorpio: marriage damaged, partner finds out.
Neptune on the 8th in Scorpio: affects the 7th by being next to it, affairs surfacing.

ambiguity: Which house sits Neptune is not clear ('यहां').

hindi: अब उसका जो पार्टनर है एक लड़का है उसकी कुंडली में सातवें घर में या लड़की है कोई भी है तो उसका रिलेशन बाहर होगा और पति को या पत्नी को पता होगा। उसके कारण नाश नहीं होगा। इसकी नीचता का यह फल है कि यह नष्ट हो गया। यह उसको नाश नहीं कर रहा।
says: If Neptune sits in the 7th of a boy's or girl's chart, the person has an outside relationship, the spouse knows of it, and it does not destroy the person; the debilitation-like effect destroys the marriage only.
cells_derived_method: Neptune on the 7th: outside relationship known to spouse; marriage damaged, native not ruined.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune on the 7th in Scorpio: outside relation, spouse aware, native survives.
Neptune on the 7th in Libra: openly known outside relationship.
Neptune on the 7th in Aries: relationship outside, quarrels but no ruin.

hindi: इसकी उच्चता नीचता अलग किस्म की है। शुक्र की उच्चता नीचता अलग किस्म की है। हर ग्रह का एक अपना अलग किस्म का स्वभाव है।
says: Neptune's, and Venus's, exaltation and debilitation are of different kinds; every planet has its own type of nature.
cells_derived_method: Dignity meaning differs per planet; no house/sign cells.

hindi: अब हमारे को देखना ये है कि हमारे पास जहां पर भी नेप्च्यून की बात के अलावा भी और ग्रह है। अब सूर्य यहां सात नंबर का आ गया। हम ऐसे सूर्य से लेके चलते हैं रेमेडीज की बात।
says: Moving from Neptune to other planets: take the Sun placed in the 7th and use it to start the remedies discussion.
cells_derived_method: Introduces remedy example for Sun on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Sun (debilitated) on the 7th in Libra: remedy example case.
Sun (exalted) on the 7th in Aries: remedy example case.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' is read as the 7th house (confirmed by the next slice).

hindi: मान लो। तो अब हमारा राइट हैंड है ये। अब हमें यहां देख के चलना है कि हमें राइट हैंड की कलाई के ऊपर कुछ करना है या यहां पर टैटू करा सकते हैं हम। तो यूजुअली लोग काले रंग का टैटू करा सकते हैं। यह बहुत शानदार है।
says: Remedy for the Sun on the 7th: work on the right hand, the wrist, where a black-colour tattoo can be done; he calls it very good.
cells_derived_method: Right-hand wrist is the Sun's body spot; the black colour blocks the Sun's effect; check house and aspects first.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: black mark on right wrist to tone down the Sun.
Sun on the 7th in Aries: tattoo only if the lagna aspect harms.

ambiguity: Why the right hand corresponds to the Sun is not explained.

hindi: अब देखना यह है कि सातवें घर की दृष्टि इसकी एक नंबर पे हो जाएगी। एक नंबर इसका प्रोटेक्टेड है कि नहीं किसी चीज से। अगर प्रोटेक्टेड नहीं है। मंगल बैठा है। मंगल ने यहां पकड़ लिया।
says: Check: the Sun on the 7th aspects the 1st house, so see whether the 1st house is protected; if not, and Mars grips it, then apply remedy.
cells_derived_method: Sun on the 7th aspects the 1st house (7th aspect); lagna with a Mars influence is unprotected.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Aries aspects lagna Libra: Mars influence on it makes it unprotected.
Sun on the 7th in Libra aspects lagna Aries: check Jupiter protection.

hindi: मंगल यहां बैठा है। मंगल ने यहां से आठवीं दृष्टि से पकड़ लिया। तो यहां पर काला रंग कर सकते हैं। काला रंग उसके काला कलाई पे बाजू बांध दो।
says: Mars sitting here aspects (by its 8th aspect) the afflicted house, so apply black colour: tie a black band on the wrist or arm.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects 4th, 7th and 8th from its seat; Mars on the 6th reaches the 1st by the 8th aspect.

derived_examples.reading: Mars on the 6th in Virgo reaches lagna Aries by its 8th aspect: black wrist band remedy.
Mars on the 3rd in Gemini reaches the 10th in Capricorn by its 8th aspect: the same black-colour remedy is applied for the 10th house body spot.

ambiguity: Which house Mars sits in is not named ('यहां'); the example uses the 8th aspect.

hindi: बच्चा पेपर देने जा रहा है। 101% फेल होगा। चौथा घर फ़ेलियर देगा। मां की तबियत ख़राब रहेगी। चेस्ट में इसको पेन आएगा। हार्ट की दिक्क़त आएगी।
says: Example of the afflicted 4th: a child going to an exam will fail for certain, the mother's health will be poor, with chest pain and heart trouble. Exam and health predictions are tradition claims, not guarantees.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted 4th (education, mother, heart) gives exam failure and chest-area issues; planet affliction type picks flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted 4th in Libra: poor results, mother's heart worry.
Afflicted 4th in Cancer: mother unwell, chest complaints.
Afflicted 4th in Capricorn: education obstacles, chronic chest problems.

ambiguity: '101% fail' is rhetorical; the affliction is Mars/Sun without stating which causes it.
classical_check: Classical 4th house: education, mother, heart; agrees.

hindi: इसको काले रंग का काम यहां करा दो। दूसरा काम क्या कर सकते हैं? सूर्य को यहीं पर किल कर दो। सूर्य को यहीं ग्रहण लगा दो।
says: Remedy options: get black colour work done on that spot; or 'kill' the Sun right there, give the Sun an eclipse in the same place.
cells_derived_method: Eclipsing the Sun symbolically (black colour) dims Sun's effect in the house.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: black mark to eclipse an already weak Sun, gentle effect.
Sun on the 7th in Aries: eclipse blocks its strong aspect on the 1st.

ambiguity: 'Kill the Sun' is figurative.

hindi: अच्छा, सूर्य को यहीं ग्रहण लगा दो, तो क्या होगा? सूर्य यहां की उच्चता खत्म कर देगा।
says: If the Sun is eclipsed here, its exaltation here ends, so the harm of the Sun's strength is removed.
cells_derived_method: Sun exalted only in Aries; here it implies the Sun is in its exaltation sign on the 7th, and the remedy reduces that strength.

derived_examples.reading: Sun (exalted) on the 7th in Aries: eclipse remedy dampens exalted aspect on lagna Libra.
Sun (exalted) on the 10th in Aries: eclipse would instead damage a good position.

ambiguity: 'उच्चता' suggests Aries but he does not name the sign.

hindi: सबसे बड़ा नुकसान क्या होगा? सूर्य को यहीं पर नाश कर देंगे अगर हम तो यहां की जो उच्च फल होना है सूर्य का वो खत्म हो के नष्ट हो जाएगा। तो हम कुर्बानी करने को राजी हैं। हां जी राजी हैं।
says: The cost of neutralising the Sun on the 7th is that its good (exalted-type) results there will also be destroyed; he says we are willing to sacrifice that good to remove the damage.
cells_derived_method: Remedy trade-off: blocking a planet's harm also removes its benefits in that house.

derived_examples.reading: Sun (exalted) on the 7th in Aries: remedy removes authority-type gains together with the harm to lagna Libra.
Sun (debilitated) on the 7th in Libra: little good to lose, so the sacrifice is small.

ambiguity: Whether 'उच्च फल' means exaltation or just good fruit is not clear.
classical_check: Silent; planet-blocking remedies are his own method.

hindi: तो सूर्य के एक नंबर अब नेप्च्यून की तरह नेप्च्यून का लाइट ब्लू कलर होता है। बहुत लाइट ब्लू कलर और राहु का नॉर्मल ब्लू इंक ब्लू कलर है। तो यहां पर हमने नेप्च्यून स्थापित करना है तो लाइट ब्लू कलर डाल दिया।
says: Colour mapping for the remedy: Neptune is a very light blue and Rahu is normal ink blue; to establish Neptune on that spot, apply light blue.
cells_derived_method: Planet-colour table used for body-spot remedies: light blue Neptune, ink blue Rahu; applies to any house's body spot.

derived_examples.reading: Sun in the 7th: light blue applied on the spot to install Neptune there.
Planet afflicting lagna: light blue on the head/upper-body spot to install Neptune.

ambiguity: 'सूर्य के एक नंबर' is garbled; the colour mapping itself is clear.
classical_check: Silent; planet-colour assignment for Neptune is his.

hindi: तो नेप्च्यून या सात बैठ गया तो सूर्य को नाश नहीं करने देगा। तकलीफ चल सकती है। अगर हमने इसको बिल्कुल क्रश करके खत्म कर देना है तो नीला नॉर्मल हिंक ब्लू डाल दो। सूर्य ही डेड हो जाएगा। यहां सूर्य क्रश हो जाएगा।
says: With light-blue Neptune installed the Sun is not fully destroyed, some trouble may continue; to crush the Sun completely use normal ink blue and the Sun there is dead.
cells_derived_method: Light blue gives partial blocking, ink blue (Rahu) full blocking of the Sun on the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: light blue gives partial relief, ink blue crushes its aspect on lagna Aries.
Sun on the 7th in Aries: ink blue crushes strong aspect on lagna Libra.

ambiguity: 'नेप्च्यून या सात बैठ गया' is garbled.

hindi: इससे इसकी माता से इसकी जो लड़ाई होती थी संबंध खराब थे। पिता से भी हो सकते हैं। कभी ये माता के लिए काम करेगा कभी पिता। ये कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है। मान के चलो एक से रिलेशनशिप खराब कर रहा है। तो ये लड़ाई बंद करा देगा। प्रेम
says: Result of the remedy: fights with the mother (or father) with whom relations were bad will stop; he says it works on one or the other parent and is complicated; it stops the fight but (continued in next slice) does not create love.
cells_derived_method: Sun on the 7th aspecting lagna harms relations with parents; the remedy mutes it.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: strained bond with father softened.
Sun on the 7th in Aries: ego clashes with parents cooled.

ambiguity: Which parent is affected is unclear ('complicated').

hindi: नहीं कराएगा। ये ध्यान रखें। अगर यहां पर नेप्च्यून लाइट ब्लू कलर सेट कर लेता है इसको तो प्रेम करा सकता है कभी-कभी। लेकिन अगर यहां पर ब्लू कलर आ गया तो प्रेम नहीं कराएगा। लड़ाई बंद करा देगा। दोनों दूर-दूर हो जाएंगे एक दूसरे से अलग।
says: Light-blue Neptune can sometimes bring affection, but ink blue stops fights without creating love and the two drift apart.
cells_derived_method: Light blue softens and may produce love; ink blue only ends conflict and gives distance.

derived_examples.reading: Light blue for the Sun on the 7th in Libra: occasional warmth with parent.
Ink blue for the Sun on the 7th in Aries: conflict ends, parent and child grow apart.

hindi: चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम है। जो भी समस्या चेस्ट की है वो हार्ट अटैक होने नहीं देगा। वो ब्लॉक कर देगा। कंट्रोल कर देगा।
says: For chest problems the blue remedy blocks and controls any chest trouble from reaching a heart attack. Health claim from tradition, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: Chest/heart is the 4th house and Sun; blue colour on that spot controls the affliction.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted 4th in Libra: blue remedy on chest spot said to control heart trouble.
Afflicted 4th in Cancer: blue remedy said to control chest trouble.

ambiguity: Cannot be taken as a medical claim; stated in his words as certain.

hindi: यही आपके यहां पर सूर्य आ जाता है। तो यहां पर भी ब्लू ही कलर आएगा। ब्लू कलर आएगा।
says: The same applies if the Sun comes at this place: blue colour is used again.
cells_derived_method: Blue colour applied for a Sun affliction in another house/body spot (the chest).

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 4th in Libra: blue colour on chest spot.
Sun on the 10th in Aries: blue only if the Sun harms.

ambiguity: 'यहां पर' is unspecified; likely the chest/4th house.

hindi: यहां पर अब आपने समुद्र का पानी स्थापित करना है। खुला मैदान देखो जहां किसी पेड़ पौधे बिल्डिंग घास की छाया नहीं पड़ती। ऐसे खुले मैदान के अंदर एक कांच की बोतल लो। कांच की बोतल में छोटी सी हो इतनी सी समुद्र का पानी भरना है। समुद्र का पानी भर के जमीन में गड्ढा करके दबाया। ऊपर से मिट्टी डाल के बंद।
says: Remedy to install Neptune: in an open ground with no shade of tree, plant or building, bury a small glass bottle filled with seawater in a pit and close with soil.
cells_derived_method: Seawater burial installs Neptune at the land spot that corresponds to the body part of the afflicted house.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: seawater bottle buried in an open field.
Afflicted 4th: same burial for the chest/heart spot.

classical_check: Silent; modern remedy (outer planet) by him.

hindi: यह खुला मैदान है। यह नाभि के नीचे का इलाका है। आपके सातवें घर का सूर्य है।
says: The open ground represents the area below the navel, i.e. the 7th house, where the Sun sits.
cells_derived_method: Body mapping: 7th house = region below the navel; used to match the burial spot.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: below-navel region affected.
Sun on the 7th in Aries: same body region matched.

classical_check: Classical kalapurusha: 7th is lower abdomen/genitals; agrees.

hindi: ऑपरेशन के बदले में अल्टरनेट रास्ता निकाल देगा यह।
says: The seawater remedy will give an alternative route in place of an operation. Health claim from tradition, not advice.
cells_derived_method: Neptune installation on the lower-abdomen spot is said to avoid surgery for 7th house body problems.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: lower-abdominal problem managed without operation.
Afflicted 7th in Scorpio: genital/urinary issue handled by alternatives.

ambiguity: Medical claim, not verifiable.

hindi: अगर इसको टोटली ब्लॉक करना है तो ऐसी जगह पे चाय की पत्ती मुट्ठी लो। दो मुट्ठी, चार मुट्ठी जितनी मर्जी यह लेकर के जमीन के अंदर जमीन में गाढ़ी कागज की थैली में डाल दी। प्लास्टिक की नहीं प्लास्टिक अलग होता है। कागज अलग होता है। ये बहुत सारी चीजें नॉर्मल कागज की थैली में डाली। ब्राउन थैली आती है। अखबार की थैली होती है। वैसे ही उसमें डाल दिया। उसमें डाल के मिट्टी की जमीन में डाला। ऊपर से मिट्टी डाल के बंद कर दी।
says: To block the planet totally, bury tea leaves (a fistful or more) in a plain paper bag, not plastic, in the same open ground and cover with soil.
cells_derived_method: Tea leaves burial installs Rahu (full blocking) at the body-matched spot.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: tea leaves buried to block its aspect on lagna.
Sun on the 7th in Aries: full block if exalted aspect harms.

ambiguity: Plastic vs paper difference is stated but unexplained.

hindi: यहां पर आपने राहु को स्थापित कर दिया। यही देसी खांड करते हैं। मंगल के लिए हो जाता है। और भी कई चीजें हैं। लेकिन सूर्य के लिए हमारे को यही करना है। सूर्य का दोष इसी से ठीक होता है।
says: This installs Rahu; desi unrefined sugar does the same for Mars, there are other items, but for the Sun this is what is to be done and it cures the Sun's dosha.
cells_derived_method: Planet-to-substance burial: tea for Sun (Rahu), jaggery/khand for Mars.

derived_examples.reading: Sun on the 7th in Libra: tea burial corrects the Sun dosha.
Mars on lagna Aries: unrefined sugar burial.

ambiguity: 'देसी खांड' for Mars is stated in passing.

hindi: एक नंबर में राहु का इफेक्ट भी ऐसा नहीं आएगा कि कोई एक नंबर में राहु कुछ खराबी नहीं कर रहा। इसलिए ब्लू कलर का हमारा यही ब्लू कलर लाइट हो गया। नेप्च्यून बन गया। डार्क हो गया। नॉर्मल इंक ब्लू ये आपका नेप्च्यून वरून बन गया।
says: Rahu on sign/house 1 does no damage there; so the same blue colour in light shade is Neptune and in dark ink shade becomes (in the caption) Neptune-Varuna, which likely means Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in the 1st (lagna) is harmless per him; colour shade tells the planet: light Neptune, dark Rahu.

derived_examples.reading: Rahu in lagna Aries: no damage per this view.
Rahu in lagna Gemini: likewise harmless.
Rahu in lagna Aquarius: harmless, shade rule applies.

ambiguity: Last clause is contradictory ('dark ink blue becomes Neptune Varuna'); earlier he assigned ink blue to Rahu.
classical_check: Classical texts: Rahu in the 1st is generally troublesome; this differs.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा आपका मान के चलते हैं। चंद्रमा यहां पर आपका सात नंबर है। एक नंबर का यहां नाश कर रहा है। ये एक नंबर मंगल के लिए हम क्या करें यहां
says: New example: the Moon on the 7th aspects and damages the 1st (Aries, a Mars sign); what remedy do we apply for Mars at that spot?
cells_derived_method: Moon on the 7th aspects the 1st by 7th aspect; with Aries lagna the afflicted sign is Mars-ruled.

derived_examples.reading: Moon on the 7th in Libra aspects lagna Aries: damages Mars-ruled lagna.
Moon on the 7th in Pisces aspects lagna Virgo: damages Mercury-ruled lagna instead.
Moon (exalted) on the 7th in Taurus aspects lagna Scorpio: damages Mars-ruled lagna (co-lord).

ambiguity: Continues into the next slice ('यहां पर?').

hindi: अब हमारे को यहां पर मंगल के लिए मंगल की राशि ले ली। हमने यहां पर पेट पे कमर पे हमने लाल धागा बांधना है। लाल धागा बांधने से अगर हमारे को चार नंबर राशि यहां साइड इफेक्ट आ रहा है। क्योंकि मंगल की चार नंबर चौथी दृष्टि आएगी।
says: For Mars (sign 1, Aries) tie a red thread on the belly and waist; the side effect is on sign/house 4 because Mars's 4th aspect from the 1st falls there.
cells_derived_method: Red thread installs Mars at lagna's body spot; Mars aspects 4th, 7th, 8th from where it is, so the 4th (Cancer for Aries lagna) takes a side effect.

derived_examples.reading: Mars installed for lagna Aries: its 4th aspect falls on the 4th in Cancer.
Mars installed for lagna Leo: 4th aspect falls on the 4th in Scorpio.
Mars installed for lagna Libra: 4th aspect falls on the 4th in Capricorn.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' both as 4th house and sign Cancer; here it is read as the 4th house from Aries lagna.

hindi: मंगल यहां रखा हमने पेट पे कमर पे नाभि बांध दिया चार नंबर खराब करेगा तो इसका पेट खराब रहेगा व्यक्ति का इसका डब्ल्यूबीसी कम होगा
says: Placing Mars on the navel/waist spoils the 4th, so the person's stomach stays bad and WBC count is low. Medical claim from tradition, not advice.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspecting the 4th/Cancer region (stomach, chest) disturbs digestion; applies to the 4th house in any sign.

derived_examples.reading: Mars aspecting the 4th in Cancer: stomach complaints, low immunity.
Mars aspecting the 4th in Libra: kidney/abdomen trouble.
Mars aspecting the 4th in Capricorn: digestive-joint issues.

ambiguity: Which sign is the 4th depends on the lagna; he states 4th house as Cancer in the Aries-lagna example.

hindi: चंद्रमा अगर दूषित है तो दूध से एलर्जी होगी मंगल दूषित है दवाइयों से एलर्जी होगी आपका शनि दूषित है कुंडली में तो आपको तेल से एलर्जी होगी घी से एलर्जी होगी शुक्र से है तो ऐसे-ऐसे एलर्जीज़ होती हैं। ये एक अलग टॉपिक है।
says: Allergy mapping: afflicted Moon gives milk allergy, afflicted Mars gives medicine allergy, afflicted Saturn oil and ghee allergy, Venus other allergies; he calls it a separate topic. Medical claim from tradition.
cells_derived_method: Planet affliction maps to allergen: Moon-milk, Mars-medicine, Saturn-oil/ghee; house of affliction (6th) shows when.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted Moon on the 6th in Cancer: milk allergy.
Afflicted Mars on the 6th in Aries: allergy to medicines.
Afflicted Saturn on the 6th in Capricorn: oil and ghee allergy.

ambiguity: Venus example is trailing and unclear.

hindi: तो मंगल अगर एक नंबर है और यहां पर ये दोष कर रहा है। चार नंबर राशि को खराब कर देगा। तो इसके लिए हम यहां पर मंगल में बहुत थोड़ा सा लाइट ब्लू हम नेप्च्यून सेट कर सकते हैं। ये लाइट ब्लू कलर है। तो ये पर्पल कलर हो जाएगा।
says: To offset Mars's harm on sign 4, mix a little light blue (Neptune) into the red of Mars; the mix becomes purple.
cells_derived_method: Red plus light blue gives purple thread: Mars installed with Neptune dampening its 4th aspect.

derived_examples.reading: Mars in lagna Aries: purple thread instead of red.
Mars-linked lagna Leo: purple thread also dampens the 4th aspect on Scorpio.

hindi: पर्पल पर्पल कलर नाभि पे कमर पे धागा बांधो। इसके पेट दर्द में आराम हो जाएगा। गृहस्थ जीवन में थोड़े तनाव की स्थिति आराम बनेगी।
says: Tie a purple thread at the navel or waist: it eases stomach pain and some tension in household life. Remedy claim, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: Purple thread on navel for Mars-aspect problems of the 4th and 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Afflicted 4th in Cancer: stomach pain and home tension reduced.
Afflicted 7th in Libra: domestic tension eased.

hindi: चंद्रमा सातवां एक नंबर पर राशि दृष्टि हो जाने से इसकी बॉडी के अंदर आयरन की डेफिशिएंसी रहनी है। विटामिन डी जल्दी डिप्लेट होगा। हर हालत के अंदर इसको फैरोटिन कम रहेगा। इसकी ये भी एक आयरन बाइंडिंग हार्मोन होता है और उसकी बॉडी के अंदर हीमोग्लोबिन काउंट डेफिशिएंसी हो सकती है।
says: Moon on the 7th aspecting sign 1 (Aries) gives iron deficiency, quickly depleting vitamin D, low ferritin and possible low haemoglobin. Medical-type claim from tradition, not diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Moon on the 7th aspecting a Mars sign lagna (Aries) shows blood and iron deficiency; Mars is iron karaka, Moon is body fluid.

derived_examples.reading: Moon on the 7th in Libra aspects lagna Aries: iron deficiency and low haemoglobin.
Moon (debilitated) on the 7th in Scorpio aspects lagna Taurus: blood-fluid weakness without Mars lagna.
Moon on the 7th in Pisces aspects lagna Virgo: nutrient absorption problems.

hindi: उसके लिए इसको मंगल का या पर्पल धागा बांध के होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन कराओ ठीक हो जाएगा। अन्यथा पेट की समस्या ठीक कभी होगी नहीं क्योंकि एक नंबर राशि है। यहां मंगल स्थापित करना है हमें नाभि पर और एक नंबर में खराबी कोई नहीं करेगा।
says: Remedy: tie a Mars (red) or purple thread and take homeopathic medicine and it will be cured; otherwise the stomach problem never heals since the sign is 1; establish Mars at the navel, and no one spoils sign 1. Medical claim flagged.
cells_derived_method: Mars thread at the navel for a lagna-Aries stomach problem; homeopathy is added.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna Aries with Moon on 7th: red or purple thread plus homeopathy.
Lagna Scorpio with Moon placed on the 7th: same Mars thread idea, since Scorpio is also Mars-ruled.

ambiguity: 'Nobody spoils sign 1' is an assertion that Aries lagna is never spoiled.

hindi: अगर पूरा लाल हमने डाल दिया और पति या पत्नी की तेज जबान हो गई तो सोचो मंगल की जरूरत नहीं है। थोड़ा सा इसमें नीला रंग मिक्स करने की जरूरत है। नहीं तो मंगल उग्रता देता है।
says: If pure red makes the spouse sharp-tongued, mix a little blue because pure Mars gives aggressiveness.
cells_derived_method: Pure red installs full Mars in the 7th, making partner harsh; adding blue calms it.

derived_examples.reading: Red thread with Moon on the 7th in Libra: spouse harsh; add blue.
Mars-type 7th in Aries: strongly aggressive spouse; blue added.

hindi: सातवें घर के अंदर अगर मंगल बैठा हो राशि की सेकेंडरी बात हो जाती है। तो पति या पत्नी सेनापति की तरह होंगे। अगर उनकी दृष्टि है तो कम बैठे हैं तो पूरा सेनापति
says: Mars seated in the 7th makes the sign secondary: the spouse acts like a commander (full commander if seated, less if only aspecting).
cells_derived_method: Mars on the 7th (any sign): commanding spouse; aspecting gives a lesser version.

derived_examples.reading: Mars (exalted) on the 7th in Capricorn: spouse a commanding disciplinarian.
Mars (debilitated) on the 7th in Cancer: demanding, irritable spouse.
Mars on the 7th in Pisces: spouse commanding but soft in manner.

ambiguity: He says the sign becomes secondary; this follows his multi-sign house idea.
classical_check: Classical Mars in the 7th: Kuja dosha, aggression; agrees in spirit.

hindi: सेनापति का काम क्या है दाएं मुड़ बाएं मुड़ ऊपर देख नीचे देख यहां जा वहां जा बैठ जा यानी आदेशात्मक तो लड़ाईयां होती है पतिपत्नी में जबरदस्त घर्षण मंगल महाराज वैसे भी लड़ाई कराते हैं
says: A commander gives orders all the time, so husband and wife fight and have great friction; Mars causes fights anyway.
cells_derived_method: Commanding spouse leads to marital friction; houses 7 and 4 show it.

derived_examples.reading: Mars on the 7th in Aries: ordering spouse, constant quarrels.
Mars on the 4th in Scorpio: friction at home.
Mars on the 7th in Leo: spouse proud and commanding, clashes.

hindi: हनुमान जी ब्रह्मचारी है हनुमान जी ब्रह्मचारी हम
says: Remark that Hanuman, the deity linked with Mars, is celibate, hinting Mars is unsuited to marital life.
cells_derived_method: Mars deity celibacy suggests Mars is unfavourable for marriage in the 7th and 2nd.

derived_examples.reading: Mars on the 7th in Aries: marital life strained, celibate tendency.
Mars on the 2nd in Scorpio: family life unsettled.

ambiguity: Cut-off phrase; the remark is incomplete.
classical_check: Classical: Hanuman is Mars-linked remedy deity; celibacy link is his.

gist: Audience asks why the 4th sign (water) is mentioned when WBC was said to drop, since the Moon's 7th aspect falls on sign 1, not 4; he answers by clarifying Moon's role.

hindi: चंद्रमा डब्ल्यूबीसी है चंद्रमा वाटर बॉडी का सारा का सारा चंद्रमा आयरन है आपका एक नंबर या आठ नंबर का चंद्रमा आ गया खराब करेगा
says: Moon rules WBC and all body water; Mars rules iron; Moon in Aries or Scorpio, the Mars signs, damages blood and body fluid.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Mars signs spoils fluid and blood balance; house shows which area.

derived_examples.reading: Moon in lagna Aries: low immunity, body fluid imbalance.
Moon (debilitated) on the 7th in Scorpio: strong fluid/blood disturbance.
Moon (debilitated) on the 4th in Scorpio: chest/digestive fluid problems.

ambiguity: Wording 'आयरन है आपका' appears to say Mars is iron; Moon in sign 1 or 8 is the actual claim.
classical_check: Classical: Moon debilitated in Scorpio agrees; Moon in Aries is neutral.

hindi: अब इसको हमने भ्रमित करना है ताकि खराबी ठीक होए तो या तो ये मंगल से ठीक होगी लेकिन मंगल अगर यहां लगाते हैं तो खतरा यह है कि आपका पार्टनर सेनापति ना बन जाए अगर वह बिल्कुल ही हल्के ग्रह है उसके बहुत कुछ देखना पड़ता है कुंडली में यह मोटे तौर पे है तो सेनापति अगर बन रहा है तो इसको लाल रंग को डाइल्यूट कर दो। लाल रंग के अंदर नीला मिला दो तो वह पर्पल बन जाता है।
says: To fix the Moon's damage we confuse it with Neptune: Mars would fix it, but installing Mars risks the partner turning commander (check the chart), so dilute red by mixing blue to get purple.
cells_derived_method: Mars remedy has side-effect on the 7th house (partner turns commander); blending Neptune's blue lowers the risk.

derived_examples.reading: Moon on the 7th in Libra: purple thread rather than red avoids domineering partner.
Weak Mars-like partner on the 7th in Aries: pure red may still be risky, so dilute.

ambiguity: He says to check the chart for the partner's planet strength (not specified).

hindi: पर्पल बन जाने से मंगल की यहां पूर्ण दृष्टि नहीं आएगी। लाल होने से मिक्स हो गया। यहीं पर डाइल्यूशन हो गई उसकी।
says: When the thread colour is purple (red mixed with blue), Mars no longer throws its full aspect on the spot; because red got mixed with another colour, Mars is diluted there.
cells_derived_method: none: it is about colour mixing in a thread remedy, not a particular house or sign.
ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) points at a body spot he showed on the board; which house/sign is not in the caption.
classical_check: Silent: thread colour mixing as planetary dilution is his own remedy system, not in classical texts.

hindi: तो यहां पर क्या काम होगा? उसका नीचता नहीं करेगा। खराब नहीं करेगा। हर उपाय का साइड इफेक्ट जरूर बनता है।
says: A diluted Mars (purple) will not act in its low, nasty way and will not spoil things; he adds that every remedy has some side effect.
ambiguity: 'उसका नीचता' could mean Mars's lowness (debilitation-like behaviour) or just its meanness.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss remedy side effects this way.

hindi: हमारी लड़ाई है कि फायदा 10 हो। साइड इफेक्ट दो हो तो वी आर हैप्पी।
says: His remedy goal is a benefit-to-side-effect ratio of about 10 to 2; he accepts small side effects if the gain is large.

hindi: तो चंद्रमा का यहां हो जाने से एलर्जी देता है। डब्ल्यूबीसी काउंट कम कर देगा बॉडी के अंदर।
says: If the Moon colour/planet is placed at this spot, it gives allergy and lowers the white blood cell count. He is making a body-health claim (medical, recorded only as his claim).
cells_derived_method: none: the spot is not named in the caption, so no house/sign spread can be derived.
ambiguity: 'यहां' unknown house or body part; Moon here may be a thread/colour placement, not a natal Moon.
classical_check: Silent: Moon rules fluids and immunity loosely in tradition, blood-count claim is his.

hindi: एलर्जी की शिकायत देता है। पेट में एलर्जी हो गई इस व्यक्ति को। लैक्टोस इनटोलरेंट हो गया किसी ना किसी तरह।
says: The same Moon placement leads to a stomach allergy in the person, ending in lactose intolerance (milk is Moon's thing). Health claim of his, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Whether this describes a case study person or a general rule is not clear.
classical_check: Silent: Moon as milk and stomach fluids is classical karaka logic, the lactose link is his own.

hindi: नेप्च्यून चार नंबर में तो भी लैक्टोस इनटोलरेंस ही नहीं होता। नहीं नेप्च्यून चार नंबर में तो है ही नहीं।
says: Self-correction: with Neptune in number 4 (Cancer sign or 4th place) lactose intolerance does not happen; Neptune is not the cause there.
cells_derived_method: If '4' means Cancer (Moon's sign), Neptune there is read as healing, so milk problems are not produced. If '4' means the 4th house, the same holds in all 12 lagnas that put Neptune fourth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Neptune in Libra in the 4th house means lagna 7-4+1=4 Cancer; Cancer lagna, Neptune in the 4th gives home-peace healing rather than stomach upset.
Derived, not said: Neptune in Cancer in the 12th means lagna 4-12+1=-7->5 Leo; Leo lagna, Neptune healing in the foot/sleep area, no milk intolerance.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' could be sign 4 (Cancer) or house 4; he uses both ways in this series.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: वो तो हील कर रहा है। वो तो हीलर है। नेप्च्यून तो हील कर देता है। ठीक कर देता है। अजीब-अजीब तकलीफें। ड्रग से भी ठीक नहीं होगा। नेप्च्यून से हो जाएगा।
says: Neptune is the healer planet: it can cure strange, odd ailments that drugs cannot, so Neptune is used where medicine fails.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-level role, not changing across houses or signs in his statement.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune not in classical texts; healing role comes from modern/Western association.

hindi: कृपा तभी तो कहते हैं कृपा से होगा। जो किसी चीज से नहीं कृपा से होगा। इसमें केतु का सम्मेलन है ना बहुत तगड़ा।
says: What nothing else cures happens by grace (kripa), and Neptune is the grace planet; he notes a very strong Ketu gathering/influence in this setup.
ambiguity: 'सम्मेलन' (conference) most likely means conjunction or strong linkage with Ketu, but the caption does not say where.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; Ketu as grace/moksha karaka is classical.

hindi: तो सर जैसे फोर्थ एस्पेक्ट हुए काम करेगा ए पे भी करेगा मंगल करेगा 100% पैसे भी वही देगा सेकंड हाउस में
says: Mars's 4th aspect will work 100 percent on its target, and it is the same Mars that will give money in the 2nd house.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from itself. 4th aspect lands on house 2 when Mars sits in house 11 (11+3=14->2). The money meaning of the target house changes with the sign there, Taurus/Libra for earned and bank money, Scorpio for sudden or joint money.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Taurus in the 2nd house means lagna 2-2+1=1 Aries; Mars's aspect on it pushes direct earning through effort and family wealth.
Derived, not said: Scorpio in 2nd means lagna Libra-2+1=7 Libra; Mars aspect there stirs sudden, risky, shared money.

ambiguity: 'फोर्थ एस्पेक्ट' counted from where, and 'ए' unclear (probably '8' sign/house). Garbled caption.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars's special aspect is the 4th and 8th from itself (plus 7th). Money from 2nd-house aspect is standard.

hindi: पैसे भी देगा आठ नंबर पे यही इन धागों का कमाल है आपका यहां पर बैठा हुआ है
says: The same Mars will also give money on the 8th (via its 8th aspect or position); he calls this the marvel of the threads: one coloured thread works across several spots.
cells_derived_method: Money from 8th depends on the sign: in Scorpio sudden/inheritance/insurance, in Cancer or Pisces through mother/hidden sources, in Gemini through partner's side.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Scorpio in the 8th means lagna 8-8+1=1 Aries; Mars own-sign influence brings insurance/ancestral or sudden money.
Derived, not said: Pisces in 8th (lagna 12-8+1=5 Leo) Mars aspect gives hidden or foreign-source money with delays.

ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर' sign or house. Whether this is the 8th aspect or placement of Mars is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mars 8th aspect is classical; thread method is his own.

hindi: मान लो दूसरा अलग-अलग ग्रह ले लो कौन सा बुध अब 12 नंबर का बुध बैठा है मान लो नीच का उदाहरण छह भी बैठा है यहां
says: New example with Mercury: take Mercury of sign number 12 (Pisces, its debilitation sign) sitting there, and also the Mercury of number 6 (Virgo) sitting at the same spot.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Pisces is debilitated, in Virgo exalted and own. House shifts the topic: 12th = foot/loss, 6th = enemy/disease. A Virgo Mercury in the 12th gives lagna Libra; a Pisces Mercury in the 6th gives lagna Libra too.
