says: The nose bone is crooked in every case; what to do? He says never operate on it. A medical-advice claim of his, recorded only and not endorsed.
classical_check: Silent: no classical guidance on surgery.

hindi: शनि को छेड़ेंगे नहीं। यह कैंसर की तरह मैलिगनेंसी बढ़ा देगा। अंधाधुंध बुरे हाल होंगे और वह हड्डी ठीक कभी नहीं होगी क्योंकि शनि महाराज बैठे हैं।
says: Do not disturb Saturn; operating would spread malignancy like cancer, the bone would never heal since Saturn sits there. A medical warning of his, recorded only and not endorsed.

hindi: तो यह क्या करें? नाक के हड्डी की करेक्शन के लिए छठे घर पे जाके धागा बांधे। 6/7 था पीछे चला गया। 1/2 है। तो यहां क्या बांधे? लाल धागा। नवांश में चेक कर लेते हैं।
says: For the nose-bone correction, tie a thread at the spot of the 6th house, which with the 6/7 lagna shifts back to signs 1/2, and the colour to tie there is red; first check this in the navamsa.
cells_derived_method: Thread spot = the body zone of the house; colour = the planet to strengthen (red Mars) in the signs there. Ranges: signs 1/2 are Aries (Mars) and Taurus (Venus).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Aries in the 6th means lagna 1-6+1=-4->8 Scorpio; red thread supports Mars own sign.
Derived, not said: Taurus in the 6th means lagna 2-6+1=-3->9 Sagittarius; a red thread then clashes with Venus's sign.

ambiguity: His counting is unclear: '6/7 went back to 1/2' does not match the 6th house (signs 11/12 here); signs 1/2 are the 8th house, which fits the later left-leg 8th-house thread, so the caption or his words are inconsistent.
classical_check: Silent: thread remedies are his method.

hindi: लाल धागा इसके लिए ओके रहेगा कि नहीं? ये केपी नवांश कहां गया? ये रहा। ये रहा। लाल धागा यहां बिल्कुल ठीक है।
says: Checking the red thread in the navamsa and KP chart, he finds the red thread is fine for this person.

hindi: अगर इसके आठवें घर में लेफ्ट पैर में लाल धागा बांधेंगे तो इसके आधे सर की दर्द ठीक हो जाएगी।
says: A red thread on the left leg, the 8th-house spot, will cure the person's half-head pain (migraine-type). A health claim of his, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Thread on the body part for the house: 8th spot = left leg in his map. Mars thread works on headache as Mars rules head.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; red thread on 8th spot, Mars as 7th lord in 8th, soothes half-head pain.
Derived, not said: lagna Virgo; Mars own sign in the 8th, thread supports the planet there.

ambiguity: Left leg for the 8th house is his body map; contrast with the earlier right-foot mapping of 12 and 6.

hindi: मजे की बात एक आंख में सिलड्रिकल नंबर है। एक में स्फेरिकल क्योंकि एक पेशेंट ये आस्पेक्ट कर रहा है। दूसरा ठीक है। लेकिन इसको आंख की प्रॉब्लम आएगी।
says: One eye has a cylindrical power and the other spherical because one aspect is working on one side only; the other eye is fine, but eye trouble will come.
ambiguity: 'पेशेंट' is likely 'planet' or 'one planet aspecting'; garbled.

hindi: लॉन्ग रन में एक आंख से अंधत्व देता है। यानी एक आंख के अंदर इसको ऑप्टिकल वेन से ब्रेन में विज़न की सप्लाई कम होगी। क्योंकि शुक्र की यहां नीच दृष्टि है।
says: In the long run it threatens blindness in one eye, as vision supply from the optic nerve to the brain falls, because Venus casts a low (debilitated-type) aspect here. A medical prediction of his, recorded only.
ambiguity: 'नीच दृष्टि' is garbled: Venus's aspect from a debilitated position, or a low-quality aspect.
classical_check: Silent: Venus is not usually blamed for optic-nerve loss; classics blame Sun, Moon and the 2nd and 12th.

hindi: शुक्र का है। अंधा होगा। नहीं बुद्ध बचा रहा है। बुद्ध कह रहा है अंधा नहीं होने दूंगा। तो यह इसको पैर आंख का डिफेक्ट रहेगा।
says: It is Venus's work and the eye would go blind, but no: Mercury is protecting and refuses to let blindness come, so only an eye and leg defect remains.

hindi: आंख का डिफेक्ट कम हो जाए के लिए क्या होगा? इसके पैर में डिफेक्ट है। तो पैर पे चोट आ गई तो बुध यहां पावर पकड़ लेगा तो यहां भी पावर पकड़ लेगा। तो इसके पैर पे चोट आने दो। इसका दांत टूटता है। दांत टूटने दो। इसकी आंख बज जाएगी।
says: To reduce the eye defect: if the foot gets hurt Mercury gains power there and then also on the eye; so let foot injuries and a broken tooth happen, the eye will be spared.
cells_derived_method: Mercury rules foot, teeth and nerves in his scheme; a small injury at its zones discharges the harm that would otherwise land on the eye.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Pisces in the 12th means lagna 12-12+1=1 Aries; Mercury debilitated in the 12th, foot injury absorbs the harm.
Derived, not said: Gemini in the 2nd means lagna 3-2+1=2 Taurus; Mercury own sign in the 2nd, tooth trouble in place of eye trouble.

ambiguity: 'आंख बज जाएगी' reads 'the eye will be saved' (typo for 'बच').
classical_check: Silent: transferring harm to a lesser body part is his principle.

hindi: और उसके लिए क्या करें? ये बहन, बुआ, बेटी, साली, अन्य स्त्री किसी का जिससे इसका संभोग नहीं हो सकता। एक्चुअल मतलब समझने का यह है जो इसके लिए कंवारी कन्या है उसका धन ना खाए उससे आशीर्वाद ले बुध पावर पकड़ लेगा
says: Remedy for Mercury: take blessings from women who are not marriageable for him (sister, father's sister, daughter, sister-in-law, other women) or from unmarried girls, and do not eat their money; Mercury then gains power.
ambiguity: 'कंवारी कन्या' (unmarried girl) is the classical Mercury remedy; the full list of women is his reading of 'women he cannot mate with'.
classical_check: Agrees: honouring girls and sisters is a classic Mercury remedy; not eating a girl's wealth is also traditional.

hindi: इसकी आंख पूरी बच जाएगी तकलीफ चलती रहेगी और इलाज होते रहेंगे शनि आंख के अंदर इंजेक्शन जरूर लगवाएगा ये आंख का ऑपरेशन कराता है लेकिन आंख बची रहेगी
says: The eye will be fully saved but trouble and treatment continue; Saturn will force injections inside the eye and eye operations, yet the eye survives. A medical prediction of his, recorded only.

hindi: और नाक की हड्डी टेढ़ी है इसके लिए होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन करे होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन से इसको रिलीफ आएगा होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन सूट कराने के लिए इसको मोती चाहिए चंद्रमा नीच तुल्य है मोती चाहिए मोती पहनाओ कार्य में भी लाभ होगा।
says: For the crooked nose bone he advises homeopathic medicine, and to make homeopathy suit the person he prescribes a pearl for the near-debilitated Moon; the pearl will also bring gains in work. A medical and gem remedy of his, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Pearl is for strengthening the Moon, which he calls near-debilitated in Aries; in a house where the Moon is already strong it would be dropped.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Moon in Aries in the 7th, pearl recommended to steady partner and mind.
Derived, not said: lagna Aquarius; Moon in Aries in the 3rd, pearl for stable effort and communication.

ambiguity: Homeopathy as a medical treatment is his advice, not a recommendation of this analysis.
classical_check: Differs: the Moon is not debilitated in Aries; pearl for the Moon is classical.

hindi: नेप्च्यून का सर इस क्लास से रिलेटेड हमें नेप्च्यून देखना। नेप्च्यून है ना? ये तीसरा नेप्च्यून है ना? हां जी। तीसरा जबरदस्त ज्ञान है इस आदमी को। यह धर्म से जुड़ा हुआ व्यक्ति होएगा।
says: Back to the case chart: since this class is on Neptune, look at Neptune; it sits in the 3rd house, which gives the man tremendous knowledge and ties him to religion or dharma.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 3rd (courage, siblings, learning by effort) takes its flavour from the sign: Sagittarius gives religious learning, Scorpio occult and research knowledge.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Sagittarius in the 3rd means lagna 9-3+1=7 Libra; Neptune there gives a dharma-linked, teaching mind.
Derived, not said: Scorpio in the 3rd means lagna 8-3+1=6 Virgo; Neptune in the 3rd gives investigative, occult interest.

ambiguity: 'तीसरा' here is the 3rd house (the case chart shows Neptune in sign 9 there).
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; the 3rd house giving self-effort learning is classical.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति के साथ हर हालत के अंदर यह हाल होगा कि इंट्यूटिव पावर्स होंगी या इसके पास कोई व्यक्ति होगा जुड़ा हुआ जो इसका इंट्यूटिव पावर्स जानता हो। इसके पास ज्योतिष का ज्ञान होगा या ज्योतिषी के साथ बहुत क्लोज जुड़ा जुड़ा होगा हर हालत में।
says: The person will in every case either have intuitive powers himself or be close to someone who knows his intuitive powers; he will know astrology or be closely tied to an astrologer.
cells_derived_method: none: result stated as fixed for Neptune in the 3rd of this chart.
ambiguity: Whether this is a general rule for Neptune in the 3rd or only for this chart is not stated.

hindi: इसका अपना एक भाई या बहन ऐसा होगा जो या तो परिवार छोड़ के चला गया या महा दारूबाज या महा ऐश अय्याशी करने वाला होगा। लेकिन होगा वो बहुत अच्छा क्योंकि नौ नंबर है।
says: One sibling will either have left the family or be a heavy drinker or debauched, but still a good person at heart because Neptune sits in sign 9 (Sagittarius), a friendly sign.
cells_derived_method: The 3rd is siblings; Neptune there makes one sibling an escapist; the sign decides tone: Sagittarius good-natured, Capricorn or Scorpio hostile.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; escapist but kind sibling.
Derived, not said: lagna Virgo; Neptune in Scorpio in the 3rd, the sibling is addicted and hostile.

classical_check: Silent: the 3rd house as siblings is classical, Neptune's drink and escape role is modern.

hindi: अगर बुरी राशि का होता तो इससे दुश्मनी होती पैसे खा जाता इसका। लेकिन अच्छी राशि का है इसका मतलब पैसे भी है सर साथसा आठ आठ नंबर राशि आठ भी है। थोड़ा बुरा भी जाएगा तभी मैंने नशेड़ी फशेड़ी कर दिया ना। एक राशि पीछे गई ना नशेड़ी फशेड़ी रहेगा।
says: In a bad sign the sibling would be an enemy and eat his money; in a good sign the sibling has money; since the 3rd house also touches sign 8 (Scorpio) there is a bad side, so the sibling will be an addict because one sign goes back.
cells_derived_method: A house with two signs (8/9) is read twice: the Sagittarius half is kind, the Scorpio half is harsh, so the result is mixed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; sibling with money and goodwill.
Derived, not said: lagna Virgo; sibling gets into intoxicants and strife.

ambiguity: 'एक राशि पीछे गई' means the 3rd house's second sign (8); caption noisy.
classical_check: Agrees with the project's multi-sign house principle; silent on Neptune.

hindi: इसके कंधे पे हल्की सी चोट आएगी जिसका ये कुछ कर नहीं पाएगा लेकिन रहेगी। तो इसके कंधे पे इंजेक्शन लग चुका होगा या कंधे पे चोट है तो कंधे पे निशान होगा या हड्डी पे इसके एक साइड की थोड़ा प्रेशर पड़ेगा। कंधे में थोड़ा दर्द आ सकता है।
says: A light shoulder injury will come that cannot be cured but stays: either an injection mark, a scar or some bone pressure on one side, with occasional shoulder pain; the shoulder is the 3rd-house zone. A body-health claim of his.
cells_derived_method: The 3rd house covers shoulders, arms and hands; an afflicted planet there marks that zone. Scorpio half adds injection or scar, Sagittarius half hip-thigh strain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Virgo; Neptune in Scorpio in the 3rd, an injection or surgical scar at the shoulder.
Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Neptune in Sagittarius in the 3rd, a strain or pressure on the shoulder bone.

classical_check: Agrees on the 3rd house giving shoulder and arm; the specific injury is his.

gist: Audience acknowledges with 'okay sir' and the class settles.

hindi: इसके शनि का देखो ना अब इसको शनि एक्टिवेट करना चाहिए। इसको काम कैसा करना चाहिए? इसका सबसे पॉजिटिव बात है। 10वें घर का स्वामी दसवां है अपने से। ये बहुत बड़ा इंडस्ट्रियलिस्ट बन सकता है।
says: Look at Saturn now: the person should activate Saturn for work; the most positive point is that the 10th lord sits in the 10th from its own house, which can make him a big industrialist.
cells_derived_method: A lord placed 10th from its own sign (karma from itself) strengthens career. For lagna Libra the 10th lord is the Moon, 10th from Cancer is Aries, so the Moon in Aries qualifies; the house of that Aries changes with lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5->7); Moon is 10th lord in Aries, 10th from its own sign, career through business and partners.
Derived, not said: lagna Aries; Moon is 4th lord in the lagna, 10th from its own sign, work linked to property and public.
Derived, not said: Aries in the 4th means lagna 1-4+1=-2->10 Capricorn; Moon is 7th lord, work through partnership at home base.

ambiguity: 'दसवां है अपने से' read as 10th counted from the lord's own sign.
classical_check: Agrees in logic: a planet in the 10th from its own sign is a known strengthening idea, though not a named yoga.

hindi: अगर चंद्रमा को ठीक कर ले। सिर्फ चंद्रमा लेकिन चंद्रमा नीच का है। बहुत बड़ी इंडस्ट्री लगा के इंडस्ट्रिलिस्ट बना। लेकिन चंद्रमा इसका मालिक है नीच बंद हो गया काम और छठा बुध है बिज़नेस चल नहीं पाएगा इसका इस जन्म के अंदर
says: He can become a big industrialist only if he corrects the Moon, but the Moon (10th lord) is near-debilitated, so work stops, and the 6th-house Mercury means the business will not run in this life.
cells_derived_method: A weak 10th lord blocks career and a dusthana Mercury adds rivals; in a Libra lagna chart this appears as a stalled business.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Mercury in the 6th (debilitated sign), rivals and disputes cut the business.
Derived, not said: lagna Libra; the 10th sign Cancer is ruled by the debilitated-like Moon.

ambiguity: Moon is in Aries (not debilitated classically), the 'neech' is his term.
classical_check: Differs: the Moon is not debilitated in Aries; a dusthana Mercury harming business is a loose classical idea.

hindi: इसलिए इसको क्या करें शनि एक्टिवेट कर लो 10वें भाव में शनि एक्टिवेट कैसे होगा 10वें में सर चार नंबर राशि में शनि तो होता है पर दृष्टि उसकी खराब है दृष्टि भी नीच की खराब है शनि खराब है
says: So activate Saturn in the 10th; Saturn is there in sign 4 (Cancer), but its aspect is bad, called low quality, so Saturn is poor.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Cancer is in the Moon's sign, a hostile sign for it; the house changes the result: in the 10th work and authority, in the 4th home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Saturn in Cancer in the 10th, work through hardship, aspects the 7th, 12th and 4th.
Derived, not said: lagna Aries; Saturn in Cancer in the 4th, restless home and mother.
Derived, not said: Cancer in the 7th means lagna 4-7+1=-2->10 Capricorn; Saturn in Cancer in the 7th, strained marriage.

ambiguity: 'नीच की दृष्टि' is unclear; Saturn is debilitated in Aries and not in Cancer.
classical_check: Differs: Saturn in Cancer is in an enemy sign (not debilitated); his 'low aspect' wording is not classical.

hindi: तो क्या करें दो नंबर का काम अच्छा टैक्स चोरी कर ले सबसे आसान सारी दुनिया करती फिरती है तुम भी कर लो उसकी भी दृष्टि भी दृष्टि हां टैक्स की चोरी अब ये काम कर रहा है। ये क्या करेगा? ये पैसा खिलाएगा और काम करेगा।
says: Jokingly he says a Saturn-style way to work is number-two (black-money) business such as tax evasion, easy since everyone does it; the person will pay bribes and get work done. He is describing a pattern for a weak Saturn, and this is not endorsed.
ambiguity: Tone is half sarcastic; suggests an illegal path, recorded only.
classical_check: Silent: classically Saturn delivers through honest long labour, not evasion.

gist: The case chart belongs to a student: 'this matches me, 90 percent of it'; he replies it is his own chart, with banter.

hindi: नहीं ये तो तुम्हारा तो ये टैक्स चोरी का काम कर सकता है। दो नंबर का काम कर सकता है। ये पॉजिटिव सेंस में क्या कर सकता है? ये लोगों का धन लेके बांट सकता है।
says: This type of person can do tax-evasion or number-two work, but in a positive sense can take other people's money and distribute it (a fund-handling or charity role). He gives no investment advice, only the pattern.
ambiguity: 'लोगों का धन लेके बांट सकता है' could mean charity, trusts or distribution business.

hindi: सर लेकिन और उससे शादी भी गड़बड़ गड़बड़ होगी क्योंकि दसवीं दृष्टि शनि की फिर सेवंथ हाउस में पड़ जाएगी। हां शादी गड़बड़ होगी।
says: The marriage will also go wrong because Saturn's 10th aspect from the 10th house falls on the 7th house.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself; from the 10th its 10th aspect lands on the 7th (10th counted from 10 gives 7). The sign in the 7th colours the harm.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Saturn in Cancer in the 10th aspects Aries in the 7th, delaying or souring marriage.
Derived, not said: Capricorn in the 10th means lagna 10-10+1=1 Aries; Saturn in own sign aspects Libra in the 7th, a slow but lasting marriage.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn aspects 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself.

hindi: तो एक नंबर राशि नीचे तो शादी तो गड़बड़ होगी होगी। वैसे भी होगी इसकी समस्या तो इसकी रहेगी साथ शादी में वो तो ग्रह में ही है। तीसरा नेप्च्यून बैठ गया यही भतेरा है। एक रिश्ते से संतुष्टि देगा ही नहीं इसको।
says: Sign 1 (Aries) being low adds marital trouble; the problem is in the planets themselves, and Neptune in the 3rd is enough to deny contentment from a single relationship.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 3rd gives restlessness in bonds; with a troubled 7th the dissatisfaction multiplies. Sign of the 7th (Aries) adds impulsiveness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Neptune in the 3rd with Aries in the 7th, never settles with one partner.
Derived, not said: lagna Libra; troubled 7th in Aries adds impulsive relationships.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर राशि नीचे' garbled; likely the weak Moon in sign 1.

hindi: सेवंथ हाउस में इतने सारे ग्रह हो गए। हां जी। सेवंथ हाउस में बहुत सारे ग्रह हो गए ना इसमें। ये नेगेटिविटी है। हां। ये नेगेटिविटी है।
says: The 7th house has gathered many planets, and that crowding is itself a negativity for marriage.
cells_derived_method: A crowded 7th loads partner matters with many agents; the sign pair 12/1 sets the flavour, Aries impulsive, Pisces dreamy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; crowded Aries half of the 7th makes the partner quarrelsome.
Derived, not said: lagna Virgo; crowded Pisces half makes the bond confused and sacrificing.

classical_check: Agrees: a house with many planets is heavily loaded, and in the 7th it disturbs marriage.

hindi: अब इसमें मूर्ख एक्टिव कौन है? सूर्य और चंद्र जो अकेले हैं। क्योंकि ये घूम फिर के आए हैं दो लोग बाद में। आठवें घर से मंगल आ गया इसका और जो राहु था वो सातवें से खिसक के आठवें में गया। फिर दोबारा से आया आया तो मल्टीपल जगह काम कर रहे हैं।
says: Of the crowded planets the Sun and Moon are the active ones, alone in the 7th; Mars came in from the 8th and Rahu slid from the 7th to the 8th in chalit, so these planets work in several places at once.
cells_derived_method: In bhava-chalit a planet near a cusp shifts to the neighbouring house; one planet then acts in the sign-house and the chalit house, so Mars and Rahu act on both the 7th and 8th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Taurus in the 8th means lagna 2-8+1=-5->7 Libra; Mars here also acts on the 7th via its sign lordship.
Derived, not said: Aries in the 8th means lagna 1-8+1=-6->6 Virgo; Rahu slid here from the 7th (Pisces), stirring hidden matters.

ambiguity: 'मूर्ख' is a slip for an unclear word; the Sun and Moon reading is the likeliest.
classical_check: Agrees on chalit shifts; silent on the active-planet idea.

hindi: तो यह सातवें घर के अंदर जो इसका है अल्टीमेटली जो सारे ग्रहों का कचूमर निकाल के इसका तलाक नहीं होने देगा। घसीट लेगा रिश्ते को वो बैठता
says: Ultimately the 7th house, after crushing all those planets, will not let a divorce happen; the person will drag the relationship along.
cells_derived_method: A crowded 7th with an exalted Sun in Aries holds the marriage together by force; elsewhere debilitated planets would not.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; exalted Sun in the 7th keeps the marriage going though stressed.
Derived, not said: lagna Virgo; the Pisces half adds sacrifice, so the person stays on.

ambiguity: Sentence continues in the next chunk.

hindi: है केतु क्योंकि सातवें घर पे 12 / एक नंबर राशि एक्टिवेटेड है। तो 12 नंबर को केतु देख रहा है और एक नंबर का मंगल यही है। आ गया बाद में तो इसके दो रिलेशन करवा देगा। एक रिश्ता बाहर करा सकता है और अल्टीमेटली यहां पर जीवन चलाता रहेगा।
says: Ketu sits aspecting the 7th house (signs 12/1) and Mars of sign 1 is there too; together they create two relationships, one outside, while life ultimately continues in the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Ketu aspecting a 12/1 seventh house detaches from the first partner; Mars adds a second bond; the Pisces half is secret, the Aries half open.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Pisces in the 7th means lagna 12-7+1=6 Virgo; Ketu on Pisces 7th, a hidden or spiritual second bond.
Derived, not said: Aries in the 7th means lagna 1-7+1=-5->7 Libra; Mars with Ketu on Aries 7th, a hot-tempered second relationship.

ambiguity: Ketu's exact placement is not stated; 'देख रहा है' suggests an aspect.
classical_check: Differs: classically Ketu does not cast aspects, though some schools allow a 5th, 7th, 9th.

hindi: अगर यह पुरुष हो जाता है तो सूर्य पावर पकड़ लेगा। स्त्री हो जाती है तो चंद्रमा चंद्रमा डाउन होने से चरित्रहीनता नहीं होने देगा। क्योंकि चंद्रमा स्त्री ग्रह है तो पुरुष होने से चरित्रहीनता दे देता है।
says: If the native is male the Sun gains power; if female the Moon does, and a lowered Moon will not allow loose character in a woman, since the Moon is a female planet, but it gives loose character in a man; sex of the native changes the reading.
ambiguity: 'चरित्रहीनता' (loose character) is a value judgement; the native's sex is not stated for this chart.
classical_check: Differs: classics use Sun for men and Moon for women in spouse analysis, but the character claim is his.

gist: He opens the floor for questions and says male and female natives also change the reading; the first question follows.

hindi: पहला क्वेश्चन सर इष्ट को W5 में ही प्लेस करना होता है या W4 और W6 में भी कर सकते हैं? फाइव अगर किसी की कुंडली कुंडली फाइव नेगेटिव है वरुण देवता तो भी वह प्लेस करेगा कर सकता है ऐसा हां हां
says: Question: must the ishta be placed in W5 only, or in W4 and W6 too, and what if Varuna is negative in the chart? He answers it can be placed even when Varuna is negative.
ambiguity: The audience question is garbled between W4, W5 and W6.

hindi: तो इष्ट तो वहीं से देगा जो देगा अगर वरुण नेगेटिव है क्योंकि वो एरिया भी वरुण का ही है अब वरुण भी नेगेटिव कैसे देखना पड़ेगा वास्तु तो बहुत अजीब चीज है तो अलग चली गई
says: The ishta will give from the Varuna area whatever it gives, even if Varuna is negative, because that zone belongs to Varuna; how to judge Varuna as negative must be seen from the vastu plan, a separate matter.

hindi: चार्ट में एस्ट्रोलॉजी चार्ट में आपके घर के वास्तु के अंदर ये मोटे तौर पे जब तक नक्शा ना देख लें ये हवा में कहना बहुत ज्यादा कठिन है हवा में कहना बहुत कठिन है
says: Whether the astrology chart and the vastu of your home agree cannot be said without seeing the actual floor plan; speaking in the air is very hard.
classical_check: Agrees with sound practice: vastu needs the plan.

hindi: ये लोग कहते हैं हमारा दसवां चंद्रमा है कुछ बताइए। तो यह वो बात हुई हमारे घर में बिस्किट है। आइए खाइए। अबे कौन से बिस्किट है? कौन से डब्बे में कहां पड़े हैं? असल में हम तुम्हें खिलाना ही नहीं चाहते। हमने शेरो शायरी करके बात पूरी की है बस।
says: When people say 'my Moon is in the 10th, tell me something', it is like offering biscuits without saying which tin; a single placement is just poetry and not a reading.
classical_check: Agrees: a reading needs the full chart and sign, not one planet in one house.

hindi: अकेले चंद्रमा कहां बैठा है? इससे काम नहीं चलेगा। यहां देखो कितनी खिचड़ी है। आसान थोड़ी है। सैकड़ों चीजें बोली बताई जा सकती है। जटिल है। अभी तो गोचर की बात इसमें ऐड करें तो और चार चीजें निकल आएंगी।
says: Where the Moon alone sits is not enough; the chart is a stew of many factors and hundreds of things can be said; adding transits would bring out four more.
classical_check: Agrees: classical practice needs yoga, dasha and transit together.

hindi: नेप्च्यून की सर उच्च राशि कौन सी होती है? नेप्च्यून की सात ही नंबर बेस्ट है और दो नंबर बेस्ट है। दो नंबर बेस्ट है इसकी सर। 12 नंबर लाजवाब है नेच्यून की जो सर किसी भी प्लनेट का नीच भंग होता है।
says: Asked for Neptune's exaltation sign, he says sign 7 (Libra) is best and sign 2 (Taurus) is best; sign 12 (Pisces) is wonderful for Neptune, where any planet's debilitation is also cancelled.
cells_derived_method: A planet in a strong sign gives its best results; house shifts the area: Neptune in Libra in the 7th gives idealised partnership, in the 4th a dreamy home, in the 10th public image.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Libra in the 7th means lagna 7-7+1=1 Aries; Neptune in Libra, idealised and artistic partners.
Derived, not said: Taurus in the 4th means lagna 2-4+1=-1->11 Aquarius; Neptune in Taurus, comfortable, artistic home.
Derived, not said: Pisces in the 10th means lagna 12-10+1=3 Gemini; Neptune in Pisces, a public image of the visionary or healer.

ambiguity: Whether 'sign 12 cancels any planet's debilitation' is a separate Pisces claim or tied to Neptune is unclear.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune has no classical exaltation; Western tradition names Pisces as its home.

hindi: क्या उसका जेमस्टोन पहना जा सकता है? 100% उसकी अपनी राशि छ 8 12 में नहीं होनी चाहिए। और तीन में भी ना हो तो अवॉयड
says: Can the gemstone of a planet whose debilitation is cancelled be worn? Yes, with certainty, provided the planet's own sign does not fall in the 6th, 8th or 12th, nor the 3rd; otherwise avoid.
cells_derived_method: Gem rule by house of the planet's own sign: the sign's lord is allowed if its sign sits in a kendra, trikona or 2/11; avoid when the sign is in 3, 6, 8 or 12.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Jupiter's sign Pisces falls in the 6th, so avoid yellow sapphire.
Derived, not said: Gemini in the 9th means lagna 3-9+1=-5->7 Libra; Mercury's sign in the 9th, emerald allowed.
Derived, not said: Sagittarius in the 12th means lagna 9-12+1=-2->10 Capricorn; Jupiter's sign in the 12th, avoid.

ambiguity: 'अपनी राशि' read as the planet's own sign's house position.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical gem advice avoids gems of lords of the 6th, 8th, 12th, and adds the 3rd as his own caution.

hindi: नेप्च्यून के लिए ब्लू एक्वामरीन पहना पहनते हैं। इसके लिए ओपन भी कई बार पहना जाता है क्योंकि ये इंद्र के साथ कंजक्शन में घूमता है। तो इंद्र के करेक्शन से भी नेप्च्यून की करेक्शन होती है।
says: For Neptune a blue aquamarine is worn, and opal is also often worn because Neptune travels in conjunction with Indra (Uranus); correcting Uranus also corrects Neptune.
ambiguity: 'ओपन' read as opal.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune and Uranus gems are modern; Neptune and Uranus do travel closely in the sky in some years.

hindi: अगर केपी या चलित में तुला राशि है ही नहीं। हां तो कैसे इफेक्ट आएगा नेप? तो जिसके साथ वो बैठा है उसकी कंजक्शन के अनुसार काम देगा। फिर वो उसी के हिसाब से फल देगा।
says: If the sign Libra does not appear in the KP or chalit chart, Neptune's effect comes through the planet it sits with, in line with the conjunction, and gives results as that companion would.
cells_derived_method: Neptune takes the colour of its companion: with Mars it acts like Mars, with Venus like Venus, whatever the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: lagna Libra; Neptune with Jupiter in the 3rd gives expansive dreamy effort.
Derived, not said: lagna Aries; Neptune with Saturn in the 10th gives slow, hazy career.

ambiguity: The question is garbled; Libra is taken as Neptune's sign in his scheme.

hindi: किस ग्रह की दृष्टि किसके साथ बैठा है वह उस ग्रह के साथ बिहेव करेगा उसके अनुसार उसका चेला बन गया
says: Neptune behaves according to the aspect it gets and the planet it sits with, becoming that planet's disciple.
classical_check: Silent: outer planets as followers of their conjunct planet is his idea.

hindi: वो कोई जेम स्टोंस अगर अंदर से क्रैक हो जाए या ब्लैक स्पॉट्स हो तो क्या वो जेम स्टोन पॉजिटिव रिजल्ट्स की बजाय नेगेटिव रिजल्ट्स देना स्टार्ट कर 100% इसके अंदर एक काला निशान अगर आ गया
says: Question: if a gemstone has an internal crack or black spots, does it give negative instead of positive results? He answers yes, 100 percent, when a black mark has appeared inside the stone.
classical_check: Agrees: classical gem texts list flaws (crack, black spot) that cause harm.

hindi: तो आंखें देखती रहेंगी उस काले एरिया को छोड़ के आइज ब्रेन एडजस्ट कर लेगा देखेगा लेकिन वो एरिया में ग्लूकोमा हो जाएगा आपको खराब चश्मों की वजह से ग्लूकोमा हो
says: His analogy: the eyes keep looking past a black spot and the brain adjusts, but glaucoma develops in that area from bad spectacles; likewise a flawed gem silently harms. A medical analogy of his, recorded only, and cut off.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk end; the glaucoma statement is his claim, not medical fact.

hindi: इसीलिए आपके के जेम स्टोन में क्रैक या निशान आ गया तो फिल्ट्रेशन बंद हो जाएगी।
says: A gemstone works as a filter for cosmic rays; if the stone you wear has a crack or a mark, the filtering stops, so a flawed stone gives no benefit.
ambiguity: 'filtration' of cosmic rays is his physical model; it is not a classical Jyotish claim.
classical_check: Classical gem texts (Ratna Pariksha, Brihat Samhita) do list cracks and flaws as defects that give bad results; the ray-filter wording is his own.

hindi: टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी फिल्ट्रेशन करेगा और कॉस्मिक रेज़ की और अल्टीमेटली आपको साइड इफेक्ट मारेगा।
says: A flawed stone filters the planet's rays in a distorted way, and in the end the wearer gets side effects instead of help.
ambiguity: Which kinds of side effects are not named.
classical_check: Agrees in direction with classical warnings that defective gems cause harm; no classical text uses the cosmic-ray model.

hindi: अच्छा स्टोन पहनो।
says: Instruction: if you wear a gemstone, wear a good-quality, flawless one, not a cheap one.
ambiguity: No grading standard (clarity, weight, origin) is given here.
classical_check: Agrees with classical gem texts that insist on flawless stones.

gist: Rhetorical: how do people choose a wife? (leading into a joke that people want the best in everything)
Garbled caption 'best pati ka sar chahiye', probably 'they want the best husband'; cannot be sure.
Rhetorical: what kind of house do people buy, the best one.
Rhetorical: which gemstone to buy?
Mimics the customer: 'give me a cheap one' for the gemstone.
Rhetorical: which doctor do you want?
Joke answer: 'bring a grass-cutter' (an unqualified doctor), mocking cheap choices.
Switches voice: no brother, people ask for the best in everything else.
Rhetorical: why don't they get treatment?
Answer fragment: they want a decent, good one.

hindi: असल में जो प्रॉब्लम आती है ना उस टाइम तो वो बेस्ट बेस्ट उपाय कर लेते हैं।
says: People only go for the best remedy at the moment a problem actually arrives; he is describing the habit of doing remedies reactively.
ambiguity: A behavioural remark more than a rule.

hindi: प्रॉब्लम आए बिना बेस्ट नहीं कर सकते।
says: Without a problem showing up, people will not make the best effort, so remedies done in advance are rare.

gist: Begins quoting a proverb: 'in sorrow everyone remembers God'.
Second half of the proverb: 'in happiness no one does'.

hindi: जो सुख में सुमिरन करे दुख काहे को होए।
says: Quoting Kabir: one who prays and keeps remedies up in good times will not meet sorrow; used to argue for doing remedies preventively.
ambiguity: Devotional proverb, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; it is a devotional saying.

gist: Parody: people eat almonds only when they are crying.
Parody continued: nobody eats almonds while laughing and playing.
Parody ending: whoever eats almonds while happy never says 'oh no'.

hindi: तो पहले क्यों नहीं उपाय कर रहे थे अच्छे टाइम में?
says: Remedies should be done during good periods, before trouble, not only when a bad period has already started.
ambiguity: Asked as a rhetorical question.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical idea of shanti done before a bad dasha begins.

gist: People simply do not do remedies in good times.
Reading a student's question: he did not follow the next question.
He says he will explain the question himself.
Filler 'yes'.
Restates the student's question: thread worn on the left hand is said to place a planet in the 4th house, then repeats the premise.

hindi: फोर्थ नहीं 10थ।
says: Correction: the left hand corresponds to the 10th house, not the 4th, when a thread is tied on it.
cells_derived_method: The 10th house sign changes with the lagna (lagna sign + 9). So the same left-hand thread touches Capricorn for Aries lagna, Aries for Cancer lagna, Libra for Capricorn lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, left-hand thread falls on the Saturn-ruled 10th sign, so career and public standing themes.
Derived: Libra lagna (7+9=16, so 4) has Cancer 10th, the left-hand thread then touches a Moon sign.
Derived: Cancer lagna (4+9=13, so 1) has Aries 10th, a Mars sign for career.

ambiguity: In the following sentence he gives right hand as 4th; the body-vastu mapping is his own.
classical_check: Differs: Kala Purusha puts arms and hands in the 3rd house; hand-to-house 4/10 is his body-vastu scheme.

hindi: अच्छा तो राइट हैंड फोर्थ हाउस है।
says: By his body map the right hand is the 4th house (as the pair to the left hand being the 10th).
cells_derived_method: 4th house sign = lagna sign + 3. A thread on the right hand then touches Cancer for Aries lagna, Capricorn for Libra lagna, Aries for Capricorn lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, right hand thread acts on the Moon sign 4th: home, mother, peace of mind.
Derived: Libra lagna has Capricorn 4th, so the right hand is the Saturn-sign home area.
Derived: Capricorn lagna has Aries 4th, Mars-sign home area, heated domestic matters.

ambiguity: It reads like the student agreeing ('achha to') as he repeats his understanding; he confirms in the next sentence.
classical_check: Differs from Kala Purusha (4th = chest/heart); it is a left-right axis scheme.

hindi: लेफ्ट हैंड 10थ हाउस है।
says: Confirms again that the left hand is the 10th house in his scheme, the other pole of the 4th-10th axis.
cells_derived_method: Same as the earlier correction: 10th sign = lagna + 9, so the left hand has different sign flavour for each lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius lagna (9+9=18, so 6) has Virgo 10th, a Mercury sign, so left side is about work and trade.
Derived: Libra lagna has Cancer 10th, the left hand then falls on a Moon sign: public image, dealings with people.
Derived: Leo lagna has Taurus 10th; Aquarius lagna (11+9=20 gives 8) has Scorpio 10th, a fixed Mars sign for career.

ambiguity: Repeats his own correction.

gist: Filler 'okay'.
Re-reads the question: would a gemstone of a combust planet, worn on the left hand, give power to that house?

hindi: जेमस्टोन पहन लो।
says: Answer: simply wear the gemstone; which hand it goes on is not a house-power question.
classical_check: Classical texts do specify fingers and hands for each gem; he is setting that aside here.

hindi: अगर सूट करता है तो कोई लेना देना ही नहीं है।
says: If the stone suits you, hand or house placement does not matter at all; suitability of the stone is the only test.
ambiguity: 'Suit' means the stone is judged right for the chart; the method for that is not given here.
classical_check: Differs from texts that fix the finger and hand per gem.

hindi: पावर देने का लिंक ही नहीं है।
says: There is no link between the hand a gemstone is worn on and giving power to the house that hand stands for.

hindi: हम तो उसकी प्लेसमेंट कर रहे हैं।
says: The body-part mapping applies to placement: the thread's location is what is being set, not the gem's.
ambiguity: 'Usकी' (its) is unclear: the thread or the planet.

hindi: हमने एक ग्रह को छोटे से तौर पे प्लेस किया है थोड़े टाइम के लिए।
says: A thread places a planet's energy in a small, short-duration way at a chosen body spot.
classical_check: Silent; this is his thread model.

hindi: बस टेंपरेरीली जेम स्टोन कहीं भी किसी ग्रह को प्लेस नहीं करता।
says: A gemstone does not place a planet in any location; thread is temporary placement, gem is not a placement tool.
ambiguity: Caption mixes 'temporarily' with the gem statement; sense is that only the thread places a planet.

hindi: यह धागा वहां प्लेस हो रहा है।
says: The thread is the item that actually gets placed at that body spot, so its position on the body is meaningful.

hindi: घर के अनुसार जैसे शरीर का वास्तु है।
says: The body has its own vastu, with body parts mapped to the houses of the chart.
cells_derived_method: Each body part belongs to a house, and the sign on that house comes from the lagna, so the same body spot carries a different sign flavour per person (e.g. 10th spot is Capricorn for Aries lagna, Cancer for Libra lagna).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, the 10th-house body spot sits under a Saturn sign.
Derived: Libra lagna, the same spot sits under a Moon sign.

ambiguity: Which parts map to which houses beyond hands is not given here.
classical_check: Partly overlaps Kala Purusha body mapping but differs on details.

hindi: ऐसे घर के अंदर भी होता है।
says: The same house-wise mapping also applies to the rooms and spots inside a dwelling (house vastu).
cells_derived_method: Each chart house maps to an area of the home, so a planet in a house marks that area of the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna with a planet in 4th, the 4th-house area of the home gets that planet's stuff.
Derived: Capricorn lagna, the 10th-house area of the home carries a Venus-sign flavour.

ambiguity: Which direction of the home each house stands for is not stated in this sentence.
classical_check: Not in classical Parashari texts; comes from the vastu-link school.

hindi: आपका बुध जहां होगा वहां रेजगारी पड़ी होगी।
says: Wherever Mercury sits in your chart, the matching area of your home will have loose coins lying about.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in house H points to the home area for house H. Which area depends on the house, so Mercury in 4th gives coins in the 4th-house area, Mercury in 10th in the 10th-house area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Gemini in 4th (lagna 3-4+1=0, so 12 Pisces): coins lie in the 4th-house part of the home.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo in 10th (lagna 6-10+1=-3, so 9 Sagittarius): coins in the 10th-house part of the home.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in 7th (lagna 3-7+1=-3, so 9 Sagittarius): coins in the 7th-house part.

ambiguity: Which part of the home each house maps to is not stated here.
classical_check: Mercury as the planet of coins and trade is classical; the house-wise location in the home is his vastu link.

gist: Closing remark of the vastu example: 'it happens this way'.
Remark that these are tricky, complicated matters.
'Yeh hum woh karte hain' - unclear referent.

hindi: यह इफेक्ट करता है।
says: The thread placement does have an effect on the person.
ambiguity: Subject of 'this' is the thread placement, inferred.

hindi: काम करता है।
says: He asserts that it works in practice.
ambiguity: Referent inferred from the previous sentence.

hindi: यह हमारा चौथा ही एरिया रहेगा हमेशा।
says: The right-hand area stays the 4th-house area for the person always, regardless of which hand he writes with.
cells_derived_method: 4th sign = lagna + 3; the hand stays 4th for everyone, only the sign on it changes by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, right hand = Moon-sign 4th.
Derived: Taurus lagna has Leo 4th, right hand = Sun-sign area.

ambiguity: 'Hamara' could mean 'this area (right side)'; the next chunk adds that it holds even for upside-down born child.

gist: 'Unless such a born child' - sentence is cut off, it continues in the next chunk.

hindi: हां डाउन यह फिर भी चौथा ही रहेगा।
says: Even in an unusual case (a person born reversed or left-handed, caption garbled) the right side stays 4th.
ambiguity: 'Down' is garbled; probably left-handed or reversed born; continuation of the previous unfinished sentence.

gist: Advises to try it and learn from experience.

hindi: और जो आपकी कुंडली में मूंगा पहन लिया वो मंगल के लिए
says: Coral worn according to the chart is the stone for Mars.
ambiguity: Sentence breaks off and goes on with a question.
classical_check: Agrees: red coral (moonga) is the classical gem of Mars.

hindi: मंगल का घर एक नंबर कहां है?
says: Asks where Mars is: its house or sign number, which may be anywhere in the chart.
ambiguity: 'Ek number' may be house or sign number; the answer in the next sentence says he does not care.

hindi: राशि वो वहां के लिए पता नहीं कहां है।
says: Mars's sign and house are somewhere unknown and irrelevant to the gem; coral does not depend on where Mars sits.
ambiguity: Rhetorical; the point is the gem works on the planet, not on the house where Mars sits.
classical_check: Differs from texts that choose a gem partly by the planet's house lordship and placement.

hindi: उसका इस धागे से कोई लेनदेन नहीं है।
says: The Mars coral has no connection with the thread's body-part placement.

gist: Asks the audience 'right?'.

hindi: ये टोटली डिफरेंट है।
says: Gemstone remedy and thread remedy are two totally different systems, not variants of each other.

hindi: ये एडवांस्ड है।
says: The gemstone route is the advanced remedy compared to a simple thread.
ambiguity: 'This' could be gems or the whole gem-versus-thread distinction.

hindi: या ₹2 का उपाय होगा धागे का या 2 लाख का पत्थर आएगा सीधा।
says: Remedies span from a 2-rupee thread to a 2-lakh stone, with the two ends being thread or a costly gem.
ambiguity: The prices are illustrative.

hindi: बीच के उपाय होंगे छोटे-मोटे।
says: Everything between the thread and the gem is a minor remedy.

hindi: वो टेंपरेरी है।
says: The in-between minor remedies are temporary in effect.
ambiguity: 'That' probably refers to the minor remedies.

hindi: काम करेंगे सारे।
says: All of these remedies will work.
classical_check: Silent; it is an efficacy claim with no measurement given.

gist: Student asks for the next class on threads: Rahu and Ketu are left, Jupiter was added by Nikhil.
Mock poem: 'what do I do, I am helpless, maybe a labourer, a master of poems'.
Student question: a housewife needs her husband's money for remedies; will the charity effect go to husband or wife since he earns?
Jokes that she should steal a little money from the husband's pocket.
Student repeats: whose will the charity effect be, husband's or hers?

hindi: किसी से भी ले हस्बैंड के पैसे हो भी उसके हाथों
says: Whatever the source of the money, even the husband's, charity effect goes to the person whose hands give it (sentence trails off).
ambiguity: Cut off at chunk end, meaning inferred; it may instead continue 'in her hands', not stated.
classical_check: Silent; charity classically credits the giver.

hindi: सातवां घर सेट करो पति को जेब में डालो
says: Fix the 7th house (the husband's house) as the remedy for marital friction; the 'husband in pocket' phrase is a joke on keeping him under control.
cells_derived_method: 7th sign = lagna + 6: Libra for Aries lagna, Aries for Libra lagna, Capricorn for Cancer lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, the spouse house is a Venus sign; remedy aims at Venus themes.
Derived: Cancer lagna, spouse house is Saturn's sign, steadier and more austere.
Derived: Capricorn lagna, 7th is the Moon's sign, an emotional spouse area.

ambiguity: 'Set' is loose; the actual remedy follows in the next sentences.
classical_check: 7th house as spouse is classical; the pocket line is humour.

hindi: कौन सा ग्रह कौन सा वो पड़ा हुआ है देखो उस हिसाब से ग्रह के हिसाब से करो उपाय
says: For a marriage problem, look at which planet sits in the 7th house and do the remedy of that planet.
cells_derived_method: The remedy is picked by the occupying planet and the sign it is in (which depends on the lagna), so Saturn in Libra 7th (Aries lagna) differs from Saturn in Aries 7th (Libra lagna).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra 7th (exalted, Aries lagna): Saturn remedy, with a strong planet.
Derived: Saturn in Aries 7th (debilitated, Libra lagna): Saturn remedy, with a weak planet.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini 7th (Sagittarius lagna): Mercury remedies, e.g. green items.

ambiguity: Whether this is for any 7th-house problem or only the wife's complaint here.
classical_check: Using the occupant for remedy is common practice; lordship of the 7th is usually also checked classically.

hindi: सातवें घर खुले स्थान में कुछ दबाओ
says: Bury something in an open place in the 7th-house area (the matching part of the house or plot).
cells_derived_method: What is buried would follow the planet in the 7th (not specified); the sign on the 7th changes with lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, bury a Venus-type item in the 7th-house open space.
Derived: Taurus lagna, 7th is Scorpio (Mars-type item).

ambiguity: What to bury and which direction is the 7th is not specified in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; belongs to Lal Kitab style remedy.

hindi: कमर पे धागा इफ अलाउड
says: A thread on the waist, if permitted, is the body-part remedy for the 7th house.
ambiguity: 'If allowed' means if her husband or family allows it; waist as 7th house follows from the Kala Purusha waist-pelvis link.
classical_check: Agrees with Kala Purusha placing the 7th house in the lower abdomen and waist region.

gist: Aside to the questioner: 'Guruji, you said so' used as a lead-in to the following joke.

hindi: अपनी जुबान बंद करो
says: Advice to the wife: keep your mouth shut, stop talking back, as the remedy for home friction.
ambiguity: A behavioural advice.

hindi: अगर इन्हें बोले बिना चैन नहीं पड़ता तो 100% बुध का दोष है
says: If a person cannot rest without speaking out, that is certainly a Mercury affliction.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's affliction would be strongest in houses of speech and fighting; e.g. in 2nd, 3rd or 7th and in a hostile sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in own sign Gemini in 2nd (Taurus lagna): sharp, constant speech.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in 7th (Virgo lagna): talk causes quarrels with spouse.

ambiguity: '100%' is rhetorical; no chart check is given.
classical_check: Mercury is the karaka of speech classically, but 100% is stronger than the texts claim.

hindi: पति से घर झगड़ा ही रहेगा
says: With that Mercury fault, there will be continuing quarrels with the husband at home.
cells_derived_method: 7th house matters with Mercury; sign of the 7th changes the nature of the conflict.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini lagna, 7th is Sagittarius; Mercury there gets neutral-to-weak, spouse debates philosophy.
Derived: Virgo lagna, 7th is Pisces, Mercury debilitated: bickering is worst.

ambiguity: No 'in which house' stated, so the 7th is inferred from 'husband'.

hindi: वो कैश रुपया कागज बुध है
says: Cash, rupee notes and paper in general are Mercury's things.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury governs trade, accounts and written records; paper notes as Mercury is a modern extension.

hindi: हरा नोट उसके लिए तंग करेगा
says: The green banknote (Mercury's colour) will keep troubling her; the money issue itself is the Mercury affliction.
ambiguity: Garbled: could also be 'the green note itself will tempt her' or 'will harass for her'.
classical_check: Green is classical Mercury colour; the note-harassment reading is his own.

hindi: वैसे तो इनको करना ही चाहिए ये ब्लू फ्रेम में घर के आई एन डब्ल्यू में अपनी और हस्बैंड की फोटो लगा दे।
says: Remedy: put a photo of herself with her husband in a blue frame in the north-west part of the home.
ambiguity: 'IN W' is read as North-West; blue frame colour reasoning is not given. NW is the Vayavya (Moon) direction in vastu.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; vastu convention gives NW to Vayu and Moon.

gist: Urges to at least buy this much (the frame).
Student recalls Guruji said a favourable-colour mauli on the hand gives positive or negative effect.
Student asks whether the same principle applies to watches.

hindi: कलर्स पे भी अप्लाई वॉचेस के कलर पे सेम जाएगा।
says: Yes: the colour principle applies to watches as well, the same way as for the mauli thread.
ambiguity: Which colour is favourable depends on the person's chart; not stated here.
classical_check: Silent; colour-planet association is classical but wearing watch colours is a modern extension.

hindi: वो डायल का कलर स्टैप ओ यस यस सब काम करेगा।
says: A watch's dial colour and strap colour both count and both act.
ambiguity: Caption 'o yes yes' is filler.

gist: Repeats that all of it works.

hindi: और मौली परमानेंटली बनी बंधी रहती है।
says: A mauli thread is meant to stay tied on permanently.
ambiguity: Next sentence says it wears out, so this is the intended state.

hindi: लेकिन बनी रहती है घिस जाती है।
says: The thread stays on but wears out with use.

hindi: कलर हल्का हो जाता है।
says: The thread's colour fades, which changes the colour effect you intended.

hindi: पीला रंग ऐड हो जाता है।
says: As a red thread fades or dirties, a yellow tint is added, so another colour (Jupiter's) creeps in.
ambiguity: Yellow as Jupiter's colour is inferred; he does not name the planet here.
classical_check: Yellow is a classical Jupiter colour.

gist: Comment that this is a big hassle.
Repeats that it is a big hassle.
Rhetorical question: why is red mauli tied? (answered in next chunk)

hindi: हार्ट के कनेक्शन के साथ शुक्र और नेप्च्यून दोनों को पावर देती है।
says: Red mauli, through its link with the heart, strengthens both Venus and Neptune.
ambiguity: The subject 'it' is the red mauli, carried over from the question.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts tie red mauli to Mars, not Venus and Neptune; Neptune is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: मंगल हमेशा आग की तरह उठा देता है इन दोनों को।
says: Mars acts like fire and raises (activates) both Venus and Neptune.
ambiguity: This is the planet-link reason for red being used.
classical_check: Mars as fire is classical; its link to Neptune is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: दोनों को उठाया जाता है।
says: Both Venus and Neptune are lifted (energised) by the red thread.
ambiguity: Repetition of the previous point.

hindi: नेपच्यून का बहुत बड़ा गुण होता है।
says: Neptune has a very big quality, which he illustrates next with restless movement.
ambiguity: The quality is only named after the illustration.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not in classical texts.

gist: Says he just remembered something.
Points that his own leg is shaking.
Children shake their legs like this.
What do mothers say?
Mothers say 'don't shake your leg'.
Mothers add: 'bad habit'.

hindi: पैर बच्चे का हिलने दो जब तक हिल रहा है।
says: Let a child's leg keep shaking; it is a natural outlet of energy and should not be stopped.
ambiguity: A parenting advice that is tied to Neptune in the next sentence.

hindi: यह नेप्च्यून है।
says: The shaking leg is Neptune: restless bodily energy is a Neptune sign.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give leg movement to Rahu or Mercury, not to Neptune.

gist: Student reads next question: 'legs shake by themselves'.

hindi: मींस ऊर्जा है।
says: A leg that shakes on its own means surplus energy, again assigned to Neptune.
ambiguity: Whether 'energy' means Neptune or just vitality is not explicit.

gist: 'Yeh dada kar rahi hai' - garbled, meaning unclear.
Says 'stop' to the audience.
Student: there is a world-war-like situation today.

hindi: 100% ग्रहों की वजह से।
says: He holds that the present world-war situation is entirely caused by planets.
ambiguity: No planet or transit is named; it is a sweeping claim.
classical_check: Mundane astrology classically links wars to planets (Mars, Saturn), but a flat '100%' is not in the texts.

hindi: जैसे प्लेन क्रश के बारे में हम हां ये ग्रह ग्रह की वजह से 101% ग्रहों का खेल है।
says: Same for a plane crash: it is 101% the game of the planets, nothing happens without a planetary cause.
ambiguity: No specific combination is named for crashes.
classical_check: Silent; it is an absolute determinism claim, not testable as stated.

hindi: सारा का सारा कोई चीज ऐसी नहीं है जो ग्रहों के कारण ना घटित हो रही हो।
says: Every event without exception happens because of planets; there is nothing that is not planetary.
classical_check: Karma-doctrine texts say the planets indicate, not cause; he claims cause.

hindi: मनुष्य पढ़ नहीं पा रहा।
says: Humans are not yet able to read these planetary causes correctly.

hindi: कहीं सही मायने में इसमें बहुत अनुसंधान की जरूरत है।
says: This area really needs much more research before it can be read properly.

gist: Research will happen when many good astrologers work together on one platform.
Biggest problem: astrologers do not work together.
Saying: Brahmins and elephants are nobody's companions.

Knowledge gives ego.
Ego stops people from learning.
He says he always asks others to teach.
He will tell them more than they know.
Asks them to teach him first.
Remark that others sell stolen goods, intention is different.
Says the next two questions are a bit out of context.
Student question: do mobile wallpapers affect the subconscious?

hindi: 100% तो जो हमारे कॉम्पिटिटिव एग्जाम्स के प्रिपरेशन है
says: Mobile wallpapers affect the subconscious 100%, and he starts to apply this to students preparing for competitive exams.
ambiguity: The sentence merges his answer ('100%') with the student's next question start.
classical_check: Silent; a psychology claim and not astrology.

gist: Student: should they set a photo of the desired college as wallpaper.

hindi: तो डिजायर्ड कॉलेज की फोटो क्यों लगा रहे हो किस लिए लगा रहे हो इसलिए लगा रहे हो
says: Asks the student why they put the desired college's photo; the answer is that it is to make it happen, which he is about to criticise.
ambiguity: Rhetorical; the chunk stutters over 'because'.

hindi: मैनिफेस्टेशन नहीं कर रहे हो प्रीलिव कर रहे हो
says: Putting the dream college on the wallpaper is not manifestation but pre-living (living the result in advance), which he treats as the wrong mindset.
ambiguity: 'Prelive' is read from a garbled caption; it may be 'prove' or 'prelive'.
classical_check: Silent; a mindset claim, not Jyotish.

gist: People do not understand the difference.
They say they did not understand; it is not easy, it needs great penance.
Student question: why should a family member want the desired college.
They want it because good marks will come from there.
They think good marks come only where good results are made.
They want to pass on the strength of the college.
If they can do it on their own they could do it on their own skill.
It shows lack of self-belief.
This is the shortcoming.
'One who cannot respect himself, what on earth...' - sentence cut off at batch end.
Fragment 'will it rise?' left over from the previous question.
Student asks whether the vision board discussed earlier also works on these same lines.

hindi: तो बिल्कुल इनहीं लाइंस पे जिसने प्रीलिम कर लिया उसका कुछ ना होएगा।
says: Vision boards work on the same lines as the wallpaper idea: someone who has already 'pre-lived' the result in the mind will get nothing from it.
ambiguity: 'Prelim' is a garbled 'pre-live' from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent; a manifestation-psychology claim, not Jyotish.

hindi: तो वो तो सुन ही रहा है।
says: The subconscious is listening all the time to whatever image or word is placed before it.
ambiguity: 'He' is the subconscious, inferred from the wallpaper question.

hindi: कॉन्शियसनेस सुपरइंपोज कर लेगी उसको।
says: Conscious thought will superimpose itself on the subconscious and overwrite what it picked up.
ambiguity: 'Usko' (it) could be the subconscious input or the vision itself.

hindi: हां तभी तो कहा कि वहां जाकर के सोच लिया कार्ड ले जा के कि ये तो न्यूरोसर्जन का कार्ड है काम आएगा।
says: Example: a person who carries a neurosurgeon's visiting card and thinks 'this will be useful' has planted that thought, and it later draws the event into his life.
ambiguity: The story is told in one run; the person and context are not clear.

hindi: और वहां पर वेस्ट के एरिया में आप उस इलाके में बैठे हैं।
says: In that example you are sitting in the west part of the place, so the west zone is what carries the effect.
cells_derived_method: If the west zone maps to a chart house (not stated here), the sign on that house would vary by lagna.
ambiguity: Which house west corresponds to is not said; in the common vastu-chart scheme west is the 7th, but he does not state that.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; west as Saturn's direction is classical.

hindi: W2 WW3 में ये थोड़ा सा फर्क है।
says: There is a small difference between the W2 and W3 sub-zones of the west direction; the effect shifts between them.
ambiguity: W2 and W3 refer to a 16-zone vastu grid; the exact difference is not explained, so the caption is only partly clear.
classical_check: Silent; vastu 16-zone grid, outside Jyotish texts.

hindi: तो न्यूरोसर्जन से आपका सामना हो ही जाएगा।
says: Because of the thought planted in that zone, you will end up meeting a neurosurgeon.
ambiguity: Implies a medical event for the person; recorded as his example only, no health prediction is endorsed.

hindi: वो अपने आप लेके चला जाएगा।
says: The planted thought will carry you towards that outcome by itself, with no effort of yours.

hindi: पता भी नहीं चलेगा आपको।
says: You will not even be aware that the subconscious thought is steering you.

hindi: लेटेेटे मैनिफेस्टेशन के कई टेक्निक्स देखी हमने पूरी होती है वह और बड़ी डेंजरस है।
says: He has seen many latent-manifestation techniques; they do come true, and that makes them dangerous because unnoticed wishes also get fulfilled.
ambiguity: 'Letete' is a garbled 'latent'.

hindi: तभी तो मुद्दा है कि जब आप इस लायक हो जाते हैं तो आपका मन ही नहीं करता करें।
says: When you become capable of such techniques you no longer feel like using them, because the desire to push things fades.

gist: Once capable, it looks like a toy and becomes very easy.

Question: some family members steal from their own home.
Exclamation 'oh-ho'.
Student asks how to look at this, and how not to.

hindi: घर के मेंबर घर में ही चोरी कर देखना ही नहीं चाहिए इसको तो घर का माल घर पे ही है।
says: Do not treat a family member taking things from their own home as theft; the household's goods are still inside the household.
ambiguity: No chart factor is given for why a family member steals; this is a social view.
classical_check: Silent; theft by kin is usually read from 2nd/4th and Mercury/Rahu afflictions, not stated here.

hindi: घर का माल घर में दे ही नहीं रहा कोई उनको।
says: Such a member steals because nobody in the family is giving him his share of what the household has.

hindi: उनको देता क्यों नहीं कोई वो बेचारा क्या करे चोरी करेगा
says: If the family does not give him anything, he has nothing else to do but steal.

gist: Rhyme: stealing is no sin, there is no snake under the house; this much theft is allowed.

hindi: घर के अंदर चोरी कोई नहीं करता जब तक कि वो मजबूर ना हो
says: Nobody steals within his own home unless compelled by need.

gist: Rhetorical: who wants to steal?

hindi: आप पहले किसी को सुख दे बैठे आदत डाल दें फिर ना दें तो वो चोरी तो करेगा ही
says: If you first give someone comforts and build the habit and then stop, he will certainly steal.
ambiguity: A behaviour remark; he does not justify theft as lawful.

hindi: चोरी करने में कोई नुकसान नहीं है कोई बुराई नहीं है
says: He says stealing inside the family is no real harm and no evil; recorded as his view, not endorsed as advice.
ambiguity: Likely a half-joking remark limited to household money.
classical_check: Differs from classical dharma texts, which treat theft as a sin.

hindi: देख के चलो कि राइट पैर के अंगूठे में राइट सही धागा पक पना हुआ है कि नहीं
says: Check that the right-foot big toe has the correct thread tied firmly; this is the remedy against legal trouble.
ambiguity: 'Right thread' means a thread suited to the person; colour or planet is not given. The 'toe' wording is partly garbled.
classical_check: Silent; toe-thread is not a classical remedy.

hindi: क्योंकि फिर ना आपके ऊपर कोर्ट केस होगा ना जेल जाओगे और हो भी गया तो भी बचोगे।
says: With the right-toe thread in place, you will face no court case or jail, and even if one starts you will escape its consequences.
cells_derived_method: Court case relates to the 6th house and jail to the 12th; 6th sign = lagna + 5, 12th = lagna + 11. The same remedy covers different signs per lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, 6th is Virgo, litigation themes are Mercury-like (documents, argument).
Derived: Cancer lagna, 6th is Sagittarius, litigation themes are Jupiter-like (law, judges).
Derived: Aries lagna, 12th is Pisces, confinement themes sit in Jupiter's sign.

ambiguity: He does not name the 6th or 12th here; mapping is derived from classical meanings. A guarantee of escape from jail is a strong claim.
classical_check: 6th house for litigation is classical; the toe-thread cure is not.

hindi: सबसे सबसे महत्वपूर्ण अपने जीवन के एक्सपीरियंस में मैंने पाया है कि भैया पांचवें और नौवें घर की कृपा ले लो और छठा घर मजबूत कर लो।
says: From his own experience the most important thing against enemies is to win the grace of the 5th and 9th houses and to strengthen the 6th house.
cells_derived_method: 5th sign = lagna + 4, 9th = lagna + 8, 6th = lagna + 5. So the signs doing the work differ by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna: 5th Leo, 9th Sagittarius, 6th Virgo; Sun, Jupiter and Mercury become the helpers.
Derived: Scorpio lagna (8): 5th Pisces, 9th Cancer, 6th Aries; Jupiter, Moon and Mars carry the protection.
Derived: Cancer lagna: 5th Scorpio, 9th Pisces, 6th Sagittarius; Mars rules the 5th, Jupiter the 9th and 6th.

ambiguity: 'Kripa lena' (take grace) is not defined as a specific act; likely worship or strengthening of lords.
classical_check: 5th and 9th as trines of grace and 6th as the enemy house are classical; the combined advice is his own.

hindi: उसके बाद आपका शत्रु आपके ऊपर हावी नहीं हो पाएगा।
says: After that, your enemy will not be able to dominate you.
cells_derived_method: 6th house sign = lagna + 5, so who the enemy is shaped by differs per lagna (Aries lagna: Virgo-type, Libra lagna: Pisces-type).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, enemies are the critical, detail-seeking Virgo kind.
Derived: Libra lagna, enemies are hidden, Pisces kind.

classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that a strong 6th house defeats enemies.

hindi: जीत भले ही ना पाए।
says: The enemy may not be beaten outright by this approach.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts promise victory from a strong 6th.

hindi: आप उससे जीत भले ही ना पाए लेकिन आप उससे हारोगे नहीं।
says: You may not win against the enemy, but you will not lose; it is protection, not victory.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts that promise victory over enemies from strong 6th.

hindi: तो राइट पैर का धागा तो बहुत ही इंपॉर्टेंट है।
says: So the right-foot thread is very important for protection from enemies and legal trouble.
ambiguity: Which house the right foot belongs to is not stated here; the link to the 6th house is inferred from context.
classical_check: Silent; Kala Purusha gives feet to the 12th house.

hindi: और अष्टम भाव अगर स्ट्रांग करना आपको आ गया तो ये शब्द है।
says: If you learn to strengthen the 8th house, you gain a special power, which he names with the next word (stambhan).
cells_derived_method: 8th sign = lagna + 7: Scorpio for Aries lagna, Pisces for Leo lagna, Taurus for Libra lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, strengthening the 8th means working on the Mars-ruled hidden house.
Derived: Leo lagna, the 8th is Pisces, a watery, Jupiter-ruled house of mystery.
Derived: Libra lagna, the 8th is Taurus, a fixed Venus-ruled earth sign.

ambiguity: 'Ye shabd hai' points to 'stambhan' in the next sentence.
classical_check: 8th as hidden power is classical; stambhan is a tantric use, not a house rule in Parashari texts.

hindi: आप स्तंभन कर सकते हो दूसरे का।
says: With a strong 8th house you can perform stambhan, a freezing or stopping of another person.
cells_derived_method: Same 8th-house sign mapping as the previous sentence.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna; Mars's own sign in the 8th gives a forceful stambhan.
Derived: Scorpio lagna (8+7=15, so 3) has Gemini 8th, a Mercury sign, so stambhan works through speech and wit.

ambiguity: Stambhan is a power claim, not a prediction; no measurement is given.
classical_check: Stambhan is one of the six abhichara karmas in tantra; classical Jyotish texts do not tie it to the 8th house.

hindi: स्तंभन मींस आपके सामने आके वो सारे क्वेश्चन भूल जाएगा।
says: He defines stambhan as the other person forgetting all his questions or complaints when he comes in front of you.
ambiguity: He uses the non-hostile sense (forgetting a quarrel), not paralysis.
classical_check: Differs from the classical tantric sense of stambhan (paralysing movement or speech).

gist: Hums a film song: 'seeing these eyes we forget all our tears'.
Says it was some such song, not sure.
Says it was something like his own.
Filler 'yes'.
Song line: after coming before you we forget our questions.

hindi: ये स्तंभ है या अष्टम भाव से होता है।
says: Stambhan is produced from the 8th house, as the one-line answer to the student.
cells_derived_method: 8th sign depends on lagna as before; the effect needs a strong 8th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius lagna (9+7=16, so 4): Cancer is the 8th, Moon-ruled, stambhan works through emotion.
Derived: Gemini lagna (3+7=10) has Capricorn 8th, Saturn-ruled, a slow, heavy stambhan.

ambiguity: Caption is a garbled question-answer mix; 'ye stambh hai ya' reads as 'is this stambhan? it comes from the 8th'.

gist: Filler 'yes'.
Filler 'okay'.
Filler 'something like that'.
He says he only wanted to sing a song.
He sang and rambled.

hindi: तो जब आपको यह अष्टम भाव की भी क्रिया आती है तो आप मजे की बात देखेंगे कि आपके सामने आया हुआ व्यक्ति प्रश्न भूल जाएगा।
says: When you also master the working of the 8th house, the person who comes before you forgets his question, which is the practical sign that it has worked.
cells_derived_method: 8th sign = lagna + 7, so the style of the effect shifts by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, the effect is direct and intense.
Derived: Leo lagna, the other person drifts into confusion and forgets softly.

ambiguity: 'Kriya' (practice) of the 8th is not described in this sentence.

hindi: अभी वह सोच के आया साले कुत्ते प्लस तीन चार गाली और और वो अंदर आके भूल गया।
says: Example: a man who came in planning to abuse you with several swear words enters and forgets all of it, a result of the 8th-house power.
ambiguity: A story illustration rather than a general rule.

hindi: ये अष्टम भाव से होता है।
says: He confirms that this forgetting effect comes from the 8th house, not from any other house.

gist: Remark: very powerful.

hindi: इसलिए आपके सब खेल ग्रहों का ही है।
says: Therefore everything that happens in your life is the play of planets.
classical_check: Repeats his earlier determinism claim; classical texts say planets indicate karma.

hindi: बाकी आपके अपने पर्सनल रेमेडीज आप कितनी रेमेडीज कर पाते हैं
says: What is left is up to you: how many personal remedies you manage to perform decides how much the planets' play is eased.
ambiguity: The sentence is open-ended and runs into the next.

hindi: और ये रेमेडीज करने के लिए जरूरी है कि बृहस्पति का सहारा लो।
says: To be able to do remedies at all, you need the support of Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'Sahara' (support) probably means a strong Jupiter in the chart or Jupiter-related practices.
classical_check: Jupiter as guru and faith is classical; as the enabler of remedies it is his line.

hindi: इसलिए बृहस्पति बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट है क्योंकि इसी के दम पर चलता है।
says: Jupiter is very important because the whole remedy system runs on his strength.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with Jupiter as the planet of dharma and guidance.

gist: Course plan: Jupiter has been kept for a later class.
He does not know what the Jupiter class will be like.
What will 'Lord Jupiter' make us do?
Course plan: Rahu, Ketu, Jupiter still remain, so bear with the rest.
They will look again when these are completed.

hindi: कई बार बताते हैं कि किसी को पूजा नहीं करनी चाहिए।
says: Sometimes the chart analysis shows that a particular person should not do puja at all.
ambiguity: The indicator in the chart that shows this is not given here.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view that worship is always beneficial.

hindi: हां पूजा नहीं करनी चाहिए।
says: He confirms: puja should be avoided by such persons.

gist: Repeats 'many people'.

hindi: बहुत लोगों को होम्योपैथी नहीं लेनी चाहिए।
says: Analogy: many people should not take homeopathy, as a system can be unsuitable for a person; recorded as his analogy, not medical advice.
ambiguity: A medicine remark used only for analogy; no health recommendation is taken from it.

hindi: बहुतों को एलोपैथी नहीं लेनी चाहिए।
says: Analogy continued: many people should also avoid allopathy; again only an analogy about suitability, not a medical statement to follow.
ambiguity: Not medical advice; flagged.

hindi: बहुत लोगों को आयुर्वेदिक सूट नहीं करती।
says: Analogy continued: Ayurveda also does not suit many people, so every system is person-specific.
ambiguity: Analogy only; no health advice is taken.

hindi: ऐसे ही बहुतों को पूजा सूट नहीं करती।
says: In the same way puja does not suit many people; suitability of a remedy must be checked person by person.
classical_check: Differs from the classical blanket recommendation of worship.

hindi: बहुत से लोग ऐसे हैं जो इस हिप्नोसिस में रह रहे हैं।
says: Many people live under a hypnosis, fixed in one belief or ritual and unable to leave it.
ambiguity: The planet is named in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as delusion is classical.

hindi: ये राहु है के भैया हम तो माता के पास ही जाते हैं।
says: This hypnosis is Rahu: the person insists 'I only go to the Mother (goddess)'.
classical_check: Rahu as obsession and fixation is classical.

hindi: पिता के पास ही जाते हैं।
says: Another form of the same Rahu fixation: 'I only go to the Father (a deity or guru)'.
ambiguity: 'Pita' could mean a father deity such as Shiva or a guru.

gist: The fixated person says 'this is the only court' and 'so-and-so'.

hindi: फिर बोले दुख क्यों तुम्हारे जीवन में?
says: If someone faces sorrow despite devotion, he is then asked why there is suffering in his life; the argument against exclusive worship.
ambiguity: A rhetorical question.

hindi: हो सकता है इनकी कृपा से कम हो।
says: The sorrow may be less because of that deity's grace.

hindi: होने नहीं चाहिए।
says: The sorrow should not have been there at all if the single worship worked fully.

hindi: लेकिन इनकी कृपा से ही कम हो।
says: But suffering is only reduced, never removed, by that single deity's grace.

hindi: यह बेवकूफी दिमाग में बस जाती है और इससे आदमी निकल नहीं पाता।
says: This foolish belief settles in the mind and the person cannot get out of it.
classical_check: Rahu's hold on the mind is classical.

hindi: यह हिप्नोसिस है।
says: He names this state hypnosis, the lock produced by Rahu.

hindi: जब राहु भ्रष्ट हो जाए तो बुद्धि भ्रष्ट है।
says: When Rahu is spoilt (afflicted) in a chart, the intelligence is spoilt as well.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's effect on intellect would be most visible in the 5th (intellect) or 1st house and depends on its sign; no cell is stated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in 5th (lagna 8-5+1=4, Cancer lagna): obsessive, fixed thinking.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the lagna (Gemini lagna): the mind is clever but swept by fixations.

ambiguity: 'Bhrasht' (corrupt) is not defined as a specific affliction.
classical_check: Rahu as confusion of the mind agrees with classical views.

hindi: आपका हिप्नोसिस नहीं छूटता और आप बेवकूफों की तरह कुछ नया नहीं करते।
says: The hypnosis does not break and, like fools, you never try anything new.

hindi: इसीलिए सबसे बड़ी समस्या इसी में है कि ये यही जपते रहो।
says: The biggest problem is the instruction to keep chanting the same single mantra over and over.
classical_check: Differs from classical advice of continuous japa.

gist: Repeats: keep chanting only this.

hindi: बुद्धि ब्लॉक हो के भ्रष्ट हो जाती है।
says: The intellect gets blocked and then corrupted.

hindi: ब्लॉक हो के भ्रष्ट हो जाती है बुद्धि पूरी की
says: The intellect becomes completely blocked and corrupt; the sentence is cut at the batch end and finishes in the next chunk.
ambiguity: Cut off at the chunk boundary ('puri ki' continues in 'puri').

hindi: पूरी। ये उसके आगे सोचना ही बंद।
says: The whole intellect is shut, and the person stops thinking beyond that one practice.
ambiguity: This chunk starts with the tail of the earlier sentence ('puri'), then its own short sentence.

hindi: मुन्ना को उसमें बिजी कर दिया।
says: The mind has been kept busy in that single routine, like a child kept occupied.
ambiguity: 'Munna' is a figure of speech for the mind or the follower.

hindi: ज्ञान कभी नहीं आएगा।
says: In this state real knowledge will never come.

hindi: इसलिए ज्ञान की बातें करने वाले लोग बड़े रेवोलशनरी होते हैं और पागल होते हैं।
says: People who speak real knowledge are revolutionary and look mad, since they break the usual track.

hindi: विचित्र बातें करते हैं।
says: They say strange things that look odd to ordinary people.

hindi: लोग समझ नहीं पाते हैं और वो सिर्फ कृपा से चलता है।
says: People cannot understand them, and such knowledge moves only by grace, not by effort.
ambiguity: 'Vo' (that) could mean the knowledge or the life of such a person.

hindi: इसलिए कृपा पे ध्यान दो जी।
says: So pay attention to grace (the support of Jupiter, teacher and the divine) rather than only to techniques.
ambiguity: Jupiter link is inferred from the earlier sentence on his support.

gist: Golgappa joke: see which golgappa's water you drank.
Joke: change the vendor and see.
Joke: maybe another golgappa will suit you.

hindi: हो ही जाता है।
says: If one practice or teacher does not suit you, another will; switching eventually finds a fit.
ambiguity: Golgappa is a metaphor for trying different remedies.

hindi: नए-नए गोलगप्पे हेल्प करते हैं।
says: Trying new things (new remedies, new teachers) helps, he says through the golgappa metaphor.

gist: Keep trying.
That is what life means.

hindi: परिवर्तन लाते रहो।
says: Keep bringing change into your practices and life, and do not stay stuck in one fixed routine.
ambiguity: A closing exhortation tied to the anti-Rahu-hypnosis theme.
